Lohar's Trial
<b><size=30>Lohar's Trial</size></b>
 <color=#997336>Are You A Real Warrior?</color>
 <b>Overview</b>
Defeat barbarians, collect relics, and challenge Lohar.
 <b>Requirements</b>
Any governor can take part in this event and collect event items, but you must be in an <color=#379f1f>alliance</color> to launch a rally against Lohar's troop.
 <b>How to Play</b>
1. During the event, defeat Barbarian Troops on the map to collect <color=#379f1f>Bone Necklaces</color>.
2. You can use Bone Necklaces for a chance to gain one of Lohar's relics: <color=#379f1f>Lohar's Longbow</color> or <color=#379f1f>Lohar's Buckler</color>.
3. Use Lohar's relics to summon Lohar and his troop of elite soldiers near your city.
4. To defeat Lohar, you will need to launch a rally attack with your allies.
 <b>Rewards</b>
1. You will earn a reward every time you use a Bone Necklace.
2. You will earn even better rewards for defeating Lohar's troop.

<color=#00A0FF>"Will we witness the birth of a legend?"</color>y
 <b>Overview</b>
Challenge the warriors of Karaku and take home priceless treasures.
 <b>Starting the Event</b>
1. From the event page, tap the <color=#379f1f>CHALLENGE</color> button to summon a troop of Karaku warriors.
2. Summoning Karaku warriors costs <color=#379f1f>action points</color>.
3. You can also tap the <color=#379f1f>Help Us!</color> icon on the event page to help your allies with their challenges.
 <b>How to Play</b>
1. After summoning a Karaku troop, you can <color=#379f1f>attack it directly</color>, <color=#379f1f>launch a rally attack</color> against it, or <color=#379f1f>call for help</color>.
2. If you choose to launch a <color=#379f1f>rally attack</color>, you will not be able to reinforce the rallied army after it sets out.
3. If you <color=#379f1f>call for help</color>, the Karaku troop will become visible to your fellow alliance members, allowing them to launch their own rally attacks against it.
4. To complete the Karuak Ceremony, you must defeat <color=#379f1f>all levels</color> of Karaku troops.
 <b>Event Difficulty</b>
1. Before starting the Karuak Ceremony, you can choose from one of <color=#379f1f>5 difficulty levels</color>. After selecting a difficulty, it cannot be changed for the rest of the Ceremony.
2. To unlock a new difficulty level, you must complete the Ceremony at the previous difficulty level. You will be able to select the new difficulty level in the <color=#379f1f>next instance of the event</color>.
 <b>Mark of the Karuak</b>
1. <color=#379f1f>Calling for help</color> costs <color=#379f1f>1</color> Mark of the Karuak.
2. At the start of the Ceremony, all governors will automatically receive <color=#379f1f>5</color> Marks of the Karuak.
3. Every time you help an ally with their challenge, you have a small chance to earn a Mark of the Karuak.
 <b>Rewards</b>
1. At the end of the Karuak Ceremony event, you will receive a reward based on the <color=#379f1f>highest level</color> you completed.
2. Higher difficulty levels will earn you better rewards. 
 <b>Important Notes</b>
At the end of the event, all unused Marks of the Karuak will be <color=#E06666>lost</color>.

CornucopiaZ
<b><size=30>Cornucopia</size></b>
<b><size=24>Event Rules</size></b>
1. Governors can obtain Cornucopia by defeating barbarians.
2. Cornucopia can be accumulated by defeating multiple barbarians troops with a single troop without returning home. This total will be reset once the troop returns to its home city.
3. Event score is equivalent to the maximum number of Cornucopia a governor has accumulated during a single expedition. Achieve the specified scores to receive corresponding rewards.
4. Governors throughout the kingdom will be ranked based on their event score. At the end of the event, the top 100 governors will receive additional rank rewards.
Cornucopia Rewards
Lvl 1-5 Barbarians = 1 Cornucopia
Lvl 6-10 Barbarians = 2 Cornucopia  
Lvl 11-15 Barbarians = 3 Cornucopia
Lvl 16-20 Barbarians = 5 Cornucopia
Lvl 21-25 Barbarians = 10 Cornucopia
During the event, governors can obtain Cornucopia by defeating barbarians. After a troop has been dispatched from a governor's home city, the number of Cornucopia obtained by the troop will accumulate, but the total will be reset once the troop returns home. A governor's score for this event is equivalent to the maximum number of Cornucopia obtained on a single, continuous expedition. Governors who achieve the specified scores will receive additional rewards.

<b><size=30>Hungry Turkey</size></b>  
<b><size=24>Event Rules</size></b>
1. Feed your turkey Corncobs to help him level up. Once your turkey reaches certain levels you will receive corresponding rewards.
2. Each Corncob that is fed has a chance to multiply the experience received by your turkey.
3. Once your turkey reaches the maximum level (Level 20), all remaining Corncobs will be exchanged for an equivalent number of Lvl 2 Resource Packs.
4. Level rewards can only be claimed once by each governor. Feeding progress will not be reset during the event.
Tips:
1. Participate in the "Hungry Turkey" event to receive plentiful rewards. Once your turkey reaches Level 20, you will be able to claim a special "Turkey Sculpture" decoration for your city!
2. Once a governor has claimed the "Turkey Sculpture" decoration, the structure will be permanently unlocked for their city, and can be built or demolished at anytime. (Governors who have not received this item will be unable to view the corresponding structure in their building list.)
3. The first time a turkey sculpture is constructed, the corresponding "Turkey Sculpture" item will be consumed. No items will be returned if the sculpture is demolished. However, the sculpture can be rebuilt for 1,000 stone.J

An Ancient Empire Reborn
<b><size=30>Red Packet Bonanza</size></b>  
<b><size=24>Event Rules</size></b>
1. Use your Lucky Fu to earn amazing rewards. Once your red packet reaches certain levels you will receive corresponding rewards.
2. Each Lucky Fu that is stuffed into the red packet has a chance to multiply the experience received by the packet.
3. Once your red packet reaches the maximum level (Level 10), all remaining Lucky Fu will be exchanged for an equivalent number of Lvl 2 Resource Packs.
4. Level rewards can only be claimed once by each governor. Progress will not be reset during the event.
Tips:
1. Participate in the "Red Packet Bonanza" event to receive plentiful rewards. Once your red packet reaches Level 10, you will be able to claim a special "Lucky Lion" decoration for your city!
2. Once a governor has claimed the "Lucky Lion" decoration, the decoration will be permanently unlocked for their city, and can be built or demolished at anytime. (Governors who have not received this item will be unable to view the corresponding structure in their building list.)
3. The first time a lucky lion decoration is constructed, the corresponding "Lucky Lion" item will be consumed. No items will be returned if the decoration is demolished. However, the decoration can be rebuilt for 1,000 stone.
Experience needed to upgrade:
Level 0 -> 1 = 5
Level 1 -> 2 = 5
Level 2 -> 3 = 16
Level 3 -> 4 = 16
Level 4 -> 5 = 24
Level 5 -> 6 = 24
Level 6 -> 7 = 24
Level 7 -> 8 = 36
Level 8 -> 9 = 36
Level 9 -> 10 = 50

<b><size=30>Pledge of Thorns</size></b>
<b><size=24>Event Rules</size></b>
1. Add <color=#EE7600>Roses</color> to your flower arrangement. Once your arrangement reaches certain levels you will receive corresponding rewards.
2. Unlock the fantasy flower arrangement to receive <color=#EE7600>bonus rewards</color>!
3. Each Rose that is added has a chance to multiply the experience received by the flower arrangement.
4. Once your flower arrangement reaches the maximum level (Level 25), all remaining Roses will be exchanged for an equivalent number of Lvl 2 Resource Packs.
5. Level rewards can only be claimed once by each governor. Progress will not be reset during the event.
Tips:
1. Participate in the event to receive plentiful rewards. Once your flower arrangement reaches Level 15, you will receive a special <color=#EE7600>Bed of Roses</color> city decoration! Unlock your fantasy flower arrangement and upgrade it to Level 17 to receive a limited-edition Valentine's Day theme
<color=#EE7600>Cupid's Arrow (Permanent)</color>!
2. Once a governor has claimed the "Bed of Roses" decoration, the structure will be permanently unlocked for their city, and can be built or demolished at anytime. (Governors who have not received this item will be unable to view the corresponding structure in their building list.)
3. The first time a bed of roses decoration is constructed, the corresponding "Bed of Roses" item will be consumed. No items will be returned if the sculpture is demolished. However, the sculpture can be rebuilt for 1,000 wood.

Collect roses to build a giant flower arrangement!
<b><size=24>Event Rules</size></b>

CHOCOLATE CRUSADE
During the event, governors can obtain Chocolates by defeating barbarians. After a troop has been dispatched from a governor's home city, the number of Chocolates obtained by the troop will accumulate, but the total will be reset once the troop returns home. A governor's score for this event is equivalent to the maximum number of Chocolates obtained on a single, continuous expedition. Governors who achieve the specified scores will receive additional rewards.
<b><size=30>Chocolate Crusade</size></b>
<b><size=24>Event Rules</size></b>
1. Governors can obtain Chocolates by defeating barbarians.
2. Chocolates can be accumulated by defeating multiple barbarian troops with a single troop without returning home. This total will be reset once the troop returns to its home city.
3. A governor's score for the event is equivalent to the maximum number of Chocolates a they have accumulated during a single expedition. Achieve the specified scores to receive additional rewards (including Roses).
4. Governors throughout the kingdom will be ranked based on their event score. At the end of the event, the top 100 governors will receive additional rank rewards.
Number of Chocolates Rewarded:
Level 1-5 Barbarians = 1 Chocolate
Level 6-10 Barbarians = 2 Chocolates 
Level 11-15 Barbarians = 3 Chocolates
Level 16-20 Barbarians = 5 Chocolates
Level 21-25 Barbarians = 10 Chocolates

TREE OF FELLOWSHIP
Tree of Fellowship!
We Are as Strong as a Mighty Oak!
<b><size=30>Tree of Fellowship</size></b> 
<b><size=24>Event Rules</size></b>
1. Help your tree grow by watering it with <color=#EE7600>Pots of Dew</color> or spending gems to fertilize it. Once your tree reaches certain levels all alliance members will receive corresponding rewards. Rewards will be received by mail.
2. Each time you use a <color=#EE7600>Pot of Dew</color> to water your tree you will receive a <color=#EE7600>Green Leaf</color> (even after your tree has reached the maximum level).
3. Each time you spend gems to water your tree you will receive a <color=#EE7600>Flower Petal</color> (even after your tree has reached the maximum level).
4. <color=#EE7600>Green Leaves</color> and <color=#EE7600>Flower Petals</color> can be exchanged for rewards in the "Sunny Breeze" event. Potential rewards include a limited-edition <color=#EE7600>Spring Blossoms</color> city theme!
5. Each time the tree is watered or fertilized, there is a chance that the tree will receive bonus experience.
6. You will receive 1 contribution point for every 1 experience point you add to the tree. The individual contributions of all governors in the alliance will be displayed on the "Contributions" page.

Heartfelt Words
During the event, governors can obtain Greeting Cards by defeating barbarians. After a troop has been dispatched from a governor's home city, the number of Greeting Cards obtained by the troop will accumulate, but the total will be reset once the troop returns home. A governor's score on this event is equivalent to the maximum number of Greeting Cards obtained on a single, continuous expedition. Governors who achieve specified scores will receive additional rewards.
<b><size=30>Heartfelt Words</size></b>
<b><size=24>Event Rules</size></b>
1. Governors can obtain Greeting Cards by defeating barbarians.
2. Greeting Cards can be accumulated by defeating multiple barbarian troops with a single troop without returning home. This total will be reset once the troop returns to its home city.
3. Event score is equivalent to the maximum number of Greeting Cards a governor has accumulated during a single expedition. Achieve the specified scores to receive additional rewards (including Roses).
4. Governors throughout the kingdom will be ranked based on their event score. At the end of the event, the top 100 governors will receive additional rank rewards.

Silk Road
Silk Road Privateer
Total Chances Remaining: 
EASY
NORMAL
HARD
NIGHTMARE
HELL
 <b>Overview</b>
Work with your alliance to defend a merchant caravan from Barbarian Raiders until it reaches its destination.
 <b>Requirements</b>
You must be in an alliance to take part in this event.
 <b>Starting the Event</b>
1. From the event page, your alliance leader or officers can select a difficulty level and summon a caravan.
2. Summoning a caravan costs <color=#379f1f>Alliance Credits</color>.
3. There is a limit to how many caravans you can escort in each instance of this event. Successfully escorting a caravan will cost <color=#379f1f>1 escort chance</color>.
4. Your alliance leader or officers can choose to abandon an ongoing caravan escort at any time. Your alliance will not lose an escort chance if it quits midway through.
5. Each governor can only dispatch <color=#379f1f>1 troop</color> to escort the caravan.
 <b>How to Play</b>
1. Once summoned, the caravan will begin traveling to a random village on the map. Barbarian Raiders will attack the caravan along the way.
2. You will also encounter Barbarian Chieftains, who will stop the caravan from moving. You must defeat the Chieftain to continue.
3. Your escort will be successful once the caravan reaches its target village.
 <b>Event Difficulty and Points</b>
1. There are multiple difficulty levels for this event. To unlock a difficulty level, you must complete the previous difficulty level while fulfilling certain requirements.
2. You can earn individual points by attacking barbarians. The more damage you deal, the more points you'll earn.
3. You can also earn points over time by keeping your troop within a certain range of the caravan.
 <b>Rankings</b>
1. This event includes a <color=#379f1f>leaderboard</color>. Your alliance's ranking will be affected by the <color=#379f1f>difficulty</color> it chose.
2. For alliances that chose the same difficulty level, the rankings will be based on the final <color=#379f1f>condition</color> of their caravans.
 <b>Rewards</b>
1. The higher the <color=#379f1f>difficulty</color> you selected, the better your rewards will be for successfully escorting the caravan.
2. Your rewards will also be affected by the <color=#379f1f>condition</color> of the caravan when it arrives at its destination. The less damage it has taken, the better your rewards will be.
3. Rewards will be sent to all alliance members via mail at the end of the escort. Rank rewards will be sent at the end of the event.
<b><size=30>Silk Road Privateer</size></b>
<b><size=24>Event Rules</size></b>
1. During the event, governors can select a difficulty and dispatch a private caravan. Action points will be expended each time a private caravan is dispatched.
2. Caravan escort missions come in various difficulties. Some difficulties are automatically unlocked based on your power. Higher difficulties will be unlocked once you meet the requirements. Tap a difficulty flag for more detailed information and requirements.
3. Barbarian troops will appear and attack the caravan while it is en route to its destination. Defeat all barbarian troops to ensure that the caravan and its goods safely reach the destination.
4. Once the caravan has been escorted to its destination, you will receive corresponding event rewards via in-game mail. The higher the percentage of goods that are safely delivered to the destination, the greater the rewards received.
5. This event can only be attempted a certain number of times. Every successful escort mission will use up one challenge attempt. 
6. Governors will be ranked by their highest difficulty level completed, and then by their highest score achieved at that difficulty level. Rank rewards will be received at the end of the event..

<b><size=30>Shadow Legion Invasion</size></b>
<b><size=24>Event Rules</size></b>
1. During this event, a large number of <color=#EE7600>Dark Fortresses</color> will appear on the map.
2. Rank 4 or above Alliance members can choose to start the event at any time (note: your alliance must have at least 30 members).
3. Once the event has started, the Dark Fortress will send out troops that will march to attack the cities of alliance members.
4. 25 waves of attacks will be sent out. An elite Shadow Legion troop will be sent out once very 5 waves, which can be defeated for extra item rewards.
5. Governors will be eliminated from the event if their city is defeated twice. Once eliminated, they will no longer be a target for the Shadow Legion. If all alliance members are eliminated, the event will end.
6. If at least 15 members survive all 25 waves, it will be possible to launch a counterattack against the Dark Fortress itself. Once the Fortress is defeated, the next Shadow Legion difficulty level will be unlocked. The new difficulty level option will be visible the next time the event is started. The last difficulty level completed will also be displayed. If your alliance loses to the same difficulty level twice, the difficulty will automatically be lowered.
7. Peace Shields will not protect you from the Shadow Legion.
8. The Shadow Legion's troops will have special abilities. Governors will need to plan their strategy (and which commanders to use) carefully!
Tips:
1. Defeating the Shadow Legion will earn you individual credits and alliance credits.
2. You can only earn prizes when both individual and alliance credits reach the target level. For each instance of this event, you will only earn the prize corresponding to the highest level completed. Prizes are sent by in-game mail.
3. If you leave your alliance during the event, your individual credits will be reset to zero.
4. Each governor can only send one troop to attack the Shadow Legion.
The Dark Fortress is the gathering point of the Shadow Legion. Once the invasion has begun, the Shadow Legion will start from the Dark Fortress and proceed to attack Alliance member cities within your Alliance's territory.S

<b><size=24>Event Rules</size></b>
1. During this event, a large number of <color=#EE7600>Dark Fortresses</color> will appear on the map.
2. Rank 4 or above Alliance members can choose to start the event at any time (note: your alliance must have at least 30 members).
3. Once the event has started, the Dark Fortress will send out troops that will march to attack the cities of alliance members.
4. 25 waves of attacks will be sent out. An <color=#EE7600>elite Shadow Legion troop</color> will be sent out once <color=#EE7600>every 5 waves</color>, which can be defeated for extra item rewards.
5. Governors will be eliminated from the event after their <color=#EE7600>city has been breached 2 times</color>. Once eliminated, they can no longer be a target for the Shadow Legion. If all alliance members are eliminated, the event will end.
6. Using a teleport during a Shadow Legion invasion will be considered as 1 breach.
7. If at least <color=#EE7600>15 members survive</color> all 25 waves, the alliance will <color=#EE7600>unlock the next difficulty</color> of the Shadow Legion Invasion event. The new difficulty level option will be visible the next time the event is started. The alliance leader and officers can select the difficulty in the event panel.
8. Peace Shields will not protect you from the Shadow Legion's troops.
9. The Shadow Legion's troops will each have different special skills.
10. During each event, each alliance only has one chance to challenge.
11. When the Lost Kingdom opens, if the event is started in the Lost Kingdom, it cannot be started again in your original kingdom. If you began the event in your original kingdom, it cannot be started again after entering the Lost Kingdom.
Tips:
1. Defeating the Shadow Legion will earn you individual credits and alliance credits.
2. You can only earn prizes when both individual and alliance credits reach the target level. For each instance of this event, you will only earn the prize corresponding to the highest level completed. Prizes are sent by in-game mail.
3. If you leave your alliance during the event, your individual credits will be reset to zero.
4. Each governor can only send one troop to attack the Shadow Legion.n

 <color=#997336>On the night of a blood moon...</color>

 <color=#997336>Alas, wicked servants of the Night Eternal stole the sacrificial offering...</color>
 <color=#997336>And thus, ne'er shall the sun shine again upon the Golden Kingdom.</color>
 <color=#997336>For months now, a ballad has been circulating around the land, and the presence of Karaku's High Priest before us today only confirms it. It says that Karaku's annual Festival of the Eternal King was disrupted by servants of the demon known as the Night Eternal. These demon-worshippers now rule the "Golden Kingdom" from the shadows, though Karaku's loyal High Priest managed to escape east to the "dawnlands". Following an ancient prophecy, he has called for warriors throughout the dawnlands to come to Karaku's aid. An epic battle awaits!</color>
 <color=#997336>To protect its ancient land and faith, the Kingdom of Karaku has secluded itself in the west, beyond foreboding mountains and forests. With the High Priest as our guide, we have begun marching our forces towards Khabus, capital of Karaku. To reach the mountains, however, we must first cross the deadly and treacherous Takra Forest...</color>
 <b>Overview</b>
Explore the Takra Forest and save Karaku.

 <b>Important Notes</b>
1. The dense Takra forest is rugged and winding. Each governor can only dispatch <color=#E06666>1 troop</color>.

TREASURE HUNT
<b><size=30>Treasure Hunt</size></b>
 <color=#997336>Fortune favors the bold.</color>
 <b>Overview</b>
Collect Treasure Map Fragments to find the treasure.
 <b>Starting the Event</b>
See the main event page to learn how to get Treasure Map Fragments.
 <b>How to Play</b>
1. Collect 7 different Treasure Map Fragments to obtain a complete Treasure Map. Tap the <color=#379f1f>COMBINE</color> button to learn the location of the treasure.
2. After locating the treasure, you can send a Scout to dig it up.
3. The hunt will begin as soon as you combine a map. If you have searched for the treasure for over <color=#379f1f>8 hours</color> without finding it, your treasure hunt will fail, and the corresponding map and treasure will be lost.
 <b>Rewards</b>
Once your Scout has claimed a treasure, you will receive it via mail.
 <b>Important Notes</b>
1. You can hunt for treasure up to 3 times per day. A failed attempt <color=#E06666>will still be counted</color> towards the daily limit.
2. You can see treasure locations discovered by other governors on the map, but only governors with the corresponding map can claim the treasure inside.

<b><size=30>Assembling Scrolls</size></b>
<b><size=24>Event Rules</size></b>
1. The first time a puzzle is attempted, a corresponding number of Scroll Fragments will be expended. Additional attempts will not expend Scroll Fragments.
2. Governors will be able to attempt a puzzle once the unlock countdown for that puzzle reaches zero, but only after completing the previous puzzles.

5. Governors who complete all of the puzzles (on any difficulty) will receive chest rewards.
Tips:
1. Tap the question mark in the bottom left corner to view the different speed ratings and their corresponding time requirements.
2. After starting a puzzle, tap and hold the eye in the bottom right corner to view the completed puzzle.

1. Tap the <color=#379f1f>Rankings</color> icon on the event page to view the event leaderboard.
2. The <color=#379f1f>stage rankings</color> will rank you based on how many points you earned in a given stage.
3. The <color=#379f1f>overall rankings</color> for the event will be based on how many points you earned across all stages.
 <b>Points</b>
1. Tap the <color=#379f1f>Points</color> icon on the right-hand side of the event page to learn how to earn points.
2. During the Final Sprint stage, you can earn points by completing the objectives of any of the <color=#379f1f>previous 5 stages</color>, though you will earn comparatively fewer points.
 <b>Rewards</b>
1. During each stage, you can unlock new <color=#379f1f>progress rewards</color> by reaching certain point milestones.
2. At the end of each stage and at the end of the event, the top <color=#379f1f>100</color> governors in the stage and overall rankings will also receive <color=#379f1f>rank rewards</color> via mail.
3. For rank rewards that include commander sculptures, you can <color=#379f1f>choose your preferred commander</color> from a preset list. You can change your preferred commander at any time before the end of the Final Sprint stage.f

Relentless Warriors
A percentage of your units killed during this season will be returned to you at the end of the season.
1. In this season's Lost Kingdom, your units killed in battles with other governors will be recorded in the Hall of Heroes. Units lost in battles outside of the Lost Kingdom or after the season is settled will not be recorded.
2. After the season ends, 30% of all recorded troops will be returned to their governors.
3. This return ratio is fixed, and cannot be increased.
4. The Hall of Heroes records the type and level of all troops killed. Special units, when returned, will be based on your civilization at the end of the season.
5. In addition to the 30% of troops returned, you can also use Troop Return Scrolls to receive an extra 10%.
6. Troop Return Scrolls can be used for yourself, or to help an ally from the same alliance.
7. If you use a Troop Return Scroll on an ally, but they leave the alliance before claiming their units, your Troop Return Scroll will be returned to you via mail.
8. Governors that immigrate before the season ends cannot recover troops otherwise available through Troop Return Scrolls.
9. Troop Return Scrolls can only be used during their corresponding season. At the end of the season, any unused Return Scrolls will be converted into 500 Gems each.

<b><size=30>Lucky Stall</size></b>
 <color=#997336>Try your luck and win prizes!</color>
 <b>Overview</b>
Make a wish and get a surprise reward.
 <b>Starting the Event</b>
1. You can wish for <color=#379f1f>whichever theme you prefer</color> during the event period. The themes are "Construction", "Research", and "Training".
2. The first wish is free of charge. Subsequent wishes will cost 1 <color=#379f1f>Lucky Coin</color> each.
3. Lucky Coins can be obtained from the <color=#379f1f>Lucky Spin</color> event.
 <b>How to Play</b>
1. Select a theme and make a wish to obtain a <color=#379f1f>discount in resource costs</color> for the theme (effective only during the event period).
2. Once you've made a wish, you can tap <color=#379f1f>CHANGE</color> to use 1 Lucky Coin to make new wish.
3. After making a new wish, you can choose whether or not you want to replace your existing resource discount with your new one.
 <b>Important Notes</b>
1. All resource discounts only apply to <color=#E06666>Food, Wood, Stone, and Gold</color>.
2. The resource discount for the Construction theme <color=#E06666>only applies to building upgrades</color>, and does not apply to constructing new buildings or decorations.
3. In each instance of this event, each resource has a <color=#E06666>limit on how much it can be discounted</color>. Once you've reached that limit, the resource costs for that resource will no longer be discounted.
4. If you cancel an upgrade/training, you will receive a refund of all your resources as per usual, but it will <color=#E06666>still count towards your discount cap</color> for the event.
5. All Lucky Coins will be <color=#E06666>lost</color> at the end of the event, so make sure to use them beforehand.

Basic Overview
Skill Overview
Outlaw Affiliation
Treasure Outlaws
These so-called "Treasure Outlaws" share the same disregard for civilization as their stronger barbarian cousins, but would rather steal and avoid direct confrontations. Governors should still beware their strange, uncanny skills.
Outlaw Affiliation`
Thieves belong to specific kingdoms, and Governors can only attack <color=#c88800><b>thieves affiliated to their</b></color> kingdom. Rules of this affiliation are:
1. In the kingdom map, thieves spawned around <color=#c88800><b>all holy sites</b></color> belong to the kingdom.
2. In the map of seasons 1-3 of the Lost Kingdom, thieves spawned around a <color=#c88800><b>holy site</b></color> belong to the kingdom which occupies it.
3. In the Season of Conquest map of the Lost Kingdom, thieves spawned around a <color=#c88800><b>holy site</b></color> belong to all kingdoms of the camp which occupies it.

Welcome to the "Preparation Season", where you can unify the kingdom by defeating barbarians, seizing passes and thus occupying the Lost Temple in alliances of your choosing with free teleportation.
Welcome to "Lost Kingdom: Endless War", where vast resource deposits allow you to battle for the Great Ziggurat with other kingdoms at the head of unusually powerful armies and commanders.
Welcome to the "Lost Kingdom: Distant Journey", a brand-new matching system pitting you against opponents of comparable skill in a thrilling fight for the King's Land and Great Ziggurat.
Welcome to the "Lost Kingdom: Light and Darkness", where you take on powerful opponents to wrest control of the Great Ziggurat across brand-new maps in teams of your choosing and Camps offering decisive buffs.
Welcome to "Season of Conquest: Heroic Anthem". In this story, the new Crystal research system and commander Bastion mechanics will encourage a wide range of original strategies.
Welcome to "Season of Conquest: Strife of the Eight". In this story, the Great Ziggurat is once again up for grabs, along with a new mix of Crystal technologies and commander Bastions that will change the rules of the war.
Welcome to "Season of Conquest: March of the Ages" a new Story incorporating Forward Camps and an important new morale system which demands a more cautious approach to these age-old battlefields.

You must meet the following requirements to immigrate to this kingdom:

 After you immigrate, please note that the following things will occur:

Frederick I, also known as Frederick Barbarossa (or "Red Beard") was the Holy Roman Emperor from 1155 until his death. Historians consider him an accomplished politician, military strategist, and one of the most successful rulers of medieval Europe whose empire, in its zenith, reached a size and strength comparable to the Roman Empire that inspired it.
Minamoto no Yoshitsune was a military commander of the Minamoto clan of Japan in the late Heian and early Kamakura periods. During the Genpei War, he led a series of battles which toppled the Ise-Heishi branch of the Taira clan. Yoshitsune is considered one of the greatest and the most popular warriors of his era, and one of the most famous samurai fighters in the history of Japan. 
Rodrigo D
az de Vivar was a Castilian nobleman and military leader in medieval Spain. The Moors called him El Cid, an honorific probably from the original Arabic al-Sayyid, 
. El Cid is often portrayed as a chivalric hero of the Reconquista, and a legendary figure in Spain.3
Richard I was King of England from 6 July 1189 until his death known popularly as "Richard the Lionheart" because of his reputation as a great military leader and warrior. Richard was a central Christian commander in the Third Crusade, scoring considerable victories against his Muslim counterpart, Saladin.9
Charlemagne (2 April 742 
 28 January 814), also known as "Charles the Great" united a majority of western and central Europe in what became known as the Carolingian Empire during Europe's early medieval period, and had a foundational influence on the future formation of France, Germany, and the Low Countries.
Taejo of Joseon, born Yi Seong-Gye, was the founder and the first king of the Joseon Dynasty of Korea in 1392
1393 under the name of "Joseon", thereby reviving an older state by the same name that had been, legendarily, established nearly three thousand years previously.
Born in Pella in 356 BC, Alexander III of Macedon, commonly known as Alexander the Great, was a king of the ancient Greek kingdom of Macedon. He succeeded his father Philip II to the throne at the age of 20 and spent most of his ruling years on an unprecedented and highly successful campaign through Asia and northeast Africa. By the age of thirty, he had created one of the largest empires of the ancient world, stretching from Greece to northwestern India.
Genghis Khan, born Tem
jin, was the founder of the largest contiguous empire in history
the Mongol Empire. His father, the head of a nomadic Mongol tribe, was killed by Tatars when Tem
jin was only nine, and his family was abandoned by their clan.
Wu Zetian (17 February 624-16 December 705) was the first Empress of China. Her prospects quickly improved with the aid of a strong education from her father as a consort in the Imperial Court, from which position she worked her way up to Empress and then ruler of China when the Emperor suffered a stroke. She was a successful and ruthless commander who famously left her tombstone blank, saying history would decide her true legacy.
Saladin was the first Muslim sultan of Egypt, Syria, Yemen, and Palestine, the founder of the Ayy
bid dynasty, and one of the most famous Muslim heroes of all time. Saladin fought against the Christian Crusaders, most notably against Richard the Lionheart during the Third Crusade. In 1187, Saladin inflicted a crushing defeat on the army of the Kingdom of Jerusalem and recaptured the holy city which had been occupied for nearly nine decades.f
Tomyris was the warrior queen of the nomadic Massagetae people in the 6th century BCE. She is said to have personally led her troops into battle to defend her lands against Cyrus the Great of the Achaemenid Empire. Most historians say she defeated and killed Cyrus in 530 BCE, a victory that considerably delayed the eastward expansion of the Persian Empire.t
Edward of Woodstock, known to history as the "Black Prince" was the eldest son of King Edward III of England, and one of the most successful English commanders during the Hundred Years' War between France and England. The Black Prince was appointed Duke of Aquitaine in accordance with the Treaty of Bretigny, bringing the first phase of The Hundred Years' War to a close.A
Guan Yu (approx. 160-220 CE) served as an important general under Liu Bei during the Three Kingdoms Period toward the end of the Eastern Han dynasty in China. Guan Yu was one of the "Five Tiger Generals" of ancient Chinese history, and he is still honored ubiquitously in Chinese society in many communities and settings.d
Chandragupta Maurya, nicknamed Moon Guardian, was the founder of the Maurya Empire in India. In 324 or 321 BCE, Maurya declared himself king and marched upon the Nanda Dynasty's capital city of Pataliputra. Chandragupta's forces went on to unify much of Northern India and establish a powerful, centralized state and one of the largest empires in its time.Q
Artemisia I, named after the sister of Apollo, probably lived around 500 BCE and ascended to the rulership upon the death of her husband, the King of Halicarnassus. Artemisia I notably campaigned with King Xerxes of Persia against the Greek city-states, and greatly distinguished herself as an admiral in combat against the Greek navies.

<b><size=30>Relics of the Shu Kingdom</size></b>
<b><size=24>Event Rules</size></b>
1. Collect a complete set of 7 different "Treasure Map Fragments" to combine them into a Treasure Map, which will reveal a location with "Strange Markings".
2. After finding a "Strange Markings" site, you can send a scout to excavate it. Once the excavation is complete, you can tap the "Strange Markings" to get a treasure.
3. You can see treasure locations discovered by other governors on the map, but only governors with the corresponding map can get the treasure inside.
4. The hunt will begin as soon as you combine a map. If you have searched for the treasure for over 8 hours without finding it, your treasure hunt will fail, and the corresponding map and treasure will be lost.
5. "Treasure Map Fragments" can be earned by taking part in the "Eternal Sanxingdui" event.
6. Join the treasure hunt for a chance to receive an exclusive "Standing Bronze Figurine" decoration from the Sanxingdui Ruins events.

<b><size=30>Team Draw</size></b>
<b><size=24>Event Rules</size></b>
1. Governors must take part in this event in teams of <color=#c88800>5</color>, featuring 1 team captain and 4 team members.
2. Governors may form teams in one of two ways: the captain can invite other governors to team up for the draw or fill the remaining slots with random governors; ordinary team members must find a team through the matchmaking process.
3. Captains must spend <color=#c88800>{p1} {p2}</color> to join the event, and team members <color=#c88800>{p3} {p4}</color>.
4. Each gacha round will involve a draw from a pool of <color=#c88800>10</color> cards with each governor choosing <color=#c88800>1</color> card. Once all governors have selected theirs, the <color=#c88800>5</color> remaining, unselected cards will be granted to the captain.
5. Governors must spend Imperial Scrolls to initiate the matchmaking process. If the matchmaking process fails to form a team after a certain length of time, then the team will be disbanded and any Scrolls spent returned.
6. The probabilities shown in the "Team Rewards List" reflect the chance for a team to obtain a certain reward in a single gacha event. <color=#c88800>However, each gacha round will offer a guaranteed reward of at least one "Legendary Commander Sculpture" or Legendary Commander.</color>
7. Any selections made during the gacha draw process cannot be changed. However, if you have drawn Commanders with Expertise or their sculptures, then this draw will be automatically exchanged for 1 Imperial Scroll.
8. Governors from different kingdoms may have access to different Commander Sculptures based on the current state of their kingdom during the teaming-up or matchmaking process, <color=#c88800>but the same probabilities apply across the board.</color>
9. At the end of the event, all unused Imperial Scrolls will be reclaimed as {p5} at a 1:1 ratio.

<b><size=30>Thief in the Night</size></b>
A far off corner of our kingdom is home to a band of masked and hooded treasure-stealing bandits that routinely sweep through isolated towns leaving no earthly possessions in their wake. Efforts by locals to engage the bandits directly have been frustrated by their artful ability to vanish at a moment's notice. Matters have come to a head in recent days as the bandits' lust for gold - both nobles and commoners - has driven the fiends to new marauding depths. The bandits' battle cry has become known throughout the kingdom: "Strip the city's gold mine!"
Our scouts have learned these bandits are even considered outcasts by their barbarian kin for their weak statue and conniving habits. Their only real "skillset", if it can be termed that, is an abundance of caution and tendency to disappear at the first sign of trouble. Our scouts have also noted their strange sorceries, but report the ragtag bunch is unlikely to pose any real threat to an organized force.
We have received word the fearsome bandits have been sighted in our kingdom hauling a heavy-laid cart on this snowy evening. One can only wonder what treasures these ne'er-do-wells plan to steal as Christmas approaches!R
 <b>Overview</b>
Send troops to chase down the thief, gather loot, and earn rewards.
 <b>Starting the Event</b>
1. During this event, you will have a total of <color=#379f1f>3 chances</color> to challenge this event and pursue the thief.
2. Dealing damage to the thief will earn you <color=#379f1f>Gold</color>. The more damage you deal, the more Gold you'll earn. There is also a chance you'll "crit" when dealing damage to him, earning you extra Gold.
3. The thief's loot will level up as you deal more damage to him.
4. At the end of the challenge, the thief will run away, leaving behind his ill-gotten loot. You'll need to dispatch a troop to pick it up to receive your rewards.
5. You can choose to give up a challenge at any time. If you give up, you won't lose one of your challenge chances, but you also won't earn any rewards.
 <b>Rankings</b>
In this event, you will be ranked based on the <color=#379f1f>highest damage</color> you dealt to the thief in a single challenge.
 <b>Rewards</b>
1. At the end of each challenge, the thief will leave his loot behind on the map. You'll need to dispatch a troop to pick it up to claim your rewards.
2. At the end of the event, the top 100 governors in the leaderboard will earn extra rank rewards.
 <b>Important Notes</b>
You can't start a new challenge in the last 60 minutes of the event.
 <b>Special Features</b>
1. Whenever you hit the thief with a basic attack, he has a chance to drop an <color=#379f1f>Energy Ring</color> on the map.
2. Whenever one of your troops moves inside an Energy Ring, you will gain one stack of the Energized effect. For every stack of the Energized effect you have, <color=#379f1f>all your troops will deal {s1}% more damage to the thief</color>.
3. Some of the thief's skills can inflict the <color=#379f1f>Fatigued</color> effect on you if they hit one of your troops:
- You will lose a number of stacks (at least 1) of the Energized effect. Energy Rings will randomly spawn around the thief.
- The more of your troops that get hit by a Fatigue-inflicting skill, the more stacks of Energized you will lose.
- Thief skills that can inflict the Fatigued effect include: Snail Hex, Quagmire, Chainlinked, Boulder Smash, and Slug Trail.
 <b>Thief Skills - Stage One</b>
1. Smoke Bomb: The thief drops a smoke bomb, briefly stunning nearby troops and causing all troops attacking or marching towards him to stop.
2. Snail Hex: The thief marks 1 nearby troop, reducing the troop's March Speed and inflicting the Fatigued effect on you.
3. Quagmire: Turns the area around the thief into a muddy quagmire for a period of time, reducing the March Speed of all troops caught in it. If one of your troops spends too long in the quagmire, you will be inflicted with the Fatigued effect.
 <b>Thief Skills - Stage Two</b>
1. Boulder Smash: The thief throws 2 boulders in random directions. There will be warning indicators showing you where the boulders will fall. Any troops hit by the boulders will be briefly stunned. If this skill hits one of your troops, you will be inflicted with the Fatigued effect.
2. Smokestep: The thief becomes temporarily invisible, during which time he cannot be targeted. While invisible, there is a chance the thief will start moving in the opposite direction.
3. Chainlinked: The thief marks a number of nearby troops. Warning indicators will appear around the marked troops. After a few moments, all troops within the warning indicators will be temporarily immobilized. If the thief manages to immobilize more than two troops with this skill, you will be inflicted with the Fatigued effect.
4. Slug Trail: Wherever the thief moves, he will leave behind a temporary trail of mud, reducing the March Speed of all troops caught in the mud trail. If one of your troops spends too long in the mud trail, you will be inflicted with the Fatigued effect.

<b><size=30>Team Draw</size></b>
<b><size=24>Event Rules</size></b>
1. Governors must take part in this event in teams of <color=#c88800>5</color>, featuring 1 team captain and 4 team members.
2. Governors may form teams in one of two ways: the captain can invite other governors to team up for the draw or fill the remaining slots with random governors; ordinary team members must find a team through the matchmaking process.
3. Captains must spend <color=#c88800>6 Imperial Scrolls</color> to join the event, and team members <color=#c88800>1</color>.
4. Each gacha round will involve a draw from a pool of <color=#c88800>10</color> cards with each governor choosing <color=#c88800>1</color> card. Once all governors have selected theirs, the <color=#c88800>5</color> remaining, unselected cards will be granted to the captain.
5. Governors must spend Imperial Scrolls to initiate the matchmaking process. If the matchmaking process fails to form a team after a certain length of time, then the team will be disbanded and any Scrolls spent returned.
6. The probabilities shown in the "Team Rewards List" reflect the chance for a team to obtain a certain reward in a single gacha event. <color=#c88800>However, each gacha round will offer a guaranteed reward of at least one "Legendary Commander Sculpture" or Legendary Commander.</color>
7. Any selections made during the gacha draw process cannot be changed. However, if you have drawn a Commander with Expertise, then this draw will be automatically exchanged for 1 Imperial Scroll.
8. Governors from different kingdoms may have access to different Commander Sculptures based on the current state of their kingdom during the teaming-up or matchmaking process, <color=#c88800>but the same probabilities apply across the board.</color>
9. At the end of the event, all unused Imperial Scrolls will be reclaimed as {p5} at a 1:1 ratio.

3. To complete the Trial of Kau Karuak for a given difficulty level, you must defeat <color=#379f1f>all levels</color> of the trial at that difficulty.

1. Before the trial begins, you can choose one of <color=#379f1f>five difficulties</color>.

 <b>Rewards</b>

<b><size=24>Event Rules</size></b>
1. Form a team of at least <color=#c88800>2</color> Governors, either by invitation or random matching, to participate in this event.
2. Spend <color=#c88800>1</color> Imperial Scroll to gain <color=#c88800>2</color> cards. You can choose how many Imperial Scrolls to spend each turn. Once your team has spent a total of <color=#c88800>5</color> Imperial Scrolls, you can begin the draw.
3. Each round will involve a draw from a pool of <color=#c88800>10</color> cards, with each Governor selecting <color=#c88800>1</color> card. Once all Governors have selected theirs, unselected cards will be randomly assigned according to how many Imperial Scrolls each Governor spent.
4. Governors must spend Imperial Scrolls to initiate the matchmaking process. If the matchmaking process fails to form a team after a certain length of time, then the team will be disbanded and any Scrolls spent returned. If the matchmaking process is taking too long, change the number of Scrolls you spend and try again.
5. <color=#c88800>The team will receive at least 1 Legendary Commander Sculpture or 1 Legendary Commander in each round</color>.
6. Any selections made during the draw process cannot be changed. However, if you draw a Commander or their Sculptures for whom you already have Expertise, it will be automatically exchanged for 1 Dazzling Starlight Sculpture.
7. Governors from different kingdoms may have access to different Commander Sculptures based on the current state of their kingdom during the teaming-up or matchmaking process, <color=#c88800>but the same probabilities apply across the board</color>.
8. At the end of the event, all unused Imperial Scrolls will be reclaimed as {p5} at a 1:1 ratio.q

Desert Conquest
Yi Sun-sin was a famous Korean military strategist, general, and hero. He was an expert in naval warfare who repelled the invading Japanese army on multiple occasions, pioneering the use of so-called "turtle ships".%
Gilgamesh reigned as fifth king of Uruk in Mesopotamia during the Ancient Sumerian period, around the 27th century BCE. His exploits are recorded in the "Epic of Gilgamesh", the earliest surviving work of literature, and he is revered within the Mesopotamian mythos as a seeker of immortality.
Xiang Yu was born in the state of Chu in the waning years of the Qin Dynasty. His grandfather, Xiang Yan, was a well-known general, politician, and military strategist. His military excellence is recognized in a Chinese saying: "throughout history, none were as brave as Xiang Yu."

<b><size=30>The Arena Begins</size></b>
A limited-time barbarian challenge.
<b><size=24>Event Rules</size></b>
1. Defeat as many barbarian troops as possible in a 5 minute period.
2. The higher the level of a barbarian troop, the more points and bonus time you get for defeating them. Bonus time extends your time limit (up to a total of 4 extra minutes).
3. You will get a reward based on your highest score at the end of the event (can only be claimed once).
4. You can challenge this event up to 3 times per day. Daily attempts will reset at midnight (00:00) UTC.
5. The system will rank Governors according to their highest score earned during the event. Governors will receive additional rank rewards at the end of the event.
6. In order to avoid event data errors, Governors will be unable to start a challenge during the last 15 minutes of the event.+

A new Chronicle is ready for Governors to write. At the same time, the Lost Kingdom "War of Conquest" achievement series and corresponding events are ready to begin!
<b>Kingdom Confrontations</b>
All kingdoms will gather in the Lost Kingdom to vie for total control. A contest to determine who is REALLY the strongest kingdom!
<b>Season Structure</b>
The Lost Kingdom opens in intervals called "seasons". Governors can only journey to the Lost Kingdom while a season is underway. Once the season ends, Governors will be returned to their home kingdoms. Different seasons will have different features and rules to give Governors a unique experience each time!
<b>Protecting Territory</b>
In the Lost Kingdom, cities within their own alliance territory cannot be attacked. Efficient and thorough battles will require careful planning.
<b>Pass Mechanism</b>
In the Lost Kingdom, kingdoms will start in a province with passes which can be "protected", "semi-protected" or "unsealed". Semi-protected passes can only be occupied by the kingdom which started in this province.

PROLOGUE
The Governor and Gilgamesh have arrived in Egypt in search of the secret to eternity. They have found a great many answers during their travels...
Words of Eternity
Prologue
Each of us has our own experiences, our own dreams to chase, our own definitions of eternity. Cleopatra's answer has not convinced Gilgamesh at all.
We have left the city and come to the countryside, in search of other answers. But the countryside is full of its own dangers.
We have said our farewells to Thutmose and continued on our journey. A vast land stretches before us, and a warm breeze blows through the trees like music.
Barbarians have surrounded us, seemingly mistaking us for ordinary travelers. They are not the friendliest of fellows.
We have gathered our thoughts and gone for a wander through the city where Imhotep lives, enjoying a well-earned break.
The cities along the river are rich in resources, and the people want for nothing. Life blooms in every corner.%
Barbarians defeated: <b>{p1}/{p2}</b>$
Resources gathered: <b>{p1}/{p2}</b>
We came to Cleopatra's palace, where she welcomed us, and we spoke of eternity.
Cleopatra's beauty and wisdom are praised by thousands. Is that not the secret to eternity? Such was her belief.
Gilgamesh and I left Cleopatra's palace. In the streets, the children played happily.
We spoke of what we had just experienced, and concluded that beauty is not the secret to eternity.
We encountered Thutmose and his army, ready to march off to war.
Thutmose believes that eternity lies in ambition and authority. He rules over a mighty nation. His quest for power will never cease.
We said farewell to Thutmose, and came to the banks of the Nile. Its vast span blocks our path.
Gilgamesh did not agree with Thutmose. He says that Thutmose has not even conquered all of this land, let alone achieved eternity.
I fainted from the heat, and woke up in a stranger's dwelling. By chance, Imhotep had come to our aid.
Hearing of the reason for our arrival, Imhotep spoke to us of the Book of the Dead. We decided that we would set out the next day to look upon the eternity that Imhotep spoke of.
We have come to the place where Imhotep gives lectures. From here, one may look upon the Great Pyramid.
As Imhotep sees it, man's life is brief, but to pass on the legacy of a civilization is to know eternity.d

ALLIANCE QUIZU
<b><size=30>The Trial of Kau Karuak</size></b>
<color=#997336>As we traveled through distant lands, we came upon old friends. The warriors of Karaku traveled many miles to find us, for they never forget a debt. When the riches of the Golden Kingdom attracted covetous invaders, we helped them hold the line. In return, they have brought us a bounty of resources. But tradition is tradition, and to lay claim to these riches, there is one last step...</color>
<color=#997336>We must pass the Trial of Kau Karuak.</color>
 <b>Overview</b>
Brave the trials and receive a boon from the Golden Kingdom.
 <b>Starting the Event</b>
1. From the event page, tap the <color=#379f1f>CHALLENGE</color> button to summon a troop of Karaku warriors (the trial target).
2. Summoning Karaku warriors costs <color=#379f1f>action points</color>.
 <b>How to Play</b>
1. After summoning the trial target, you can challenge them for a <color=#379f1f>limited time</color>.
2. If you fail to challenge or defeat the trial target within the time limit, the trial target will disappear and will need to be re-summoned.
3. To complete the Trial of Kau Karuak for a given difficulty level, you must defeat <color=#379f1f>all levels</color> of the trial at that difficulty.
 <b>Event Difficulty</b>
1. Before the trial begins, you can choose one of <color=#379f1f>five difficulties</color>.
2. You will unlock new difficulties as the <color=#379f1f>Lost Kingdom Chronicles</color> progress.
3. Once you have selected a difficulty, you must complete <color=#379f1f>all its trials</color> to advance to the next difficulty.
 <b>Rewards</b>
1. The higher the trial difficulty you selected, the better the rewards.
2. The more trial levels you've completed, the more Crystals you can earn each hour.
3. Every time you complete a trial, the reward will be sent to you by <color=#379f1f>mail</color>.
 <b>Important Notes</b>
1. You can only take on the trial alone. Other governors cannot provide assistance.
2. You can only store up to <color=#E06666>24 hours</color> of Crystal income at a time, so make sure you claim them regularly.
3. Each trial level has a <color=#E06666>maximum number of attacks</color> possible. One attack is spent every time you send a new troop to attack the trial target. Once you have used up all your attacks, you cannot send any new troops to attack the trial target.'

<b><size=30>Dhalruk's Puzzle Box</size></b>
The Mysterious Merchant is offering finely-crafted Mechanisms... rare treasure could be yours!
<b><size=24>Event Rules</size></b>
1. Spend <color=#EE7600>free tries</color> or <color=#EE7600>Mechanisms</color> during the event to open Puzzle Boxes. Each time you open a Puzzle Box, you gain the treasure it contains.
2. Each level contains a <color=#EE7600>Rare Treasure</color>. Open it to gain all of the remaining treasures on the map and move on to the next level.
3. Each Puzzle Box opened adds to your <color=#EE7600>Puzzle Progress</color>, which begins at 0.5% (you also have a chance of getting a critical success multiplier). When your Puzzle Progress reaches 100%, you can get access to Dhalruk's Private Collection, where you can choose an Ornate Chest and gain extra treasure. This will reset your Puzzle Progress to 0. Every time you access Dhalruk's Private Collection, the prize pool will be reset according to the displayed probability. When the event ends, <color=#EE7600>your Puzzle Progress will be retained</color> and kept for the next instance of the event.
4. There is a <color=#EE7600>use limit</color> for Mechanisms. Once you reach the limit, you cannot use any more Mechanisms to open Puzzle Boxes, but you can still use your free tries.
5. At the end of each event, <color=#EE7600>unused free tries will be reset to zero</color>, and remaining Puzzle Pieces will be saved in your inventory for use in the next instance of this event.
6. Your City Hall <color=#EE7600>must be at least Level 8</color> to participate in this event.

<b><size=30>Dhalruk's Puzzle Box</size></b>
 <color=#997336>The Mysterious Merchant has a strange contraption for sale... rare treasure could be yours!</color>
 <b>Overview</b>
Solve the mysterious puzzle boxes and earn rewards.
 <b>Requirements</b>
Your City Hall must be at least <color=#379f1f>level 8</color> to take part in this event. 
 <b>Starting the Event</b>
1. Tap the <color=#379f1f>OPEN</color> button on the event page to start opening the puzzle box.
2. To open puzzle box tiles, you must spend <color=#379f1f>free tries</color> or <color=#379f1f>Mechanisms</color>.
 <b>How to Play</b>
1. Dhalruk's Puzzle Box consists of several levels. You must open <color=#379f1f>all tiles</color> in a level to move onto the next level.
2. You can manually select which tiles you wish to open, or tap <color=#379f1f>AUTO</color>, which will use your remaining free tries and Mechanisms to open tiles automatically.
3. Each level contains a <color=#379f1f>Rare Treasure</color>. If you find the Rare Treasure, you can instantly open the rest of the level's tiles and move onto the next level.
 <b>Rewards</b>
1. Each time you open a tile, you will receive the treasure hidden beneath it.
2. You can earn even better rewards by opening chests from <color=#379f1f>Dhalruk's Private Collection</color>.
 <b>Puzzle Progress</b>
1. Every time you open a tile, it will increase your <color=#379f1f>puzzle progress</color>. Each tile is worth 0.5% puzzle progress. You also have a chance to crit whenever you open a tile, which will significantly increase your puzzle progress.
2. Whenever you hit 100% puzzle progress, you will get to pick a reward from Dhalruk's Private Collection and your puzzle progress will be reset to 0%.
3. Every time you pick a reward from Dhalruk's Private Collection, the prize pool will be reset based on the probabilities listed below. 
 <b>Important Notes</b>
1. At the end of the event, unused free tries will be <color=#E06666>lost</color>.
2. There is a <color=#E06666>limit</color> to how many Mechanisms you can use in each instance of this event. Once you reach this limit, you will not be able to use Mechanisms to open any more tiles.
3. At the end of the event, unused Mechanisms will be kept in your inventory, and can be used in the next instance of this event.
4. Your puzzle progress will not be reset at the end of the event, and will carry over to the next instance of this event..

 <b>Overview</b>
Work with your alliance to defend a merchant caravan from Barbarian Raiders until it reaches its destination.
 <b>Requirements</b>
You must be in an alliance to take part in this event.
 <b>Starting the Event</b>
1. From the event page, your alliance leader or officers can select a difficulty level and summon a caravan.
2. Summoning a caravan costs <color=#379f1f>Alliance Credits</color>.
3. There is a limit to how many caravans you can escort in each instance of this event. Successfully escorting a caravan will cost <color=#379f1f>1 escort chance</color>.
4. Your alliance leader or officers can choose to abandon an ongoing caravan escort at any time. Your alliance will not lose an escort chance if it quits midway through.
5. Each governor can only dispatch <color=#379f1f>1 troop</color> to escort the caravan.
 <b>How to Play</b>
1. Once summoned, the caravan will begin traveling to a random village on the map. Barbarian Raiders will attack the caravan along the way.
2. You will also encounter Barbarian Chieftains, who will stop the caravan from moving. You must defeat the Chieftain to continue.
3. Your escort will be successful once the caravan reaches its target village.
 <b>Event Difficulty and Points</b>
1. There are multiple difficulty levels for this event. To unlock a difficulty level, you must complete the previous difficulty level while fulfilling certain requirements.
2. You can earn individual points by attacking barbarians. The more damage you deal, the more points you'll earn.
3. You can also earn points over time by keeping your troop within a certain range of the caravan.
 <b>Rankings</b>
1. This event includes a <color=#379f1f>leaderboard</color>. Your alliance's ranking will be affected by the <color=#379f1f>difficulty</color> it chose.
2. For alliances that chose the same difficulty level, the rankings will be based on the final <color=#379f1f>condition</color> of their caravans.
 <b>Rewards</b>
1. The higher the <color=#379f1f>difficulty</color> you selected, the better your rewards will be for successfully escorting the caravan.
2. Your rewards will also be affected by the <color=#379f1f>condition</color> of the caravan when it arrives at its destination. The less damage it has taken, the better your rewards will be.
3. Rewards will be sent to all alliance members via mail at the end of the escort. Rank rewards will be sent at the end of the event.

Henry V (1386 - 1422) was a Lancastrian king of England. Though he reigned for a mere 9 years, he is remembered as a premier warrior-king. During his reign, the Hundred Years' War with France was rekindled. Taking advantage of his foe's internal divisions and allying with the Duke of Burgundy, Henry left England in firm control of the conflict.
Alexander Nevsky was a political and military leader and strategist of 13th century Russia. He not only protected his people from German and Swedish invaders, he also preserved Russia's independence from the unprecedented threat of the Mongol "Golden Horde" through skillful diplomacy.
Scipio Africanus was a Roman general and statesman, born to an esteemed noble family. His family had produced a number of Roman consuls, and he had seized Spain for the Roman Empire in his youth, driving out the Carthaginians.

<b><size=30>Shadow Legion Invasion</size></b> 
 <color=#997336>For the sake of our people, we must hold them back.</color>
 <b>Overview</b>
Defend your city from invading Shadow Legion troops.
 <b>Requirements</b>
1. You must be in an alliance to take part in this event.
2. Your alliance must have at least <color=#379f1f>30 members</color> to take part in this event.
 <b>Starting the Event</b>
1. Your alliance leader or officers can choose to activate this event at any time.
2. Each time this event occurs, your alliance can only activate it <color=#379f1f>1 time</color>.
3. Each governor can only send <color=#379f1f>1 troop</color> to attack the Shadow Legion.
 <b>How to Play</b>
1. During this event, a large number of <color=#379f1f>Dark Fortresses</color> will appear on the map.
2. Once the event has been activated, the Dark Fortresses will send out <color=#379f1f>Shadow Legion troops</color> to attack alliance member cities in the same province as the Dark Fortress. 
3. There will be a total of <color=#379f1f>25 waves</color> of attackers.
4. You will be eliminated from the event if your city is breached <color=#379f1f>2</color> times. Once you've been eliminated, the Shadow Legion will no longer attack your city.
5. To complete the event, you must survive all 25 waves <color=#379f1f>without being breached twice</color>.
6. The event will end if all alliance members have been eliminated. 
 <b>Event Difficulty and Points</b>
1. Before activating the event, your alliance leader or officers can select a difficulty level from the event page. 
2. To unlock a new difficulty level, your alliance must complete the previous difficulty level with at least <color=#379f1f>15</color> surviving alliance members. Your alliance will be able to select the new difficulty level in the next instance of the event.
3. Defeating Shadow Legion troops will earn you individual points and alliance points. 
 <b>About the Shadow Legion</b>
1. The Shadow Legion's troops each have their own unique skills.
2. Peace Shields <color=#379f1f>will not protect you</color> from the Shadow Legion's troops. 
3. Every <color=#379f1f>5 waves</color>, the Shadow Legion will dispatch <color=#379f1f>elite troops</color>. Defeat them for a chance to earn additional items. 
 <b>Rewards</b>
1. You can unlock new reward tiers by reaching certain individual and alliance point milestones.
2. You will only receive the <color=#379f1f>highest tier</color> of rewards you have unlocked.
3. Rewards will be sent by mail after the event ends. 
 <b>Important Notes</b>
1. Teleporting your city while the event is active will count as <color=#E06666>1 breach</color>.
2. If you leave your alliance during the event, your individual points will be <color=#E06666>reset to zero</color>.

<b><size=30>Protect The Supplies</size></b>
 <color=#997336>The road ahead is difficult. Take great care.</color>
 <b>Overview</b>
Defend a merchant caravan from Barbarian Raiders until it reaches its destination.
 <b>Starting the Event</b>
1. Tap the <color=#379f1f>CONFIRM</color> button on the event page to summon a merchant caravan on the map.
2. It costs 50 action points to summon a caravan.
 <b>How to Play</b>
1. Once summoned, the caravan will begin traveling to a random village on the map. Barbarian Raiders will attack the caravan along the way.
2. To win, you must keep the caravan alive until it reaches its destination.
 <b>Event Difficulty and Points</b>
1. Before summoning a caravan, you can add special <color=#379f1f>challenges</color> to the event to increase its difficulty and rewards.
2. You can control the difficulty of each challenge by adjusting its <color=#379f1f>star level</color>. Drag the sliders on the main event page to adjust the star level and view a detailed description of each challenge.
3. At the start of the event, the highest star level you can select will depend on your power. You can unlock a higher star level for a challenge by completing the challenge at the previous star level.
4. Your <color=#379f1f>total star level</color> is the sum of the star levels you have chosen for each challenge. The higher your total star level, the harder the event will be.
5. You can attempt this event multiple times. Only your best result will be recorded.
 <b>Legend Mode</b>
1. When your kingdom enters the <color=#379f1f>offseason before Season 2</color>, you will be able to unlock the extra-difficult Legend Mode for this event.
2. To unlock Legend Mode, you must successfully escort a caravan with every challenge at max star level.
 <b>Rewards</b>
You can claim rewards from the Quests page by successfully escorting a caravan with a certain total star level.
 <b>Important Notes</b>
If you fail to escort the caravan, it will still cost you one of your attempts, and your action points <color=#E06666>will not be refunded</color>.

<b>Individual</b>
1. To take part in this event, you must have joined your current alliance and reached City Hall level {p3} before your alliance signed up for the event.
2. Each governor can only be selected to participate in the current event by <b>1 alliance</b>.4
1. For this event, your alliance will be randomly grouped with others in its league.
2. During the competition, your alliance's participating members can accept event quests for the alliance. They can complete the quests to receive points.
3. Your alliance can have up to {p1} quests at a time, and each participant <b>can only accept 1 quest at a time</b>. During the competition, each participant will have up to <b>10</b> free quest attempts (required to accept a quest) and can purchase <b>1</b> more with Gems.
4. When your alliance's total points reach certain thresholds, its event level will be increased. During the <b>rewards phase</b>, you can choose level rewards to receive based on your alliance's <b>event level</b>.
5. After the competition, your alliance will be ranked within its group by total points.h
1. You can only accept quests, increase quest progress, and claim alliance level rewards in the <b>alliance that signed you up for the event</b>.
2. Only your alliance leader or officers participating in the event can <b>refresh unaccepted quests</b>.
3. After accepting a quest, you must complete it within the time limit for it to be considered <b>successful</b>.
4. If you are unable to complete a quest within the time limit or manually give it up, you will fail the quest and it will be returned to the quest list. Your quest attempt will be refunded and other alliance members will be able to accept the quest.
5. If left unsubmitted, completed quests will be automatically submitted after {p1} minutes.
6. After each alliance quest, whether it's completed, refreshed by your alliance leader/officers, or failed, you will need to <b>wait 5 minutes</b> for a new one.

The number of alliances promoted or relegated in each group <b>depends on the league</b>. See below for more details.
3. Please note that if your alliance has a total score of 0 at the end of the competition, you will immediately be relegated to a lower league.
4. The higher your alliance's league, the more difficult the quests will be, and the more points you will earn for completing them. In addition, your alliance's event level cap will be increased in higher leagues. See below for more details.b

3. The higher your alliance's league and the older your kingdom is, the better the rewards for each level.

<b><size=30>Event Rules</size></b> 
1. Team immigration is only open to returning governors. To help you migrate to kingdoms in the offseason, the number of Passport Pages needed to immigrate will be reduced.
2. You can only activate the team immigration feature for 1 character on your account. After successfully immigrating through team immigration, you will need to wait some time before using team immigration again. This will not affect the cooldown time for other types of immigration.
3. You can create or join an immigration team. Only the team captain can select which kingdom to immigrate to and send out applications. After the target kingdom's king approves your application, all members of your team will be eligible to immigrate there. To facilitate immigration team creation/recruitment, we have added a new Team Immigration chat channel.
4. There is no minimum member requirement for a team. You can create a one-person team if you wish. We recommend contacting the king of your target kingdom in advance via mail.
5. Only kingdoms in the offseason are open to team immigration. Imperium Kingdoms are not open to team immigration at the moment.
6. Incomplete returning player quests and unclaimed returning player rewards will carry over to the new kingdom.
7. If you immigrate via this event, you will appear in a random province within the target kingdom. You cannot choose a specific province to immigrate to.

Wish Upon a Cloud
<b><size=30>Wish Upon a Cloud</size></b> 
<size=24>Let the spring breeze carry your wishes up high.</size>
<b><size=24>Event Rules</size></b>
1. During this event, you have a chance of finding <color=#EE7600>Silk Ribbons</color> when collecting resources in your city, gathering resources on the map, or defeating barbarians. <color=#EE7600>Silk Ribbons</color> will be sent to you via mail.
2. You can earn chest points by using <color=#EE7600>Silk Ribbons</color> or purchasing <color=#EE7600>Wish Plaques</color> with Gems. Once you have enough chest points, all members of your alliance that have at least <b>50</b> contribution points will get a chance to open a chest. You can open up to 10 chests during this event.
3. On the event page, you can use one <color=#EE7600>Silk Ribbon</color> to gain one <color=#EE7600>Kite Reel</color>, or spend 50 Gems for one <color=#EE7600>Wish Plaque</color>. After you have opened the maximum number of chests, you can continue to acquire these items, but you will not earn any more chest points.
4. Up until the last day of the event, <color=#EE7600>Silk Ribbons</color> can be found when defeating barbarians on the map, collecting resources in your city, or gathering resources on the map. You will be unable to obtain Silk Ribbons this way on the last day of the event.
5. <color=#EE7600>Silk Ribbons</color> and <color=#EE7600>Kite Reels</color> can be exchanged for rewards, including <color=#EE7600>Spring Once More City Theme Choice Vouchers</color>.
6. When using a Silk Ribbon or spending Gems, you have a chance to earn extra chest points.
7. The contribution rankings for this event will rank all members of your alliance by their contribution points.
8. There will be a short delay between the end of the event and the final calculation/sending of alliance rank rewards via mail. To avoid any unintentional losses, please refrain from leaving your alliance right after the event ends.0

Governor, you must meet the following requirements to immigrate to this kingdom:
1. Your City Hall is <color=#ffa800>Level 16 or higher</color>.
2. You have sufficient <color=#ffa800>Passport Pages</color>. The number of Passport Pages required is determined by your power level.
3. All your march queues are idle.
4. Neither your city nor your troops are in battle.
5. You are not part of an alliance.
6. The number of resources you possess does not exceed the protection capacity of your storehouse.
7. After successfully immigrating through team immigration, you will need to wait some time before using team immigration again. This will not affect the cooldown time for other types of immigration.
8. Immigrating may reset your current event points for certain events.
If your immigration request is successful, the game will automatically restart and your city will reappear at a random location in the selected province.

<b><size=22>Team Immigration Rules</size></b>
Kingdoms can now receive teams of returning players through the team immigration feature.
1. Only the king of a kingdom can approve team immigration applications. After approving a team's application, its members will receive a confirmation message via mail. Team immigration applications are valid for 3 days. If not approved in time, they will be automatically rejected.
2. In addition to receiving the king's approval, an immigration team's members must meet all other requirements for immigrating to a kingdom.
3. After approving a team's application, the king of the target kingdom will still be able to revoke a team's immigration eligibility so long as no members of the team have finished immigrating. Once a single member of the team finishes immigrating, the team's eligibility can no longer be revoked.
4. Only "returning players" have access to team immigration. Team immigration will not count towards a kingdom's normal/special immigration quota.d

Siege of Orl
ansi
Jan 
ka was a famous Bohemian military commander, innovator, and a national hero of Czechia. In his early years, 
ka lived as an outlaw and mercenary, fighting only for his own profit. His life was changed, however, after hearing a sermon from the theologian and reformer Jan Hus. He would go on to serve as a defender of Hus and a leader of his armies.
Joan of Arc, or Jeanne d'Arc, was a famous French commander during the Hundred Years' War. Though a mere 17 years old, she led French forces to a remarkable victory at the Siege of Orl
ans. Her resilience and defiance of both class and gender roles have inspired countless writers and artists, immortalizing her as one of the most important cultural icons of both France and Western Europe as a whole.I
Flavius Aetius was a Roman general and consul who led Rome's armies to victory against the Huns, Franks, Burgundians, and Goths, earning him the nickname the "Last of the Romans". Though he managed to secure relative peace for the people of the declining Western Roman Empire, even he was unable to prevent its eventual collapse.*
Welcome, Governor, to "Season of Conquest: Siege of Orl
ans". Here, you will play the role of a French warrior, battling to retake the land conquered by the English Army. If you manage to capture the city of Orl
ans herself, you will be able to try out the newly-added Siege of Orl
ans campaign.
Warriors Unbound
Bertrand du Guesclin was a famous Breton commander on the French side of the Hundred Years' War. During the Breton War of Succession from 1341 to 1364, while still a young man, du Guesclin led a punishing guerrilla campaign against the English forces and their allies.&
Tariq ibn Ziyad was a renowned Umayyad commander, known for conquering much of Hispania from the Visigoths and leading Umayyad forces to victory at the Battle of Guadalete. Gibraltar is named after him, being the Spanish transliteration of the Arabic "Jabal Tariq", meaning "mountain of Tariq".
Amanitore was a Nubian queen regnant (or "Kandake" to the Greeks and Romans of that era) of the Kingdom of Kush during the Meroitic Period. Amanitore most likely began her reign around 1 BCE.
Welcome, Governor, to "Season of Conquest: Warriors Unbound". In this Season, you will be able to unlock a new type of legendary equipment called "artifacts". These artifacts will provide powerful bonuses when equipped to a troop's secondary commander.
