<b><size=30>Shadow Legion Invasion</size></b> 
 <color=#997336>For the sake of our people, we must hold them back.</color>
 <b>Overview</b>
Defend your city from invading Shadow Legion troops.
 <b>Requirements</b>
1. You must be in an alliance to take part in this event.
2. Your alliance must have at least <color=#379f1f>30 members</color> to take part in this event.
 <b>Starting the Event</b>
1. Your alliance leader or officers can choose to activate this event at any time.
2. Each time this event occurs, your alliance can only activate it <color=#379f1f>1 time</color>.
3. Other than garrisons, each governor can only send <color=#379f1f>1 troop</color> to attack the Shadow Legion.
 <b>How to Play</b>
1. During this event, a large number of <color=#379f1f>Dark Fortresses</color> will appear on the map.
2. Once the event has been activated, the Dark Fortresses will send out <color=#379f1f>Shadow Legion troops</color> to attack alliance member cities in the same province as the Dark Fortress. 
3. There will be a total of <color=#379f1f>25 waves</color> of attackers.
4. You will be eliminated from the event if your city is breached <color=#379f1f>2</color> times. Once you've been eliminated, the Shadow Legion will no longer attack your city.
5. To complete the event, you must survive all 25 waves <color=#379f1f>without being breached twice</color>.
6. The event will end if all alliance members have been eliminated. 
 <b>Event Difficulty and Points</b>
1. Before activating the event, your alliance leader or officers can select a difficulty level from the event page. 
2. To unlock a new difficulty level, your alliance must complete the previous difficulty level with at least <color=#379f1f>15</color> surviving alliance members. Your alliance will be able to select the new difficulty level in the next instance of the event.
3. Defeating Shadow Legion troops will earn you individual points and alliance points. 
 <b>About the Shadow Legion</b>
1. The Shadow Legion's troops each have their own unique skills.
2. Peace Shields <color=#379f1f>will not protect you</color> from the Shadow Legion's troops. 
3. Shadow Legion troops will gain a March Speed buff if they travel for more than 5 minutes after exiting combat. They will lose this buff if they are attacked.
4. Every <color=#379f1f>5 waves</color>, the Shadow Legion will dispatch <color=#379f1f>elite troops</color>. Defeat them for a chance to earn additional items. 
 <b>Rewards</b>
1. You can unlock new reward tiers by reaching certain individual and alliance point milestones.
2. You will only receive the <color=#379f1f>highest tier</color> of rewards you have unlocked.
3. Rewards will be sent by mail after the event ends. 
 <b>Important Notes</b>
1. If this event is activated in the Lost Kingdom, it cannot be activated again in your original kingdom. Likewise, if you activate this event in your original kingdom, it cannot be activated again in the Lost Kingdom.
2. Teleporting your city while the event is active will count as <color=#E06666>1 breach</color>.
3. If you leave your alliance during the event, your individual points will be <color=#E06666>reset to zero</color>.

<b><size=30>Event Rules</size></b> 
1. Team immigration is only open to returning governors. To help you immigrate to kingdoms in the offseason, the number of Passport Pages needed to immigrate will be reduced.
2. You can only activate the team immigration feature for 1 character on your account. After successfully immigrating through team immigration, you will need to wait some time before using team immigration again. This will not affect the cooldown time for other types of immigration.
3. You can either join or create an immigration team. To help you find a team or recruit for your team, you've been added to an exclusive returning player chat channel.
4. If any member of your team exceeds the <b>team immigration power cap</b> for your target kingdom, your team captain will need to submit an immigration application. If the kingdom's king approves, you'll be eligible to immigrate to the kingdom. If all your team members are below your target kingdom's <b>team immigration power cap</b>, you'll instantly receive eligibility once your team captain submits an immigration application.
5. There is no minimum member requirement for an immigration team. You can create a one-person team if you wish. We recommend contacting the king of your target kingdom in advance via mail.
6. Only kingdoms in the offseason are open to team immigration. Imperium Kingdoms are not open to team immigration at the moment.
7. Incomplete returning player quests and unclaimed returning player rewards will carry over to the new kingdom.
8. If you immigrate through this event, you will appear within a random province of the target kingdom (you cannot choose a specific province).

Unlocking New Stages
1. This event has 3 stages. A new stage will be unlocked every day.
2. To unlock a stage, your alliance must complete all previous stages.
Participation Requirementsl
After an alliance officer starts a stage, all alliance members can dispatch one troop to escort the caravan.
Difficulty Modifiers
Your alliance officers can choose to add skills to the enemies in this event, increasing the difficulty of the escort. The higher the difficulty, the better your rewards will be for completing the escort.
Earning Pointsu
1. Alliance points earned will depend on number and type of enemies defeated, the time it took you to escort the wagon, and the difficulty modifiers you chose.
2. You can earn individual points in two ways:
1) By sticking close to the wagon (not affected by difficulty or escort time).
2) Defeating or helping to defeat enemies (calculated the same way as alliance points).
Rewards
1. Rewards are divided into 6 tiers. You will unlock higher reward tiers depending on your alliance's high score.
2. There are 4 rewards in each tier. The higher your wagon's remaining health when you complete a stage, the more rewards you can claim.
3. To claim each tier's rewards, you must also earn a certain number of individual points. The individual point requirements for each tier are {p1}, {p2}, {p3}, {p4}, {p5}, and {p6}. Rewards will be automatically sent to you via mail once you meet the requirements.

<b>Pilferer Pursuit</b>: When defeating barbarians on the map, a fleeing burglar may appear. Catch and defeat him to win.
<b>Timed Tussle</b>: When defeating barbarians on the map, elite enemies may appear. Defeat them all within the time limit to win.
<b>Luck or Schmuck</b>: When defeating barbarians on the map, an endless wave of barbarians may attack you. Defeat as many enemies as possible within the time limit to win.
<b>Roadside Assistance</b>: When defeating barbarians on the map, you may come across a damaged caravan. Protect the caravan from incoming enemies to win.
When defeating barbarians on the map, you may run into a fleeing burglar. He will remain on the map for {p1} minutes. Attack him to start the Pilferer Pursuit incursion.
In this incursion, you can send any number of troops to attack the burglar. Damaging the burglar will earn you Gold and increase your final reward level. If you abandon the incursion midway, you will lose all Gold you have earned. At the end of the countdown, you'll receive a reward based on your final reward level.
Potential Rewards:
When defeating barbarians on the map, you may run into a group of elite enemies. They will remain on the map for {p1} minutes. Attack them to start the Timed Tussle incursion.
In this incursion, you can dispatch any number of troops to attack the elite enemies. If you defeat them all within the time limit, you will earn an advanced reward, otherwise you will earn a basic reward.
Potential Rewards:
When defeating barbarians on the map, you may find a cache of abandoned barbarian supplies. They will remain on the map for {p1} minutes. Interact with them to start the Luck or Schmuck incursion.
In this incursion, you will be attacked by an endless wave of enemies. Defeating enemies will earn you points and increase their furor, which will cause more powerful enemies to spawn. At the end of the countdown, you will receive a reward based on your score.
Potential Rewards:
When defeating barbarians on the map, you may come across a damaged Commerce Council caravan. It will remain on the map for {p1} minutes. Interact with it to start the Roadside Assistance incursion.
In this incursion, enemies will attack the caravan, and will steal its cargo if they deal damage to it. The incursion will end after you've defeated all enemies or lost all the cargo. You'll receive a reward based on the caravan's remaining cargo.

Equipment System Update
Greetings Governor,
Good tidings! Mysterious new equipment is coming to RoK!
1. The new equipment is all <b>legendary quality</b>. It includes <b>level 50</b> helms, chests, gloves, legs, and boots (for cavalry, infantry, and archers), as well as <b>level 55</b> weapons (for cavalry, infantry, and archers).
a. The new helms, chests, gloves, legs, and boots will have set effects (i.e. equip 2 or 4 items from the set for added bonuses).
b. The new weapons will not have set effects.
2. The materials required to forge the new equipment will be the same as the materials required to forge level 45 equipment of the same unit type and equipment slot.
3. The new level 50 equipment can be used in <b>all Seasons</b>. The new level 55 equipment can only be used in the <b>Season of Conquest</b>.
4. Forging and refining the new equipment will work the same as other equipment.
The new equipment will be added to the game gradually, and relevant events will be adjusted as the new equipment is added. The specific plan is as follows:
1. Version 1.0.75 (scheduled for early October 2023):
1) The rules for dismantling legendary equipment will be optimized.
When dismantling a piece of legendary equipment, the higher its refinement level, the more materials will be refunded (still 50% at refinement level 0). You'll be able to view the specific rules via the Blacksmith page after this version goes live. If you dismantle a piece of legendary equipment that has a special talent or is above refinement level 0 before the new rules take effect, you will be compensated for the difference later.
2) The "equipment preview" feature will be added to the Blacksmith.
3) New <b>level 50</b> equipment content in this version:
a. A new type of chest will be added to the rewards of the Ceroli Crisis, Ian's Ballads, and Golden Kingdom events. When opening these chests you will have a chance to find Blueprint Fragment Choice Chests for the new equipment.
b. Blueprint Fragments for the <b>gloves and chests</b> can be earned by taking part in the Holy Knight's Treasure and Hunt for History events, or by opening Blueprint Fragment Choice Chests.
4) New <b>level 55</b> equipment content in this version:
Once Version 1.0.75 goes live, you will be able to preview blueprints for the new <b>weapons</b> in the Combat Shop of the ongoing Season of Conquest. You will later be able to purchase these blueprints with Conquest Coins.
5) The schedule for the Holy Knight's Treasure and Hunt for History events will be unified across all kingdoms that have unlocked those events.
6) The Arms & Armor event will begin the day after this update goes live. By taking part in this event, you'll have a chance to earn <b>Iconic Crystals</b> and other valuable rewards.
2. November 1st 2023 update:
Starting from this update, 2 new Crusader Achievements will be added to Season of Conquest Lost Kingdoms. By completing these Crusader Achievements, you'll earn <b>Conquest Coins</b> and other valuable rewards.
3. December 4th 2023 update:
1) In the VIP Shop, the cavalry, infantry, and archer Random Blueprint Fragment Chests will be replaced with new ones. When opening these chests you will have a chance to receive a level 50 blueprint fragment.
2) New <b>level 50</b> equipment content in this version:
a. After this update, the following equipment blueprints will be removed from the Season of Conquest's Combat Shop: <b>Sacred Dominion</b>, <b>Hammer of the Sun and Moon</b>, <b>The Hydra's Blast</b>, <b>Pride of the Khan</b>, <b>Helm of the Conqueror</b>, and <b>Ancestral Mask of Night</b>.
b. Blueprint fragments for <b>Sacred Dominion</b>, <b>Hammer of the Sun and Moon</b>, <b>The Hydra's Blast</b>, <b>Pride of the Khan</b>, <b>Helm of the Conqueror</b>, <b>Ancestral Mask of Night</b>, and the <b>new helms</b> can be earned by taking part in the Holy Knight's Treasure and Hunt for History events, or by opening the new Blueprint Fragment Choice Chests.
c. The above equipment can be used in any Season.
3) New <b>level 55</b> equipment content in this version:
In this version, you will be able to purchase blueprints for the new <b>weapons</b> in the Season of Conquest Combat Shop. You can purchase up to 3 copies of each blueprint per Season.
In addition, blueprint fragments for the new <b>level 50 legs and boots</b> will be added in a future update to the Holy Knight's Treasure event, Hunt for History event, and new Blueprint Fragment Choice Chests. Stay tuned for more info.
Thank you for supporting Rise of Kingdoms. We hope you enjoy the game!

<b><size=30>Qin Treasure Troves</size></b> 
<b><size=24>Event Rules</size></b> 
1. Collect a complete set of 7 different Treasure Map Fragments to combine them into a Treasure Map, which will reveal a location with "Strange Markings".

4. The hunt will begin as soon as you combine a map. If you have searched for the treasure for over 8 hours without finding it, your treasure hunt will fail, and the corresponding map and treasure will be lost.

<b><size=24>Event Rules</size></b>
1. During this event, you have a chance of finding <color=#EE7600>Creepy Candy</color> when collecting resources in your city, gathering resources on the map, or defeating barbarians. <color=#EE7600>Creepy Candy</color> will be sent to you via mail.
2. You can use <color=#EE7600>Creepy Candy</color> or spend Gems to buy <color=#EE7600>Witch Hats</color> to increase your alliance's chest points. Once your alliance reaches max chest points, all members who contributed at least <b>50</b> chest points will be able to open a chest. You can open a maximum of 10 chests during this event.
3. On the event page, you can use one <color=#EE7600>Creepy Candy</color> to gain one <color=#EE7600>Jack-O'-Lantern</color>, or spend 50 Gems for one <color=#EE7600>Witch Hat</color>. After you have opened the maximum number of chests, you can continue to acquire these items, but you will not earn any more chest points.
4. Up until the last day of the event, <color=#EE7600>Creepy Candy</color> can be found when defeating barbarians on the map, collecting resources in your city, or gathering resources on the map. You will be unable to obtain Creepy Candy this way on the last day of the event.
5. <color=#EE7600>Jack-O'-Lanterns</color> and <color=#EE7600>Witch Hats</color> can be exchanged for rewards, including <color=#EE7600>Halloween City Theme Vouchers</color>.
6. Whenever you use a Creepy Candy or spend Gems, you have a chance to Crit, earning you extra chest points.
7. The contribution rankings for this event will rank all members of your alliance by their contribution points.
8. There will be a short delay between the end of the event and the final calculation/mailing of alliance rank rewards. To avoid any unintentional losses, please refrain from leaving your alliance right after the event ends.C

Redeeming Rewards
Battle Rewards>
1. This event is divided into the registration, battle, and rewards phases.
2. At the end of the registration phase, alliances will be matched based on the <b>total strength of all their combatants' defensive lineups</b>.
3. During the battle phase, if you've been selected as one of your alliance's combatants, you'll need to attack the enemy's encampments and capture their Banners to <b>earn points for your alliance.</b>
4. At the end of the battle phase, the alliance with the most points will win, and rewards for the Canyon Clash will be sent out to all participants.
<b>Alliance</b>
1. When the registration phase begins, your alliance leader or titled officers will be able to register your alliance for the upcoming Clash. They'll also be asked to select a list of combatants. They can edit this list at any time before the registration phase ends.
2. Your alliance must select <b>at least {p1} members</b> to serve as combatants. The max number of combatants you can select is equal to your alliance's current member limit, meaning you can <b>select all current members of your alliance</b> if you so wish.
3. At the end of the registration phase, the system will automatically remove all combatants who have not set up a defensive lineup and generate a <b>final combatant list</b>. If your alliance ends up with fewer than {p1} combatants, you will not be able to take part in the Clash.
4. In the last 30 minutes of the registration phase, the final combatant list will be locked, but combatants will still be able to edit their defensive lineups.
<b>Individual</b>
1. Only governors with a level {p2}+ City Hall can be selected as combatants.
2. You can <b>only serve as a combatant for 1 alliance</b> in each Clash. In addition, you can only serve as a combatant for an alliance in your current kingdom.
1. The first time you log in after the start of the event, or after your alliance adds you to its combatant list, your defensive lineup will automatically be set as your defensive lineup from the last time you took part in this event. If this is your first time taking part in the event, your defensive lineup will be set as your most recent Sunset Canyon lineup.
2. If you've been selected as a combatant, you can edit your defensive lineup at any time during the registration phase. After the registration phase ends, you will no longer be able to edit your defensive lineup.
3. You can assign up to 5 troops to your defensive lineup. In this event, you'll use units provided by the system instead of your own units. <b>The tier of each unit will be the highest tier you've researched in the Academy for the unit's type</b>.
4. You must place your troops in one of 8 squares. Each troop will first attack the front-row targets directly in front of them, followed by the back-row targets directly in front of them. If there are no targets directly in front, the troop will attack the closest target.
5. In the battle phase, <b>the only buffs that will take effect are buffs from commander levels, talents, equipment, Museum Relics, formations, armaments, VIP levels, buildings, technologies, civilization bonuses, city themes, and alliance technologies</b>. Note: Your defensive lineup's buffs will be based on the buffs you had the last time you saved your defensive lineup.i
1. During the battle phase, every combatant will have <b>3 chances</b> to attack enemy encampments.
2. The first time you launch an attack, you will need to set an offensive lineup. The rules for setting up an offensive lineup and the buffs they'll benefit from are the same as defensive lineups.
3. Every combatant will begin with {p1} Banners, divided into {p2} Glory Banners (yellow), {p3} Wisdom Banners (purple), and {p4} Valor Banners (blue).
4. Capturing an enemy Banner will <b>earn points for your alliance</b>. Capturing Banners will not increase your number of remaining Banners. Capturing a Glory Banner (yellow) is worth <b>{p5} points</b>, Wisdom Banners (purple) are worth <b>{p6} points</b>, and Valor Banners (blue) are worth <b>{p7} points</b>. The alliance with the most points at the end of the battle phase will be the victor.
5. When attacking an enemy, you will be given <b>3 requirements</b> for capturing the enemy's Banners. For each requirement you fulfill during the battle, you will capture 1 of the enemy's Banners. When capturing enemy Banners, you will <b>prioritize the most valuable Banners</b>.
Of the 3 requirements, <b>2 will always be the same and 1 will be unique to the current Clash</b>. The requirements for this Clash are:
Requirement 1: {p1}
Requirement 2: {p2}
Requirement 3: {p3}~
1. Alliances will be matched based on the total strength and number of their combatants.
2. If two matched alliances have a different number of combatants, the <b>lower number will be used as the maximum number of "full combatants" each alliance can field</b>. For the alliance with more combatants, any excess combatants over this limit will be turned into <b>reserve combatants</b>, starting with the combatants with the lowest defender rank.
3. Reserve combatants will not have an encampment in their alliance's battlegrounds (meaning they can't be attacked). They can still attack up to 3 times, but they cannot capture enemy Banners.
1. Whether you're a full combatant or a reserve combatant, you can earn <b>Clash Coins</b> by completing event quests. You can exchange your Clash Coins for rewards in the <b>event shop</b>.
2. You will not lose your leftover Clash Coins at the end of the event, and can use them in the next Clash.

Storyy
Since time immemorial, the Sunset Canyon has served as the shining shield of Egria, the first line of defense against any invader. Its rugged terrain makes it easy to defend and a nightmare to attack, and as the only land crossing into the continent, it allowed the barbarians who once controlled it free rein to dominate the land.
Those barbarians have since been vanquished by the armies of law and order, yet in their wake no one faction or monarch has been able to claim true dominion over the Canyon. How could such a precious asset be left without a ruler for so long?
Littered across the Sunset Canyon are the bleached bones and burnt banners of those who have tried to conquer it. Yet from beyond the horizon, the roar of trumpets cut through the deathly silence as two new challengers come to stake their claims. A land this valuable will only brook one master; who shall it be?(

TUTORIAL
<b>BANNERS</b>G
- After being selected as a combatant, you must set up a <b>defensive lineup</b> before the battle phase begins. Your defensive lineup will serve to defend your encampment from those trying to take your Banners.
- Every combatant will be given <b>{p1} Banners</b> to defend, divided into {p2} Glory Banners (yellow), {p3} Wisdom Banners (purple), and {p4} Valor Banners (blue). Capturing enemy Glory Banners will earn you the most points, while Valor Banners are worth the least.
- You can select a combatant's encampment to see how many Banners they have left, updated in real-time.
<b>CAPTURING BANNERS</b>d
- During the battle phase, you can attack enemy encampments to capture their Banners. You can capture 1 Banner for every requirement you meet during the attack.
- The requirements for capturing Banners will differ in each Clash. For the current Clash, the 3 requirements are:
<b>Requirement 1: {p1}</b>
<b>Requirement 2: {p2}</b>
<b>Requirement 3: {p3}</b>
<b>DEFENDER RANK</b>
- All your alliance's combatants will be ranked by the power of their defensive lineups. Every combatant's "defender rank" will be displayed below their encampment.
<b>RECOMMENDED TARGETS</b>
- Because you have limited chances to attack, the system will provide you with a recommended target to attack based on your defender rank.
<b>VICTORY CONDITIONS</b>
- Every time one of your alliance's combatants captures a Banner, your alliance will earn a number of <b>alliance points</b>, depending on the Banner. Glory Banners are worth {p1} points, Wisdom Banners are worth {p2}, and Valor Banners are worth {p3}.
- When capturing enemy Banners, you will prioritize the most valuable Banners.
- At the end of the battle phase, the winner will be the alliance with the most points.

FISHERMAN'S FORTUNE
Catch all sorts of aquatic creatures and exchange them for rare rewards. Rewards are limited, and are first come, first served.
<b><size=30>Fisherman's Fortune</size></b>
 <color=#997336>Break out your tackle box, it's time to get fishing! Take part in the Fisherman's Fortune event to reel in all kinds of fabulous rewards!</color>
 <color=#997336>Don't take too long! Fishing Spots are limited, and rewards are first come, first served. Don't let some other angler hook what should be yours!</color>
 <b>Overview</b>
Test your fishing skills and earn a fortune!
 <b>Requirements</b>
Your City Hall must be at least level <color=#379f1f>8</color> to participate in this event. 
 <b>Starting the Event</b>
1. Tap the green "+" on the event page to get <color=#379f1f>Bait</color>.
2. Use Bait to catch fish.
 <b>How to Play</b>
1. Choose one of the available <color=#379f1f>Fishing Spots</color> to start fishing.
2. Fishing Spots are shared between multiple kingdoms. Multiple governors can fish from the same spot <color=#379f1f>at the same time</color>.
3. There are two ways to fish: angling and netting. These methods require different amounts of Bait.
4. Different catches have different rarities. <color=#379f1f>Mussels</color> cannot be caught directly. They will instead be awarded to the governor that catches the last fish at a Fishing Spot.
 <b>Rewards</b>
1. Catches can be exchanged for <color=#379f1f>Sea Shillings</color> in the <color=#379f1f>Catch Bag</color>.
2. Sea Shillings can be exchanged for various rewards in the <color=#379f1f>Fish Market</color>.
3. The goods offered at the Fish Market will vary depending on your kingdom's current Season.
 <b>Fishing Spot Generation</b>
1. At the start of the event, a number of Fishing Spots will be generated based on your kingdom group's level of activity. As such, the number of Fishing Spots generated may not be the same for different kingdom groups.
2. Every 8 hours, new Fishing Spots will be generated for your kingdom group based on how many fish are left in your current Fishing Spots.
3. If there are less than 8 hours left in the event, no new Fishing Spots will be generated.
 <b>Important Notes</b>
At the end of the event, your unused Bait, Sea Shillings, and fish will NOT be lost, and can be used in the next Fisherman's Fortune event. Your fish will not be visible in your inventory.

<size=24>The birds of the forests awake at daybreak, singing the song of a new spring.</size>
<b><size=24>Event Rules</size></b>
1. During this event, you have a chance of finding <color=#EE7600>Easter Candy</color> when collecting resources in your city, gathering resources on the map, or defeating barbarians. <color=#EE7600>Easter Candy</color> will be sent to you via mail.
2. You can use <color=#EE7600>Easter Candy</color> or buy <color=#EE7600>Straw Bonnets</color> with Gems to increase your alliance's chest points. Once your alliance reaches max chest points, all members who contributed at least <b>50</b> chest points will be able to open a chest. You can open a maximum of 10 chests during this event.
3. On the event page, you can use one <color=#EE7600>Easter Candy</color> to gain one <color=#EE7600>Easter Egg</color>, or spend 50 Gems to buy one <color=#EE7600>Straw Bonnet</color>. After you have opened the maximum number of chests, you can continue to acquire these items, but you will not earn any more chest points.
4. Up until the last day of the event, <color=#EE7600>Easter Candy</color> can be found when defeating barbarians on the map, collecting resources in your city, or gathering resources on the map. You will be unable to obtain Easter Candy this way on the last day of the event.
5. <color=#EE7600>Easter Eggs</color> and <color=#EE7600>Straw Bonnets</color> can be exchanged for rewards, including <color=#EE7600>Easter City Theme Vouchers</color>.
6. Whenever you use an Easter Candy or spend Gems, you have a chance to crit, earning you extra chest points.
7. The contribution rankings for this event will rank all members of your alliance by their contribution points.
8. There will be a short delay between the end of the event and the final calculation/mailing of alliance rank rewards. To avoid losing out on potential rewards, please refrain from leaving your alliance right after the event ends.A

<b><size=24>Event Rules</size></b>
1. You can participate in this event by spending <color=#EE7600>Shiny Wishing Coins</color>.
2. Spend Shiny Wishing Coins to spin the wheel and receive the prizes the pointers land on. Prize amounts are limited and will not be replenished once depleted.
3. Prizes are divided into <b>8</b> types of normal prizes and <b>3</b> types of special prizes. When all <b>3</b> of the special prizes have been won, you will automatically receive all of the remaining prizes on the wheel, and do not need to spin it again.
4. The chances of winning a certain prize type may decrease due to reductions in the amount remaining. Likewise, the chances of winning other prize types may increase as the amount of those prizes decreases.
5. Each time you spin the wheel, you must spend at least 1 <color=#EE7600>Shiny Wishing Coin</color>. For subsequent spins after your first spin you may spend up to 3 <color=#EE7600>Shiny Wishing Coins</color>. For each extra <color=#EE7600>Shiny Wishing Coin</color> you spend, you will gain an extra pointer. Each pointer is separate from the other pointers.
6. Once the wheel has been cleared, leftover Shiny Wishing Coins can be exchanged for Golden Keys, Crystal Keys, or 8-Hour Speedups. Shiny Wishing Coins you do not exchange will be lost.=
You can use Gems to buy Shiny Wishing Coins during the event.)

<b><size=30>The Mightiest Governor</size></b>
 <color=#997336>Who will reign supreme?</color>
 <b>Overview</b>
Earn points, get on the leaderboard, and earn tons of rewards.
 <b>Starting the Event</b>
1. This event has <color=#379f1f>6 stages</color>: Troop Training, Defeating Barbarians, Resource Gathering, Power Upgrade, Enemy Elimination, and Final Sprint. Each stage will last <color=#379f1f>1 day</color>.
2. In each stage, you can earn points by completing the stage's objective.
 <b>Rankings</b>
1. Tap the <color=#379f1f>Rankings</color> icon on the event page to view the event leaderboard.
2. The <color=#379f1f>stage rankings</color> will rank you based on how many points you earned in a given stage.
3. The <color=#379f1f>overall rankings</color> for the event will be based on how many points you earned across all stages.
 <b>Points</b>
1. Tap the <color=#379f1f>Points</color> icon on the right-hand side of the event page to learn how to earn points.
2. During the Final Sprint stage, you can earn points by completing the objectives of any of the <color=#379f1f>previous 5 stages</color>, though you will earn comparatively fewer points.
 <b>Rewards</b>
1. During each stage, you can unlock new <color=#379f1f>progress rewards</color> by reaching certain point milestones.
2. At the end of each stage and at the end of the event, the top <color=#379f1f>100</color> governors in the stage and overall rankings will also receive <color=#379f1f>rank rewards</color> via mail.
3. For rank rewards that include commander sculptures, you can <color=#379f1f>choose your preferred commander</color> from a preset list. You can change your preferred commander at any time before the end of the Final Sprint stage.
<b><size=30>Karuak Ceremony</size></b>
 <color=#997336>There's a legend here in Egria: if you cross west over the mountain forests, all the way to where the sun meets the horizon every evening, you will find a mysterious barbarian kingdom: Karaku. They call Karaku the Golden Kingdom for a reason, for it is said to be a land where priceless treasures outnumber the stones. Of course, such wealth attracts envious eyes, and the kingdom has fallen prey to countless invaders seeking to seize its riches for themselves.</color>
 <color=#997336>To defend against these invasions, the Kingdom of Karaku hosts an annual competition, pitting the soldiers of its Solar Army against one another and sieving out the strongest among them like gold from silt. These mighty few will be granted the greatest title among the Karaku: Kau Karuak.</color>
 <color=#997336>Guided by their High Priest and the Archlumen, high commander of the Solar Army, the warriors of Karaku have traveled east to the land of civilization; the "dawnlands" as they call it. They seek the chosen one foretold by the Sun Above, the Kau Karuak who will deliver them from their current crisis. They have brought with them countless enticing treasures, promising rewards beyond imagining for those who complete the trials of the Karuak Ceremony.</color>
 <b>Overview</b>
Challenge the warriors of Karaku and take home priceless treasures.
 <b>Starting the Event</b>
1. From the event page, tap the <color=#379f1f>CHALLENGE</color> button to summon a troop of Karaku warriors.
2. Summoning Karaku warriors costs <color=#379f1f>action points</color>.
3. You can also tap the <color=#379f1f>Help Us!</color> icon on the event page to help your allies with their challenges.
 <b>How to Play</b>
1. After summoning a Karaku troop, you can <color=#379f1f>attack it directly</color>, <color=#379f1f>launch a rally attack</color> against it, or <color=#379f1f>call for help</color>.
2. If you choose to launch a <color=#379f1f>rally attack</color>, you will not be able to reinforce the rallied army after it sets out.
3. If you <color=#379f1f>call for help</color>, the Karaku troop will become visible to your fellow alliance members, allowing them to launch their own rally attacks against it.
4. To complete the Karuak Ceremony, you must defeat <color=#379f1f>all levels</color> of Karaku troops.
 <b>Event Difficulty</b>
1. Before starting the Karuak Ceremony, you can choose from one of <color=#379f1f>5 difficulty levels</color>. After selecting a difficulty, it cannot be changed for the rest of the Ceremony.
2. To unlock a new difficulty level, you must complete the Ceremony at the previous difficulty level. You will be able to select the new difficulty level in the <color=#379f1f>next instance of the event</color>.
 <b>Mark of the Karuak</b>
1. <color=#379f1f>Calling for help</color> costs <color=#379f1f>1</color> Mark of the Karuak.
2. At the start of the Ceremony, all governors will automatically receive <color=#379f1f>5</color> Marks of the Karuak.
3. Every time you help an ally with their challenge, you have a small chance to earn a Mark of the Karuak.
 <b>Rewards</b>
1. At the end of the Karuak Ceremony event, you will receive a reward based on the <color=#379f1f>highest level</color> you completed.
2. Higher difficulty levels will earn you better rewards. 
 <b>Important Notes</b>
At the end of the event, all unused Marks of the Karuak will be <color=#E06666>lost</color>.
<b><size=30>Silk Road</size></b>
 <color=#997336>A heavy-laden cart trundles along the road to prosperity.</color>
 <b>Overview</b>
Work with your alliance to defend a merchant caravan from Barbarian Raiders until it reaches its destination.
 <b>Requirements</b>
You must be in an alliance to take part in this event.
 <b>Starting the Event</b>
1. From the event page, your alliance leader or officers can select a difficulty level and summon a caravan.
2. Summoning a caravan costs <color=#379f1f>Alliance Credits</color>.
3. There is a limit to how many caravans you can escort in each instance of this event. Successfully escorting a caravan will cost <color=#379f1f>1 escort chance</color>.
4. Your alliance leader or officers can choose to abandon an ongoing caravan escort at any time. Your alliance will not lose an escort chance if it quits midway through.
5. Each governor can only dispatch <color=#379f1f>1 troop</color> to escort the caravan.
 <b>How to Play</b>
1. Once summoned, the caravan will begin traveling to a random village on the map. Barbarian Raiders will attack the caravan along the way.
2. You will also encounter Barbarian Chieftains, who will stop the caravan from moving. You must defeat the Chieftain to continue.
3. Your escort will be successful once the caravan reaches its target village.
 <b>Event Difficulty and Points</b>
1. There are multiple difficulty levels for this event. To unlock a difficulty level, you must complete the previous difficulty level while fulfilling certain requirements.
2. You can earn individual points by attacking barbarians. The more damage you deal, the more points you'll earn.
3. You can also earn points over time by keeping your troop within a certain range of the caravan.
 <b>Rankings</b>
1. This event includes a <color=#379f1f>leaderboard</color>. Your alliance's ranking will be affected by the <color=#379f1f>difficulty</color> it chose.
2. For alliances that chose the same difficulty level, the rankings will be based on the final <color=#379f1f>condition</color> of their caravans.
 <b>Rewards</b>
1. The higher the <color=#379f1f>difficulty</color> you selected, the better your rewards will be for successfully escorting the caravan.
2. Your rewards will also be affected by the <color=#379f1f>condition</color> of the caravan when it arrives at its destination. The less damage it has taken, the better your rewards will be.
3. Rewards will be sent to all alliance members via mail at the end of the escort. Rank rewards will be sent at the end of the event.

<b><size=30>Shadow Legion Invasion</size></b> 
 <color=#997336>For the sake of our people, we must hold them back.</color>
 <b>Overview</b>
Defend your city from invading Shadow Legion troops.
 <b>Requirements</b>
1. You must be in an alliance to take part in this event.
2. Your alliance must have at least <color=#379f1f>30 members</color> to take part in this event.
 <b>Starting the Event</b>
1. Your alliance leader or officers can choose to activate this event at any time.
2. Each time this event occurs, your alliance can only activate it <color=#379f1f>1 time</color>.
3. Other than garrisons, each governor can only send <color=#379f1f>1 troop</color> to attack the Shadow Legion.
 <b>How to Play</b>
1. During this event, a large number of <color=#379f1f>Dark Fortresses</color> will appear on the map.
2. Once the event has been activated, the Dark Fortresses will send out <color=#379f1f>Shadow Legion troops</color> to attack alliance member cities in the same province as the Dark Fortress. 
3. There will be a total of <color=#379f1f>25 waves</color> of attackers.
4. You will be eliminated from the event if your city is breached <color=#379f1f>2</color> times. Once you've been eliminated, the Shadow Legion will no longer attack your city.
5. To complete the event, you must survive all 25 waves <color=#379f1f>without being breached twice</color>.
6. The event will end if all alliance members have been eliminated. 
 <b>Event Difficulty and Points</b>
1. Before activating the event, your alliance leader or officers can select a difficulty level from the event page. 
2. To unlock a new difficulty level, your alliance must complete the previous difficulty level with at least <color=#379f1f>15</color> surviving alliance members. Your alliance will be able to select the new difficulty level in the next instance of the event.
3. Defeating Shadow Legion troops will earn you individual points and alliance points. 
 <b>About the Shadow Legion</b>
1. The Shadow Legion's troops each have their own unique skills.
2. Peace Shields <color=#379f1f>will not protect you</color> from the Shadow Legion's troops. 
3. Shadow Legion troops will gain a March Speed buff if they travel for more than 5 minutes after exiting combat. They will lose this buff if they are attacked.
4. Every <color=#379f1f>5 waves</color>, the Shadow Legion will dispatch <color=#379f1f>elite troops</color>. Defeat them for a chance to earn additional items. 
 <b>Legend Mode</b>
1. When your kingdom enters the <color=#379f1f>offseason before Season 2</color>, your alliance will be able to unlock the extra-difficult Legend Mode for this event.
2. If your alliance chooses <color=#379f1f>Legend</color> difficulty for the event, Shadow Legion troops will be equipped with two additional Legend Mode skills (the specific skills will be decided at random).
3. The selection of Legend Mode skills will be continually updated and become more powerful over time.
 <b>Rewards</b>
1. You can unlock new reward tiers by reaching certain individual and alliance point milestones.
2. You will only receive the <color=#379f1f>highest tier</color> of rewards you have unlocked.
3. Rewards will be sent by mail after the event ends. 
 <b>Important Notes</b>
1. If this event is activated in the Lost Kingdom, it cannot be activated again in your original kingdom. Likewise, if you activate this event in your original kingdom, it cannot be activated again in the Lost Kingdom.
2. Teleporting your city while the event is active will count as <color=#E06666>1 breach</color>.
3. If you leave your alliance during the event, your individual points will be <color=#E06666>reset to zero</color>.

<b><size=30>Lohar's Trial</size></b>
 <color=#997336>Are you a real warrior? Prove it!</color>
 <b>Overview</b>
Defeat barbarians, collect relics, and challenge Lohar.
 <b>Requirements</b>
Any governor can take part in this event and collect event items, but you must be in an <color=#379f1f>alliance</color> to launch a rally against Lohar's troop.
 <b>How to Play</b> 
1. During the event, defeat Barbarian Troops on the map to collect <color=#379f1f>Bone Necklaces</color>.
2. You can use Bone Necklaces for a chance to gain one of Lohar's relics: <color=#379f1f>Lohar's Longbow</color> or <color=#379f1f>Lohar's Buckler</color>.
3. Use Lohar's relics to summon Lohar and his troop of elite soldiers near your city.
4. To defeat Lohar, you will need to launch a rally attack with your allies.
 <b>Rewards</b>
1. You will earn a reward every time you use a Bone Necklace.
2. You will earn even better rewards for defeating Lohar's troop.
<b><size=30>King of the Tribes</size></b>
 <color=#997336>Nothing can stand before us.</color>
 <b>Overview</b>
Destroy Barbarian Forts, earn points, and open chests.
 <b>Requirements</b>
You must be in an alliance to take part in this event.
 <b>Points</b>
1. During this event, your alliance will earn points whenever an alliance member <color=#379f1f>destroys a Barbarian Fort</color>.
2. The number of points your alliance will earn depends on the level of the Barbarian Fort and how many alliance members participated in the rally against it. See the <color=#379f1f>Point Breakdown</color> section below for more details.
3. Your alliance will be ranked with the rest of your kingdom based on how many points it earned.
 <b>Rewards</b>
1. You can unlock new reward chests when your alliance reaches certain <color=#379f1f>point milestones</color>.
2. At the end of the event, the top <color=#379f1f>20</color> alliances in the rankings will receive an additional rank reward.
3. You can only claim each reward chest <color=#379f1f>once</color> per event.
 <b>Important Notes</b>
If you join an alliance midway through the event, you will <color=#E06666>not be able to claim any rewards they have already unlocked</color>.
 <b>Point Breakdown</b>
Lvl 1 Barbarian Fort = 10 Points
Lvl 2 Barbarian Fort = 20 Points
Lvl 3 Barbarian Fort = 30 Points
Lvl 4 Barbarian Fort = 45 Points
Lvl 5 Barbarian Fort = 60 Points

<b><size=30>Esmeralda's House</size></b>
 <color=#997336>Why not try your luck?</color>
 <b>Overview</b>
Ask Esmeralda to divine your fate to earn rewards.
 <b>Starting the Event</b>
1. Tap the Divine button on the event page to draw a prize.
2. Divination costs <color=#379f1f>Gems</color> and <color=#379f1f>divination chances</color>. There is a limit to how many times you can perform divination per day.
 <b>Rewards</b>
1. You will earn a random reward each time you perform divination.
2. You can claim <color=#379f1f>bonus rewards</color> when you perform enough divinations. Tap the treasure chest icon in the top-left corner to claim them.
3. Your progress towards earning bonus rewards will not be reset daily.
 <b>Important Notes</b>
Your divination chances will be <color=#E06666>reset daily</color> at 00:00 UTC.
<b><size=30>Dhalruk's Puzzle Box</size></b>
 <color=#997336>The Mysterious Merchant has a strange contraption for sale... rare treasure could be yours!</color>
 <b>Overview</b>
Solve the mysterious puzzle boxes and earn rewards.
 <b>Requirements</b>
Your City Hall must be at least <color=#379f1f>level 8</color> to take part in this event. 
 <b>Starting the Event</b>
1. Tap the <color=#379f1f>OPEN</color> button on the event page to start opening the puzzle box.
2. To open puzzle box tiles, you must spend <color=#379f1f>free tries</color> or <color=#379f1f>Mechanisms</color>.
 <b>How to Play</b>
1. Dhalruk's Puzzle Box consists of several levels. You must open <color=#379f1f>all tiles</color> in a level to move onto the next level.
2. You can manually select which tiles you wish to open, or tap <color=#379f1f>AUTO</color>, which will use your remaining free tries and Mechanisms to open tiles automatically.
3. Each level contains a <color=#379f1f>Rare Treasure</color>. If you find the Rare Treasure, you can instantly open the rest of the level's tiles and move onto the next level.
 <b>Rewards</b>
1. Each time you open a tile, you will receive the treasure hidden beneath it.
2. You can earn even better rewards by opening chests from <color=#379f1f>Dhalruk's Private Collection</color>.
 <b>Puzzle Progress</b>
1. Every time you open a tile, it will increase your <color=#379f1f>puzzle progress</color>. Each tile is worth 0.5% puzzle progress. You also have a chance to crit whenever you open a tile, which will significantly increase your puzzle progress.
2. Whenever you hit 100% puzzle progress, you will get to pick a reward from Dhalruk's Private Collection and your puzzle progress will be reset to 0%.
3. Every time you pick a reward from Dhalruk's Private Collection, the prize pool will be reset based on the probabilities listed below. 
 <b>Important Notes</b>
1. At the end of the event, unused free tries will be <color=#E06666>lost</color>.
2. There is a <color=#E06666>limit</color> to how many Mechanisms you can use in each instance of this event. Once you reach this limit, you will not be able to use Mechanisms to open any more tiles.
3. At the end of the event, unused Mechanisms will be kept in your inventory, and can be used in the next instance of this event.
4. Your puzzle progress will not be reset at the end of the event, and will carry over to the next instance of this event.9
<b><size=30>Protect The Supplies</size></b>
 <color=#997336>The road ahead is difficult. Take great care.</color>
 <b>Overview</b>
Defend a merchant caravan from Barbarian Raiders until it reaches its destination.
 <b>Starting the Event</b>
1. Tap the <color=#379f1f>CONFIRM</color> button on the event page to summon a merchant caravan on the map.
2. It costs 50 action points to summon a caravan.
 <b>How to Play</b>
1. Once summoned, the caravan will begin traveling to a random village on the map. Barbarian Raiders will attack the caravan along the way.
2. To win, you must keep the caravan alive until it reaches its destination.
 <b>Event Difficulty and Points</b>
1. Before summoning a caravan, you can add special <color=#379f1f>challenges</color> to the event to increase its difficulty and rewards.
2. You can control the difficulty of each challenge by adjusting its <color=#379f1f>star level</color>. Drag the sliders on the main event page to adjust the star level and view a detailed description of each challenge.
3. At the start of the event, the highest star level you can select will depend on your power. You can unlock a higher star level for a challenge by completing the challenge at the previous star level.
4. Your <color=#379f1f>total star level</color> is the sum of the star levels you have chosen for each challenge. The higher your total star level, the harder the event will be.
5. You can attempt this event multiple times. Only your best result will be recorded.
 <b>Legend Mode</b>
1. When your kingdom enters the <color=#379f1f>offseason before Season 2</color>, you will be able to unlock the extra-difficult Legend Mode for this event.
2. To unlock Legend Mode, you must successfully escort a caravan with every challenge at max star level.
 <b>Rewards</b>
You can claim rewards from the Quests page by successfully escorting a caravan with a certain total star level.
 <b>Important Notes</b>
If you fail to escort the caravan, it will still cost you one of your attempts, and your action points <color=#E06666>will not be refunded</color>.R

Don't be in such a hurry. The gods be back to speak with you in a minute.
A symbol of eternal strength.
Mars was the Roman god of war and a guardian of agriculture. According to Roman mythology, he sired the twins Romulus and Remus with Rhea Silvia, a Vestal Virgin. The twins would go on to found the city of Rome, and thus Mars was regarded as the father god of the Roman people.'
Time cannot extinguish love and beauty.
Venus was the Roman goddess of love, beauty, desire, fertility, prosperity, and victory. According to legend, she was the mother of the Trojan hero Aeneas. Aeneas and his followers fled to Italy after the fall of Troy, and are considered the ancestors of the Roman people. Behind Venus flies Cupid (also known as Amor), the god of love, who is often depicted as the son of Venus and her lover Mars.
Wait, is that a chicken?Y
No, it's actually a goose. Geese were considered the sacred birds of Juno, queen of the gods. One night, as an army of Gauls attempted to sneak into Rome, the sacred geese living in the temple of Juno woke the city's defenders with their honking. The presence of a goose on this relief indicates that the queen of the gods favored this marriage.=
What a strange sight, seeing a she-wolf nursing human babies.<
According to legend, after the Vestal Virgin Rhea Silvia gave birth to the twins Romulus and Remus, her uncle King Amulius (who had usurped the throne from her father Numitor) ordered the brothers drowned in the Tiber River. Fortunately, they were found by a she-wolf, who raised and nursed the boys as her own pups.
What are they looking at?
While tending their flock on the Palatine Hill, the shepherd Faustulus and his companions came upon the incredible sight of a she-wolf nursing two human babies. Faustulus took the twins home, raising them as his own sons with his wife, Acca Larentia.5
A dazed shepherd and an eagle watch the scene unfold.2
The other shepherd on this relief is a personification of the Palatine Hill, the stage on which this whole saga takes place. The centermost of Rome's seven hills, it has been the chief witness to the ebbs and tides of Roman history. Jupiter, the king of the gods, looks on silently in the form of an eagle.4
Who's this? Seems like a nice, cool place for a nap.E
This reposing man is Tiberinus, a personification of the Tiber River. Legend has it that the servant ordered to drown Romulus and Remus could not bring himself to go through with it, instead leaving them in a basket on the banks of the Tiber. The swelled river gently lifted up the basket and carried the twins off to safety.

<b><size=30>VIR TRIUMPHALIS</size></b> 
 <color=#997336>Reverence to the Imperator, loyalty to the legions.</color>
 <b>Overview</b>
Join the parading Roman legions and share in the spoils of victory!
 <b>Starting the Event</b>
During this event, you have a chance to find <color=#379f1f>Gold Leaves</color> when collecting resources in your city, gathering resources on the map, or defeating barbarians. Gold Leaves will be sent to you via mail.
 <b>How to Play</b>
1. On the event page, you can earn chest points by using <color=#379f1f>Gold Leaves</color> or by spending Gems to purchase <color=#379f1f>Phalerae</color>.
2. You will earn a <color=#379f1f>Gold Wreath</color> every time you use a Gold Leaf, and a <color=#379f1f>Phalera</color> for every <color=#379f1f>50 Gems</color> you spend.
3. <color=#379f1f>Gold Wreaths</color> and <color=#379f1f>Phalerae</color> can be exchanged for rewards.
4. Whenever you use a Gold Leaf or spend Gems, you have a chance to crit, earning you extra chest points.
5. After opening the maximum number of chests, you can continue to earn event items, but you will not earn any more chest points.
 <b>Rewards</b>
1. The leaderboard in the top-right corner will rank all members of your alliance by how many chest points they have contributed.
2. Once your alliance has earned enough chest points, all members that contributed at least <color=#379f1f>50</color> points will be able to open the chest.
3. Rewards that can be redeemed with Gold Wreaths and Phalerae include <color=#379f1f>Eternal City City Theme Vouchers</color>.
 <b>Important Notes</b>
1. You can open the chest up to <color=#E06666>10</color> times during this event.
2. On the last day of the event, you <color=#E06666>will not be able to earn Gold Leaves</color> by collecting resources in your city, gathering resources on the map, or defeating barbarians.
3. There will be a short delay between the end of the event and the mailing of alliance rank rewards. To avoid losing out on potential rewards, <color=#E06666>please refrain from leaving your alliance</color> right after the event ends.C

<b><size=30>Deadly Dash</size></b>
 <color=#997336>Defeat barbarians within the time limit for massive rewards!</color>
 <b>Overview</b>
Defeat as many barbarians as possible within the time limit. The challenge will end and your score will be calculated once time runs out or after you've defeated all the barbarians. Your Alertness rating will increase as you defeat barbarians, potentially spawning elite barbarians!
 <b>Starting the Event</b>
1. During this event, you have <color=#379f1f>3</color> chances per day to start the challenge.
2. After starting the challenge, you must defeat as many barbarian troops as possible within the time limit. Defeating barbarians will extend your time remaining and increase your Alertness rating.
3. When you reach certain Alertness ratings, elite barbarians will spawn on the map. Defeat them to gain temporary buffs.
4. While an elite barbarian troop is on the map, defeating regular barbarian troops will not extend your time remaining or increase your Alertness rating.
5. The challenge will end once you've defeated 4 elite barbarian troops, or if your time runs out.
 <b>Points</b>
At the end of each challenge, your score will be calculated based on your final Alertness rating and how much time remaining you had.
 <b>Rewards</b>
1. You can unlock new rewards by reaching certain score milestones. You can only claim each reward once.
2. At the end of the event, the <color=#379f1f>top 100</color> governors in the leaderboard will receive extra rank rewards.
 <b>Important Notes</b>
1. Your challenge chances will <color=#E06666>refresh</color> every day at 00:00 UTC.
2. To avoid data errors, you <color=#E06666>will not be able to start new challenges</color> in the last 15 minutes of the event.
3. Immigrating or entering the Lost Kingdom will interrupt any ongoing challenge. If this happens, you won't lose a challenge chance. Your event points will remain the same after immigrating/entering the Lost Kingdom.%

 <b>Overview</b>

 <b>How to Play</b>
1. After summoning a Karaku troop, you can <color=#379f1f>attack it directly</color>, <color=#379f1f>launch a rally attack</color> against it, or <color=#379f1f>call for help</color>.

3. If you <color=#379f1f>call for help</color>, the Karaku troop will become visible to your fellow alliance members, allowing them to launch their own rally attacks against it.
4. To complete the Karuak Ceremony, you must defeat <color=#379f1f>all levels</color> of Karaku troops.
 <b>Event Difficulty</b>
1. Before starting the Karuak Ceremony, you can choose from one of <color=#379f1f>6 difficulty levels</color>. After selecting a difficulty, it cannot be changed for the rest of the Ceremony.
2. To unlock a new difficulty level, you must complete the Ceremony at the previous difficulty level. You will be able to select the new difficulty level in the <color=#379f1f>next instance of the event</color>.
 <b>Mark of the Karuak</b>
1. <color=#379f1f>Calling for help</color> costs <color=#379f1f>1</color> Mark of the Karuak.

 <b>Rewards</b>

<b><size=30>Arms Training</size></b>
 <color=#997336>Armsmaster Lohar has organized a session of Arms Training. Use this opportunity to gain valuable battle experience!</color>
 <b>Overview</b>
Spar with Lohar, earn points, and open chests.
 <b>How to Play</b>
1. To start the event, you must first select a difficulty. You will automatically have access to all difficulty levels you've unlocked in previous instances of this event.
2. You can only use one troop for the entire duration of each training session. In other words, all battles in a single session have to be fought by the same troop. Until the session ends, the troop must stay on the map and <color=#379f1f>cannot be healed or reinforced</color>.
3. At the start of each training session, Armsmaster Lohar will be equipped with 2 <color=#379f1f>starting skills</color> and 1 <color=#379f1f>active skill</color>.
4. Every <color=#379f1f>2</color> times you defeat Lohar's troop, Lohar will power up and unlock a new skill. You will be able to select which skill you want him to unlock.
5. If your troop is defeated, returns to your city, or defeats a fully-upgraded Lohar 2 times (or if you give up the session), the session will end and your score will be calculated.
 <b>Points</b>
1. Every time you defeat Lohar's troop, you will earn an amount of points based on your chosen difficulty (at least <color=#379f1f>10,000</color> points).
2. If your troop is defeated midway, you will gain bonus points based on what percentage of Lohar's units you defeated in your last battle (multiplied by 10,000).
3. If you defeat a fully-upgraded Lohar 2 times, you will earn bonus points based on the percentage of units remaining in your troop (multiplied by 10,000).
4. You can conduct multiple training sessions. Your cumulative score across all sessions will be used to unlock new reward chests.
5. If you give up the training session or return your troop to your city, you will not receive any bonus points for the session.
6. Your leaderboard score will be your highest score in a single training session.
 <b>Rewards</b>
1. You can unlock new reward chests by reaching certain <color=#379f1f>point milestones</color>.
2. At the end of the event, you will receive additional rank rewards based on your event ranking.
 <b>Important Notes</b>
1. Armsmaster Lohar's units are elite barbarians. Buffs and skills that increase damage dealt to barbarians or reduce damage received from barbarians <color=#E06666>will not affect them</color>.
2. If your server is taken down for maintenance, <color=#E06666>any ongoing training sessions will be terminated</color>. If you receive a notification of impending server maintenance, please be sure to complete your current training session before the server goes offline.$

<b><size=22>Team Immigration Rules</size></b>
Kingdoms can now receive teams of returning players through the team immigration feature.
1. Only the king of a kingdom can approve team immigration applications. After approving a team's application, its members will receive a confirmation message via mail. Team immigration applications are valid for 3 days. If not approved in time, they will be automatically rejected.
2. In addition to receiving the king's approval, an immigration team's members must meet all other requirements for immigrating to a kingdom.
3. After approving a team's application, the king of the target kingdom will still be able to revoke a team's immigration eligibility so long as no members of the team have finished immigrating. Once a single member of the team finishes immigrating, the team's eligibility can no longer be revoked.
4. Only "returning players" have access to team immigration. Team immigration will not count towards a kingdom's normal immigration quota or cost special immigration points.;

 <color=#997336>A long journey lies before you; will you see it to its end?</color>
 <b>Overview</b>
Complete Expedition missions, get on the leaderboard, and earn tons of rewards.
 <b>Requirements</b>
To take part in this event, you need to have completed <color=#379f1f>mission {p1}</color> of Expedition mode. You also need to have a <color=#379f1f>historical highest power of at least {p2}</color>.
 <b>How to Play</b>
1. This event consists of <color=#379f1f>{p3} Expedition missions</color>.
2. To clear a mission, you must defeat all enemy troops within the time limit.
 <b>Points</b>
1. After clearing a mission, your score will be calculated based on your units remaining.
2. Different tiers of units have different point values. You will earn points for <color=#379f1f>every {p4} units</color> of a given tier you have remaining. If the number of units is not divisible by {p4}, the remainder will be rounded up and treated as {p4}.
3. Below are the point values for {p4} units of each tier:
- Tier 3 or lower: +{p5} points
- Tier 4: +{p6} points
- Tier 5: +{p7} points
4. If you have less than {p4} remaining units for a given tier, it will be counted as <color=#379f1f>{p4} remaining units</color> for the purposes of calculating your mission score.
5. You can challenge a mission multiple times, but only your <color=#379f1f>best result</color> will be recorded.
6. After you've cleared all missions, your <color=#379f1f>high scores</color> for each mission will be added together into your total score. You will be ranked based on your total score.
 <b>Rewards</b>

2. You will have <color=#E06666>{p8} challenge chances</color> per day. To maximize your score, you'll need to find the best way to divide these challenge chances between the various missions.
3. Each instance of this event will have different leaderboard ranges. Tap the "Cross-Kingdom" tag on the main event page to learn more.
4. In the first instance of this event, you will only be ranked with governors in your own kingdom. In subsequent instances, you will also be ranked with governors from three other kingdoms in your region.
5. The total number of missions may vary from instance to instance.

On boggy marsh or fertile leas, wealth is found where cows can graze.
Fehu represents cattle. Cattle were an important element of early Germanic economic life, and were used as a marker of wealth and social status. This rune symbolizes the flow of wealth and the accumulation of material resources.
The mighty-horned aurochs is the earth's paragon: strong, sturdy, and savage in equal measure.
Uruz represents the aurochs, a now-extinct bovine whose strength made it a symbol for power and vitality in Germanic societies. This rune symbolizes primal strength and lasting tenacity.
When Ragnarok cometh for us all, the j
tunn's blade will spare neither king nor churl.
Thurisaz represents the j
tnar (giants) of Germanic mythology, a race of beings often associated with chaotic natural forces. With great power comes the potential for great destruction, against which one must do their utmost to resist. This rune symbolizes danger and conflict, but also protection and strength.s
Should the one-eyed wanderer darken your door, heed his tales and you'll be wiser for it.
Ansuz represents Odin (also known as Gautr, B
leygr, Gr
mnir, and countless other names), the Norse god of wisdom and communication. Through language and revelation, Odin brought wisdom and knowledge to the world. This rune symbolizes wisdom, enlightenment, and the divine word.
Riding seems easy to the warrior who rests indoors, but double brave to he who traverses the moors.
Raido represents travel and journeys. From the Migration Period to Leif Erik sailing to the Americas, the Germanic peoples have had a long and storied history with travel and exploration. Journeys are not limited to just traveling the world; they also include internal, spiritual journeys. This rune symbolizes progress, change, and the rhythms of life.[
Whether the fire of creation or the dim glow of the great hall, the torch illuminates our path to come.
In the Anglo-Saxon futhorc, Kenaz represents the torch, the provider of light and warmth. The torch illuminates not just the physical, but hidden knowledge and truths as well. This rune symbolizes enlightenment, creativity, and understanding.
Generosity is a gift always reciprocated, even when given to those who lack aught to give back.
Gebo represents gifts and exchange, reciprocity and cooperation. Mutual gifting, whether between peers or master and servant, formed an integral aspect of early Germanic culture, creating the bonds and ties upon which society was built. This rune symbolizes cooperation, balance, and reciprocity.
The blessing of the gods, a joyful hearth, balance and freedom.
Wunjo represents joy, harmony, and inner peace, as represented by family, friendship, and shared success. This rune symbolizes success, happiness, and inner and outer balance.k
"Hail is the whitest of grain / It is whirled from the vault of heaven / And is tossed about by gusts of wind / And then it melts into water."
Hagalaz represents hail, a force of uncontrollable destructive power. With destruction, however, comes the opportunity for salvation and rebirth. This rune symbolizes the inevitability of change and the power of nature.
The shackled man seems doomed to fate, but you should fear he who works every day to break his bonds.
Naudiz represents constraints and scarcity. A land of little farmland but plenty of iron, the harsh environment of Northern Europe bred conflict and adversity, but also strength and growth for those who could survive it. This rune symbolizes inner strength, growth in the face of adversity, and endurance.
The stasis of ice breeds reflection in its stillness.
Isaz represents ice, bringer of stasis and separation. In medieval Northern Europe, the winter frost put a pause to ordinary life. Farmers' fields lay fallow, soldiers stopped their campaigns, and traders kept their ships anchored in port. For those who could survive winter's grasp, this stillness created a time to reflect on the past and future. This rune symbolizes stasis, clarity, and introspection.
"Summer is a joy to men, when God, the holy King of Heaven / Suffers the earth to bring forth shining fruits / For rich and poor alike."
Jera represents the harvest, seasons, and plentitude. Regardless of culture, the people of the early medieval period followed the rhythm of nature, remaining patient and putting in hard work to reap great rewards. This rune symbolizes the cycle of time, the fruits of hard work, and the rhythm of nature.U
The yew of the world tree, the bow of life and death, the knot that ties.
Eihwaz represents the holy yew tree, as well as the world tree Yggdrasil. In Norse mythology, Yggdrasil connects the Nine Worlds of existence, bridging the lands of the mortal and the eternal. This rune symbolizes resilience, transformation, and spiritual awakening.
What does the cauldron hold? Fates both young and old.
Perthro represents the mysteries and hidden potential of fate. This rune symbolizes opportunities, fate, and mysterious forces.

The Sunset Canyon Tournament is open to all kingdoms. Kingdoms will be sorted into groups of 4. You can battle against other governors in your kingdom group.
Kingdoms that haven't entered the Season of Conquest will be grouped with other kingdoms in their region. Kingdoms in the Season of Conquest will be grouped based on kingdom strength.
Each season of the tournament will start on a Monday. Seasons will be divided into a 1-week Preselection stage, a 1-week Main Event, and a 3-week Champion Showcase stage.
1. During the Main Event, you can adjust your troops for the <b>current round</b> every day before <color=#a24000><b>{p1}</b></color>. After that, your troops will be <b>locked</b>.
2. Before troops are locked, all buffs will be <b>automatically synchronized</b> with your participating troops. Please avoid anything that would reduce the power of your troops, such as removing equipment.
3. You view other governors' battle records, but you can't view their current troops.
4. If you don't set your troops in a given round, your troop settings from the <b>previous round</b> will be used by default (if you don't set your troops in the Group Stage, your troop settings will be based on your defensive lineup at the <b>end</b> of the Kingdom Breakout stage).
5. System maintenance may affect your ability to adjust your troops. Please pay attention to system announcements, and try to avoid adjusting your troops during system maintenance periods.
Outside of the Preparation Season, the rules for the Main Event of the tournament are as follows:
1. You can deploy up to 5 troops. In this event, you'll use units provided by the system instead of your own units. <b>The tier of each unit will be the highest tier you've researched in the Academy for the unit's type</b>.
2. You can place your troops in one of 8 squares. Each troop will first attack the front-row target directly in front of them, followed by the back-row target directly in front of them. If there are no targets directly in front, the troop will attack the closest target.
3. In this event, <b>the only buffs that will take effect are buffs from commander levels, talents, equipment, Museum Relics, formations, armaments, VIP levels, buildings, technologies, civilization bonuses, city themes, and alliance technologies</b>.
4. Defeat all of your opponent's troops within the time limit to win. If neither side has been eliminated by the end of the time limit, the side with the most units remaining will be the winner.2

<b><size=30>Feast Prep</size></b>
 <color=#997336>Nothing tastes better than the flavor of friendship.</color>
 <b>Overview</b>
Deliver dishes, complete menu quests, and prepare for the Alliance Feast!
 <b>Starting the Event</b>
You can claim a reward whenever you cook a dish on the menu.
 <b>How to Play</b>
1. During this event, you can deliver a certain number of <color=#379f1f>dishes</color> each day to complete menu quests. The max number of dishes you can deliver is randomized. Menu quests and rewards will be reset every day.
2. Delivering dishes will earn points for your alliance. The more points your alliance has, the higher its feast level will be in the <color=#379f1f>Good Food, Better Company</color> event. The higher its feast level, the better the rewards.
3. If you're missing a dish, you can send a request to your fellow alliance members. You can also gift dishes to others for a small reward.
 <b>Rewards</b>
You can claim a reward whenever you cook a dish on the menu.
 <b>Important Notes</b>
1. Leftover ingredients and undelivered dishes will be reclaimed at 00:00 UTC on the following day in order to guarantee the very best freshness and food hygiene (DEFINITELY not because someone wanted a midnight snack).
2. Dishes you receive from other alliance members will be <color=#E06666>automatically delivered</color>.
3. If you've been gifted a dish by a fellow alliance member, you must accept the dish to earn alliance points and request another dish. If you no longer need a dish you've requested or are unable to find somebody to gift it to you, you can cancel your requests at any time before they're fulfilled. The canceled request will not use up one of your request chances.
4. There is a <color=#E06666>limit</color> to how many dishes you can receive per day.

<b><size=30>Good Food, Better Company</size></b>
 <color=#997336>Everybody's brought a home-cooked dish! Let the feast begin!</color>
 <b>Overview</b>
Attend Alliance Feasts to claim delectable rewards!
 <b>Starting the Event</b>
Alliance leaders or titled officers can place an Alliance Feast on the map for all their alliance members to enjoy.
 <b>How to Play</b>
1. For every dish you deliver in the <color=#379f1f>Feast Prep</color> event, your alliance will earn <color=#379f1f>1 point</color>. These points will increase your alliance's feast level for the day.
2. If your alliance earns at least <color=#379f1f>100</color> points in a day, your leader or titled officers can place an <color=#379f1f>Alliance Feast</color> within your alliance's territory. The Feast is open to all alliance members.
3. Each Alliance Feast lasts for <color=#379f1f>12 hours</color>. You cannot start a new Feast until the previous day's Feast has ended.
 <b>Rewards</b>
1. You will earn a reward each time you attend an Alliance Feast.
2. You can increase your alliance's feast level up to <color=#379f1f>level 3</color>. The higher your alliance's feast level, the better the rewards will be.
 <b>Important Notes</b>
1. Once an Alliance Feast has been placed on the map, it can no longer be upgraded, and your alliance can only place one Alliance Feast per day. Try to get your feast level as high as possible before starting!
2. It takes <color=#E06666>20 minutes</color> to attend an Alliance Feast. If you leave the Feast midway or it ends before you can attend it for 20 minutes, you will not receive a reward.
3. Once you've attended an Alliance Feast, you must wait <color=#E06666>12 hours</color> before attending another one.

2. After your scout has investigated the village, a villager will give you a <b>timed quest</b>.
3. You can choose to accept or decline the villager's quest. A timer will start to count down as soon as the quest is accepted. If the quest is not completed before the timer runs out, you will fail.
4. You can only accept one villager quest at a time. That quest has to end or be given up before you can accept another.
5. After completing a villager quest, you will receive quest rewards and a special item: <b>Bandit's Clues</b>.
6. Use the Bandit's Clues to summon <b>Bandits</b>, who will spawn somewhere close to your city. You can choose to fight them alone or rally attack them.
7. You can complete up to <b>10</b> villager quests per day, but you can only get rewards from defeating the bandits <b>5</b> times per day.
8. When the event ends, the bandits will flee the kingdom. Be sure to use all your Bandit's Clues before then.

<b><size=30>Melon Market</size></b>
 <color=#997336>The Melon Market is open for business! Egria's going crazy for these melons! You could make a fortune selling them... or stealing them.</color>
 <b>Overview</b>
Gather resources and complete daily quests to obtain Egrimelons. Sell your Egrimelons to earn Melon Money, which can be exchanged for valuable rewards!
 <b>Requirements</b>
Your City Hall must be at least <color=#379f1f>level {p13}</color> to take part in this event.
 <b>Acquiring and Stealing Melons</b>
1. While this event is ongoing, the Melon Masters will send you <color=#379f1f>{p1} Egrimelons per hour</color>. You can claim up to <color=#379f1f>{p2} Egrimelons</color> from the Melon Masters <color=#379f1f>each day</color>.
2. If one of your allies has at least {p3} unclaimed Egrimelons, you can <color=#379f1f>steal</color> their Egrimelons! The more unclaimed Egrimelons an ally has, the more Egrimelons you're likely to steal. <color=#379f1f>You can steal Egrimelons up to {p4} times per day</color>, and at most {p5} time from a single ally.
 <b>Selling Melons</b>
1. The price of Egrimelons will vary from stall to stall, ranging between <color=#379f1f>{p7} to {p8}</color> Melon Money. Prices will refresh every day at 00:00 UTC. If your own stall's price isn't satisfactory, you can <color=#379f1f>visit a friend's stall to sell your Egrimelons there instead</color>.
2. You can also invite other governors to sell at your stall. When selling Egrimelons at other stalls, <color=#379f1f>{p9} of the Melon Money will go to the stall owner as a market fee</color>. The remaining {p10} will go to the seller.
3. Other governors can sell up to {p11} Egrimelons at your stall per day. You can only earn up to {p12} Melon Money per day from market fees.
 <b>Sharing Your Stall</b>
1. You can share your stall via the in-game chat or by sending someone a stall code.
2. Links shared in the chat and stall codes are <color=#379f1f>only valid for the day they are generated</color>.
 <b>Rewards</b>
1. Melon Money you earn from selling Egrimelons can be exchanged for rewards at the <color=#379f1f>Melon Mall</color>.
2. The Melon Mall has multiple tiers. The more Melon Money you spend, the more rewards you'll unlock.
 <b>Important Notes</b>
1. If you have over {p6} unclaimed Egrimelons, the Melon Masters will stop delivering new Egrimelons to you. There'd be nowhere for them to put them, after all.
2. Every day at 00:00 UTC, all of your unsold Egrimelons will be <color=#379f1f>automatically sold</color> at the previous day's price.
3. At the end of the event, any unused Melon Money will be lost.

VIEW
<b><size=30>Feast al-Fitr</size></b>
<color=#997336>The new moon shines upon a day of reunion and abundance.</color>
 <b>Overview</b>
Prepare a fabulous Eid al-Fitr feast with the other governors in your kingdom, claim valuable rewards.
 <b>Requirements</b>
Your City Hall must be at least level 8 to take part in this event.
 <b>How to Participate</b>
This event is divided into two stages: the prep stage and the feast stage.
<b>Prep Stage</b>:
1. <color=#379f1f>Collect resources in your city</color>, <color=#379f1f>purchase items from the Mysterious Merchant</color>, <color=#379f1f>train units</color>, <color=#379f1f>defeat Barbarian Troops</color>, <color=#379f1f>gather resources from the map</color>, and <color=#379f1f>help allies</color> to receive <color=#379f1f>Eid Ingredient Chests</color>. Open the chests to receive random ingredients.
2. Each day, you'll be given a menu of <color=#379f1f>3 dishes</color>. Use the ingredients you've collected to cook the dishes.
3. You can <color=#379f1f>trade ingredients</color> with other governors in your kingdom.
4, Every dish you cook will help increase your <color=#379f1f>kingdom's Feast Tent level</color>. Complete <color=#379f1f>event quests</color> to earn <color=#379f1f>Feast Tickets</color> for the feast stage and other items. 
<b>Feast Stage</b>:
1. During this stage, Feast Tents will spawn across the map. Dispatch a troop to dine with your fellow governors!
2. It takes 30 minutes and costs 1 Feast Ticket to dine at a Feast Tent.
 <b>Rewards</b>
Every time you dine at a Feast Tent during the feast stage, you'll receive an <color=#379f1f>Eid Feast Chest</color> of random quality, containing valuable rewards. The more times you dine at the Feast Tent, the more likely you are to get a higher quality chest.
 <b>Important Notes</b>
1. During the prep stage, there is a limit on how many ingredients you can acquire per day.
2. You cannot send a troop to dine at a Feast Tent in the last 30 minutes of the event.
