<b><size=30>Supreme Throne</size>
</b><color=#997336>Rise to the top and ascend the supreme throne!</color>
 <b>Event Overview</b>
Earn points, get on the cross-kingdom leaderboard, and earn tons of rewards.
 <b>Rankings</b>
1. During this event, governors will be ranked based on their <color=#379f1f>event points</color>.
2. Scroll down on the event page to view the current rankings.
 <b>Points</b>
1. There are 5 ways to earn points: training units, defeating barbarians, gathering resources, and increasing your building power/research power.
2. Tap the Points icon on the right-hand side of the event page for more details on how to earn points.
 <b>Rewards</b>
1. Complete event quests to earn rewards.
2. At the end of the event, the top 100 governors in the overall rankings will receive a <color=#379f1f>rank reward</color> via mail.
 <b>Important Notes</b>
1. Rankings for this event are <color=#379f1f>cross-kingdom</color>. In each instance of this event, your kingdom will be matched up with other kingdoms based on a number of different factors.
2. The number of kingdoms you are matched up with may vary from event to event.

UNIFICATION DAY%
All Hail the King... Whoever They Are
Unification Day
<b><size=30>Unification Day</size></b>
<color=#997336>The final battle counts down. Who will be the one to bask in the glory of the throne?</color>
 <b>Overview</b>
Celebrate the unification of the kingdom, read the new king's Coronation Oath, and claim Coronation Chests.
 <b>How to Play</b>
1. At the end of the Kingdom Chronicles chapter "The Last Golden Apple", the <color=#379f1f>leader of the alliance currently controlling the Lost Temple</color> will become the first king of the kingdom. The king will be asked to write and issue a Coronation Oath.
2. Once the new king issues their Coronation Oath, the Coronation Ceremony event will begin.
3. During the Coronation Ceremony event, 4 batches of Coronation Chests will spawn <color=#379f1f>around the kingdom's Lost Temple and certain Shrines/Altars</color>.
 <b>Rewards</b>
1. After the king issues their Coronation Oath, governors in the kingdom with a level 8+ City Hall can earn 200 Gems by liking the oath.
2. In the Coronation Ceremony event, all governors in the kingdom will be able to open up to <color=#379f1f>{p1}</color> Coronation Chest per batch.
 <b>Important Notes</b>
If the king of the kingdom changes during the Coronation Ceremony event, the first king will still be the one to issue the Coronation Oath.
At the end of the Chronicles chapter "The Last Golden Apple", the leader of the alliance currently occupying the Lost Temple will become king.U
Once the king issues their Coronation Oath, the Coronation Ceremony event will begin.

MERCANTILE MELEE
Mercantile Melee
<b><size=30>Mercantile Melee</size></b>
The Egrian Commerce Council has been opening tons of new trade routes, but with new routes comes unknown dangers! To ensure their caravans get to where they need to go, the Council has appealed to the governors of Egria for help.
 <b>Overview</b>
Escort and loot caravans to earn lavish rewards!
 <b>How to Play</b>
1. This event is split into <color=#ffffff>two trading phases</color>. The first phase will last from the start of the event until 23:59 UTC the same day. The second phase will last from 00:00 UTC on the second day until the end of the event.
2. During each trading period, you'll have <color=#ffffff>2 chances to escort and 2 chances to loot caravans</color>. Unused chances from the first period won't carry over into the second period.
3. After a caravan sets out, it'll start carrying its cargo along a random route through the kingdom. When a caravan you're escorting reaches its destination, you'll be rewarded with its remaining cargo.
 <b>Escorting Caravans</b>
1. <color=#ffffff>At the end of the first day of the second trading period</color>, you'll no longer be able to escort caravans, and will only be able to loot other governors' caravans.
2. You can escort up to <color=#ffffff>2 caravans at a time</color>.
3. Before starting an escort, you can refresh the caravan's rarity. The first refresh for each caravan is free; subsequent refreshes will cost you <color=#ffffff>Rarity Refreshers</color>.
4. Before starting an escort, you'll also need to set up escort troops to defend the caravan.
5. If your escort troops are defeated by an enemy's looter troops, your caravan will lose some of its cargo. Any losses your escort troops incur while fighting against enemy looter troops will be recovered at the end of battle.
6. Units and commanders you assign to escort your caravans can still be used in other scenarios (e.g. on the map).
 <b>Looting Caravans</b>
1. If you're in an alliance, you can loot other governors' caravans up to 2 times per trading period.
2. In your original kingdom and pre-Conquest Lost Kingdoms, you can loot the caravans of <color=#ffffff>any governor not in your alliance</color>. In Season of Conquest Lost Kingdoms, you can only loot the caravans of <color=#ffffff>governors not in your coalition</color>.
3. You can search for targets to loot from the event page or the map.
4. To loot a caravan, you'll need to <color=#ffffff>set up looter troops</color> to fight the enemy caravan's escort troops.
5. If your looter troops defeat a caravan's escort troops, you'll be rewarded with a random portion of the caravan's cargo. Any losses your looter troops incur while fighting against enemy escort troops will be recovered at the end of battle.
 <b>Important Notes</b>
1. The potential rewards for escorting a caravan depends on your <color=#ffffff>City Hall level</color> and the caravan's <color=#ffffff>rarity</color>.
2. Caravans start with <color=#ffffff>2 Durability</color> and lose 1 Durability each time they are successfully looted. At 0 Durability, they can no longer be looted.
3. If you are escorting a caravan in the Lost Kingdom and return to your original kingdom, you will <color=#ffffff>lose out on all rewards for the escort</color>. The caravan will be despawned and you won't recover the escort chance you used.
4. All buffs will take effect in caravan battles, with the exception of alliance tech, alliance territory, Lost Kingdom, Holy Site, and limited-time item buffs.
 <b>Rarity Odds</b>
Caravan rarity odds are as follows:
1. 1st Refresh: Common (60%) / Advanced (25%) / Elite (5%) / Epic (5%) / Legendary (5%)
2. 2nd Refresh: Common (40%) / Advanced (25%) / Elite (10%) / Epic (15%) / Legendary (10%)
3. 3rd Refresh: Common (30%) / Advanced (20%) / Elite (15%) / Epic (20%) / Legendary (15%)
4. 4th Refresh: Common (20%) / Advanced (15%) / Elite (20%) / Epic (25%) / Legendary (20%)
5. 5th Refresh: Elite (40%) / Epic (35%) / Legendary (25%)
6th Refresh: Legendary (100%)

<b><size=30>Trial of Kau Karuak</size></b>
<color=#997336>As we traveled through distant lands, we came upon old friends. The warriors of Karaku traveled many miles to find us, for they never forget a debt. When the riches of the Golden Kingdom attracted covetous invaders, we helped them hold the line. In return, they have brought us a bounty of resources. But tradition is tradition, and to lay claim to these riches, there is one last step...</color>
<color=#997336>We must pass the Trial of Kau Karuak.</color>
 <b>Overview</b>
Brave the trials and receive a boon from the Golden Kingdom.
 <b>How to Participate</b>
1. From the event page, tap the <color=#379f1f>Challenge</color> button to summon a troop of Karaku warriors (the trial target).
2. Summoning Karaku warriors costs <color=#379f1f>action points</color>.
 <b>How to Play</b>
1. After summoning the trial target, you can challenge them for a <color=#379f1f>limited time</color>.
2. If you fail to challenge or defeat the trial target within the time limit, the trial target will disappear and will need to be re-summoned.
3. To complete the Trial of Kau Karuak for a given difficulty level, you must defeat <color=#379f1f>all levels</color> of the trial at that difficulty.
 <b>Event Difficulty</b>
1. Before the trial begins, you can choose one of <color=#379f1f>4 difficulties</color>.
2. You will unlock new difficulties as the <color=#379f1f>Lost Kingdom Chronicles</color> progress.
3. Once you have selected a difficulty, you must complete <color=#379f1f>all its trials</color> to advance to the next difficulty.
 <b>Rewards</b>
1. The higher the trial difficulty you selected, the better the rewards.
2. Every time you complete a trial, the reward will be sent to you by <color=#379f1f>mail</color>.
 <b>Important Notes</b>
You can only take on the trial alone. Other governors cannot provide assistance.;

1. The higher the trial difficulty you selected, the better the rewards.
2. The more trial levels you've completed, the more Crystals you can earn each hour.
3. Every time you complete a trial, the reward will be sent to you by <color=#379f1f>mail</color>.
 <b>Important Notes</b>
1. You can only take on the trial alone. Other governors cannot provide assistance.
2. You can only store up to <color=#E06666>24 hours</color> of Crystal income at a time, so make sure you claim them regularly.
3. Each trial level has a <color=#E06666>maximum number of attacks</color> possible. One attack is spent every time you send a new troop to attack the trial target. Once you have used up all your attacks, you cannot send any new troops to attack the trial target.

CLAIM[
<b><size=30>Mercantile Melee</size></b>
<color=#997336>The Egrian Commerce Council has been opening tons of new trade routes, but with new routes comes unknown dangers! To ensure their caravans get to where they need to go, the Council has appealed to the governors of Egria for help.</color>
 <b>Overview</b>
Escort and loot caravans to earn lavish rewards!
 <b>How to Play</b>
1. This event is split into <color=#379f1f>two trading phases</color>. The first phase will last from the start of the event until 23:59 UTC the same day. The second phase will last from 00:00 UTC on the second day until the end of the event.
2. During each trading period, you'll have <color=#379f1f>2 chances to escort and 2 chances to loot caravans</color>. Unused chances from the first period won't carry over into the second period.
3. After a caravan sets out, it'll start carrying its cargo along a random route through the kingdom. When a caravan you're escorting reaches its destination, you'll be rewarded with its remaining cargo.
 <b>Escorting Caravans</b>
1. <color=#379f1f>At the end of the first day of the second trading period</color>, you'll no longer be able to escort caravans, and will only be able to loot other governors' caravans.
2. You can escort up to <color=#379f1f>2 caravans at a time</color>.
3. Before starting an escort, you can refresh the caravan's rarity. The first refresh for each caravan is free; subsequent refreshes will cost you <color=#379f1f>Rarity Refreshers</color>.
4. Before starting an escort, you'll also need to set up escort troops to defend the caravan.
5. If your escort troops are defeated by an enemy's looter troops, your caravan will lose some of its cargo. Any losses your escort troops incur while fighting against enemy looter troops will be recovered at the end of battle.
6. Units and commanders you assign to escort your caravans can still be used in other scenarios (e.g. on the map).
 <b>Escorting Alliance Caravans</b>
1. The <color=#379f1f>top 10 </color>alliances in your kingdom can escort alliance caravans. Each alliance gets<color=#379f1f> one free escort chance per day</color>. After completing the free escort, the alliance leader or a titled officer can purchase a bundle to activate an additional premium alliance caravan.
2. Free alliance caravans need <color=#379f1f>a captain appointed by the leader or an officer</color>. The caravan will automatically set out 4 hours after a captain is appointed. Premium caravans will be captained by the alliance officer who purchased the bundle. Captaining an alliance caravan will not affect your escort chances for personal caravans.
3. Alliance caravan captains can use <color=#379f1f>Rarity Refreshers</color> to refresh their caravan's rewards.
4. Non-captain alliance members can choose a caravan carriage to queue for. When the caravan sets out, 5 random governors in each carriage will be chosen to board. Each governor can travel on an alliance caravan up to <color=#379f1f>2 times</color> per trading period.
5. When the alliance caravan reaches its goal, the captain will be rewarded with all of the caravan's remaining cargo. Passengers will be rewarded with all of their carriage's remaining cargo.
 <b>Looting Caravans</b>
1. If you're in an alliance, you can loot other governors' caravans up to 2 times per trading period.
2. In your original kingdom and pre-Conquest Lost Kingdoms, you can loot the caravans of <color=#379f1f>any governor not in your alliance</color>. In Season of Conquest Lost Kingdoms, you can only loot the caravans of <color=#379f1f>governors not in your coalition</color>.
3. You can search for targets to loot from the event page or the map.
4. To loot a caravan, you'll need to <color=#379f1f>set up looter troops</color> to fight the enemy caravan's escort troops.
5. If your looter troops defeat a caravan's escort troops, you'll be rewarded with a random portion of the caravan's cargo. Any losses your looter troops incur while fighting against enemy escort troops will be recovered at the end of battle.
 <b>Important Notes</b>
1. The potential rewards for escorting a caravan depends on your <color=#E06666>City Hall level</color> and the caravan's <color=#E06666>rarity</color>.
2. Caravans start with <color=#E06666>2 Durability</color> and lose 1 Durability each time they are successfully looted. At 0 Durability, they can no longer be looted.
3. If you are escorting a caravan in the Lost Kingdom and return to your original kingdom, you will <color=#E06666>lose out on all rewards for the escort</color>. The caravan will be despawned and you won't recover the escort chance you used.
4. All buffs will take effect in caravan battles, with the exception of alliance tech, alliance territory, Lost Kingdom, Holy Site, and limited-time item buffs.
5. If your kingdom is in an active Lost Kingdom, you can only escort and loot caravans <color=#E06666>in the Lost Kingdom</color>.
 <b>Rarity Odds</b>
Caravan rarity odds are as follows:
1. 1st Refresh: Common (60%) / Advanced (25%) / Elite (5%) / Epic (5%) / Legendary (5%)
2. 2nd Refresh: Common (40%) / Advanced (25%) / Elite (10%) / Epic (15%) / Legendary (10%)
3. 3rd Refresh: Common (30%) / Advanced (20%) / Elite (15%) / Epic (20%) / Legendary (15%)
4. 4th Refresh: Common (20%) / Advanced (15%) / Elite (20%) / Epic (25%) / Legendary (20%)
5. 5th Refresh: Elite (40%) / Epic (35%) / Legendary (25%)
6th Refresh: Legendary (100%)[

4. Non-captain alliance members can choose a caravan carriage to queue for. When the caravan sets out, 5 random governors in each carriage will be chosen to board. Each governor can travel on an alliance caravan up to <color=#379f1f>2 times</color> per trading period.
5. When the alliance caravan reaches its goal, the captain will be rewarded with all of the caravan's remaining cargo. Passengers will be rewarded with all of their carriage's remaining cargo.
 <b>Looting Caravans</b>
1. If you're in an alliance, you can loot other governors' caravans up to 2 times per trading period.
2. In your original kingdom and pre-Conquest Lost Kingdoms, you can loot the caravans of <color=#379f1f>any governor not in your alliance</color>. In Season of Conquest Lost Kingdoms, you can only loot the caravans of <color=#379f1f>governors not in your coalition</color>.
3. You can search for targets to loot from the event page or the map.
4. To loot a caravan, you'll need to <color=#379f1f>set up looter troops</color> to fight the enemy caravan's escort troops.
5. If your looter troops defeat a caravan's escort troops, you'll be rewarded with a random portion of the caravan's cargo. Any losses your looter troops incur while fighting against enemy escort troops will be recovered at the end of battle.
 <b>Important Notes</b>
1. The potential rewards for escorting a caravan depends on your <color=#E06666>City Hall level</color> and the caravan's <color=#E06666>rarity</color>.
2. Caravans start with <color=#E06666>2 Durability</color> and lose 1 Durability each time they are successfully looted. At 0 Durability, they can no longer be looted.
3. If you are escorting a caravan in the Lost Kingdom and return to your original kingdom, you will <color=#E06666>lose out on all rewards for the escort</color>. The caravan will be despawned and you won't recover the escort chance you used.
4. All buffs will take effect in caravan battles, with the exception of alliance tech, alliance territory, Lost Kingdom, Holy Site, and limited-time item buffs.
5. If your kingdom is in an active Lost Kingdom, you can only escort and loot caravans <color=#E06666>in the Lost Kingdom</color>.
 <b>Rarity Odds</b>
Caravan rarity odds are as follows:
1. 1st Refresh: Common (60%) / Advanced (25%) / Elite (5%) / Epic (5%) / Legendary (5%)
2. 2nd Refresh: Common (40%) / Advanced (25%) / Elite (10%) / Epic (15%) / Legendary (10%)
3. 3rd Refresh: Common (30%) / Advanced (20%) / Elite (15%) / Epic (20%) / Legendary (15%)
4. 4th Refresh: Common (20%) / Advanced (15%) / Elite (20%) / Epic (25%) / Legendary (20%)

<b><size=30>Mercantile Melee</size></b>
<color=#79550a>The Egrian Commerce Council has been opening tons of new trade routes, but with new routes comes unknown dangers! To ensure their caravans get to where they need to go, the Council has appealed to the governors of Egria for help.</color>
 <b>Overview</b>
Escort and loot caravans to earn lavish rewards!
 <b>How to Play</b>
1. This event is split into <color=#ffffff>two trading phases</color>. The first phase will last from the start of the event until 23:59 UTC the same day. The second phase will last from 00:00 UTC on the second day until the end of the event.
2. During each trading period, you'll have <color=#ffffff>2 chances to escort and 2 chances to loot caravans</color>. Unused chances from the first period won't carry over into the second period.
3. After a caravan sets out, it'll start carrying its cargo along a random route through the kingdom. When a caravan you're escorting reaches its destination, you'll be rewarded with its remaining cargo.
 <b>Escorting Caravans</b>
1. <color=#ffffff>At the end of the first day of the second trading period</color>, you'll no longer be able to escort caravans, and will only be able to loot other governors' caravans.
2. You can escort up to <color=#ffffff>2 caravans at a time</color>.
3. Before starting an escort, you can refresh the caravan's rarity. The first refresh for each caravan is free; subsequent refreshes will cost you <color=#ffffff>Rarity Refreshers</color>.
4. Before starting an escort, you'll also need to set up escort troops to defend the caravan.
5. If your escort troops are defeated by an enemy's looter troops, your caravan will lose some of its cargo. Any losses your escort troops incur while fighting against enemy looter troops will be recovered at the end of battle.
6. Units and commanders you assign to escort your caravans can still be used in other scenarios (e.g. on the map).
 <b>Escorting Alliance Caravans</b>
1. The <color=#ffffff>top 10</color> alliances in your kingdom can escort alliance caravans. Each alliance gets <color=#ffffff>one free escort chance per day</color>. After completing the free escort, the alliance leader or a titled officer can purchase a bundle to activate an additional premium alliance caravan.
2. Free alliance caravans need <color=#ffffff>a captain appointed by the leader or an officer</color>. The caravan will automatically set out 4 hours after a captain is appointed. Premium caravans will be captained by the alliance officer who purchased the bundle. Captaining an alliance caravan will not affect your escort chances for personal caravans.
3. Alliance caravan captains can use <color=#ffffff>Rarity Refreshers</color> to refresh their caravan's rewards.
4. Non-captain alliance members can choose a caravan carriage to queue for. When the caravan sets out, 5 random governors in each carriage will be chosen to board. Each governor can travel on an alliance caravan up to <color=#ffffff>2 times</color> per trading period.
5. When the alliance caravan reaches its goal, the captain will be rewarded with all of the caravan's remaining cargo. Passengers will be rewarded with all of their carriage's remaining cargo.
 <b>Looting Caravans</b>
1. If you're in an alliance, you can loot other governors' caravans up to 2 times per trading period.
2. In your original kingdom and pre-Conquest Lost Kingdoms, you can loot the caravans of <color=#ffffff>any governor not in your alliance</color>. In Season of Conquest Lost Kingdoms, you can only loot the caravans of <color=#ffffff>governors not in your coalition</color>.
3. You can search for targets to loot from the event page or the map.

<b><size=30>All Under Heaven</size></b>
<color=#79550a>Conquer the six states and unite All Under Heaven!</color>
 <b>Overview</b>
Step into the shoes of King Ying Zheng of Qin as you follow his journey to becoming Qin Shi Huang. With the mighty armies of Qin at your back, you will conquer your rivals and unify All Under Heaven!
 <b>Starting the Event</b>
1. Challenge stages by tapping their flag on the event map. You can challenge previously-cleared stages.
2. After clearing all stages, you'll unlock <color=#379f1f>Hard Mode</color>.
3. You will be <color=#379f1f>ranked</color> with the rest of your kingdom by how fast you can clear each stage. You can view the rankings for a stage after clearing it.
 <b>How to Play</b>
1. Scattered across each stage's map are regions of differing allegiances.
- Friendly and enemy regions will <color=#379f1f>automatically recruit</color> soldiers over time until they reach their <color=#379f1f>recruitment capacity</color>. Regions won't recruit new soldiers while they're at capacity, but they can still be reinforced with soldiers from other regions.
- Neutral regions will not auto-recruit soldiers. They'll only start recruiting after they're occupied.
2. The higher a region's recruitment capacity, the faster it recruits soldiers.
3. You can mobilize soldiers from your controlled regions to attack <color=#379f1f>neighboring regions</color>. If you win the battle, you'll <color=#379f1f>occupy</color> the region.
4. To win, you must <color=#379f1f>occupy all enemy regions</color>.
5. In each stage, you'll be provided with a set number of support items. You can use them by dragging them to the region you want to use them on.
6. To prevent event data errors, you will be unable to start a challenge during the last 15 minutes of the event.
 <b>Support Items</b>
<color=#379f1f>Raid</color>: Instantly reduces the target region's soldier count by 20. Can only be used on enemy/neutral regions.
<color=#379f1f>Reinforce</color>: Instantly increases the target region's soldier count by 20. Can only be used on friendly regions.
<color=#379f1f>Bolster</color>: Instantly increases the target region's soldier capacity by 20. Can only be used on friendly regions.
 <b>Rewards</b>
Complete challenge quests to unlock rewards. You can claim them via the <color=#379f1f>challenge interface</color>.
Clear the preceding stages to unlock this stage.

<b><size=30>Event Rules</size></b> 
1. Team immigration is only open to returning governors. To help you immigrate to kingdoms in the offseason, the number of Passport Pages needed to immigrate will be reduced.
2. You can only activate the team immigration feature for 1 character on your account. After successfully immigrating through team immigration, you will need to wait some time before using team immigration again. This will not affect the cooldown time for other types of immigration.
3. You can either join or create an immigration team. To help you find a team or recruit for your team, you've been added to an exclusive returning player chat channel.
4. To immigrate, your team's captain needs to submit an application to the kingdom you want to immigrate to. If any member of your team <b>exceeds the power limit for team immigration or is in the Season of Conquest</b>, the application must be approved by the target kingdom's king. Once approved, all members of your team will be able to immigrate there.
If all members of your team are <b>below the power limit for team immigration and no members are in the Season of Conquest</b>, your application will be automatically approved.
5. There is no minimum member requirement for an immigration team. You can create a one-person team if you wish. We recommend contacting the king of your target kingdom in advance via mail.
6. Only kingdoms in the offseason are open to team immigration. Imperium Kingdoms are not open to team immigration at the moment.
7. Incomplete returning player quests and unclaimed returning player rewards will carry over to the new kingdom.
8. If you immigrate through this event, you will appear within a random province of the target kingdom (you cannot choose a specific province).

<b><size=30>Fountain of Dreams</size></b> 
<color=#997336>Whisper your wishes into these wistful waters.</color>
 <b>Overview</b>
Spend Dream Coins to claim amazing rewards!
 <b>Starting the Event</b>
1. Your City Hall must be at least <color=#379f1f>level {p1}</color> to participate in this event.
2. Tap the Wish button on the event page to draw a prize.
 <b>How to Play</b>
1. During this event, you can spend <color=#379f1f>Clamyks</color> to purchase Dream Coins. Dream Coins can be used to draw limited-time city themes and other cosmetics.
2. Whenever you make a wish with Dream Coins, you'll receive either <color=#379f1f>Dream Tickets or a new cosmetic item</color>. Dream Tickets can be used in the Dream Shop to purchase cosmetics and other items.
 <b>Important Notes</b>
1. By making enough wishes, you can claim <color=#E06666>extra Dream Coins and Dream Tickets</color>.

<b><size=30>Dark Fortress Raid</size></b>
<color=#997336>The call to battle has sounded! Rally your alliance, raid Dark Fortresses, and crush the Shadow Legion!</color>
 <b>Overview</b>
Rally your allies, raid Dark Fortresses, earn amazing rewards!
 <b>How to Play</b>
This event is divided into 3 stages:
1. Stage 1: Alliance members can earn Raid Coins by defeating Barbarian Troops on the map. These Raid Coins can be donated via the event page to increase your alliance's damage to the Dark Fortresses.
2. Stage 2: Your alliance leader or a titled officer can select a time and location for your Raid. After summoning up to 3 Dark Fortresses, your alliance can start the Raid.
3. Stage 3: Create rallied armies to attack the Dark Fortresses you summoned.
 <b>Rewards</b>
1. You can earn personal and alliance rewards from this event. Personal rewards are based on how much damage you personally dealt during the Raid, alliance rewards are based on how much damage your alliance dealt in total.
2. The alliance member who deals the highest total damage in the Raid will be the MVP. Depending on how much damage the MVP deals, your alliance rewards can be multiplied by up to 10!
 <b>Important Notes</b>
1. Each alliance can only launch 1 Raid per event, though during the Raid you can attack the same Dark Fortress multiple times.
2. Once your alliance leader or a titled officer sets the Raid time, they can summon a Dark Fortress to the kingdom or Lost Kingdom map (depending on which map they're on currently on). Dark Fortresses cannot be relocated after they're summoned, and all other Dark Fortresses your alliance summons must be summoned to the same map.
3. Each Dark Fortress can be attacked by up to 8 rallied armies at a time.
4. You can only receive rewards from this event once per event. If you deal 0 damage during a Raid, you will not receive any personal or alliance rewards. You'll still be able to earn rewards, however, by taking part in this event with a different alliance.
5. 5 minutes before the raid begins, you won't be able to modify its start time.
6. You cannot start a Raid in the last 60 minutes of the event.
7. At the end of the event, unused Raid Coins will be converted into Individual Credits.
8. You can only attack Dark Fortresses summoned by your own alliance.2

 <b>Overview</b>
Open Elysian Chests for amazing rewards!
 <b>Starting the Event</b>
During this event, you can find <color=#379f1f>Elysian Chests</color> of varying qualities by collecting resources in your city, gathering resources from the map, defeating barbarians, taking part in events, purchasing bundles, and more.
 <b>How to Play</b>
1. You can open your Elysian Chests via the event page. In addition to regular rewards, each Elysian Chest contains a certain number of <color=#379f1f>Elysium Points</color> and <color=#379f1f>Chest Points</color>.
2. Accumulate Elysium Points to increase your Elysian Treasures event level and unlock new rewards. Chest Points can be used to draw and redeem additional Elysian Chests via the event page.
 <b>Important Notes</b>
1. The rewards you can obtain from Elysian Chests will depend on your <color=#E06666>kingdom's season when the event began</color>. If your kingdom enters a new season during or after the event, your Elysian Chest rewards will remain <color=#E06666>unchanged</color>.
2. Your Elysian Chests <color=#E06666>will not be lost</color> at the end of the event. You can open any unopened Elysian Chests in your inventory, but any Elysium Points and Chest Points you would have earned will be <color=#E06666>invalid</color>.

Anniversary Letter
Tap anywhere to continue
<b>Dear Governor,</b>
My name is Da He, the producer of Rise of Kingdoms. It's been an honor fighting alongside all of you for yet another year. Thank you for your support, your patience, your trust, and your enthusiasm. There's no greater motivation in our endless pursuit of excellence.
Over the past year, we've crossed mountains and seas, meeting all of you by sapphire waves of Sanya, amidst the chirping cranes of Seoul, under the brilliant fireworks of Ho Chi Minh City, beneath the glimmering lights of Dubai, upon the placid waters of Hangzhou's West Lake, and above the criss-crossed canals of Amsterdam. Every online Roundtable has connected us across continents, and every Bonfire in Asia and Europe has allowed us to hear your voices more clearly than ever.
All your suggestions have left a lasting impression on us; they are a precious currency that guides our way forward. In response to governor requests for <b>quality of life</b> improvements, we've added one-tap reward collection, Crusader Flag pre-planning, and more. We've worked tirelessly to <b>optimize performance</b>, alleviating persistent issues like input lag.
Through the attack march feature, our efforts to reduce micromanagement, new commander mechanics, and the Acclaim system, we've made combat <b>freer and more enjoyable</b>. We've also paid significant attention to a persistent bugbear within the community: Lost Kingdom matchmaking. In our ongoing efforts to improve your combat experience, we'll continue to <b>prioritize matchmaking optimization</b> going forward.
We've made major improvements to the <b>armament system</b>, implementing a guarantee system for attribute transmutation, adding new ways to acquire Transmutation Stones, and more. Taking into account governor feedback, we also started pioneer testing our comprehensive <b>Crystal technology rework</b>, making it easier to focus on improving single units and adding QoL features like custom Rune summoning.
This was by no means a lonely road; all these changes have been a joint effort between our team and all of you. We've come this far due to everyone's enthusiasm and support, and we'll go even further with your understanding and company. We know as well as anyone that what we've accomplished is far from enough. We promise to make sure your voices are heard, to earnestly strive for excellence every day, and to reward your continued love for Rise of Kingdoms.
In addition to listening to your feedback, we're always looking for <b>ways to innovate and new avenues to explore</b>. Our first Lost Kingdom key story
this year's <b>King of All Britain</b>
was one of our most ambitious yet. Taking governors back to the war-torn lands of 9th-century England, the story introduced novel mechanics like Burh Raiding, Holmgang duels, and a unique artifact for Prime Ragnar Lodbrok. Outside of KvK, our <b>All Under Heaven event</b> placed you in the shoes of the mighty Qin Shi Huang, unifying the warring states and conquering chaos in a brand-new game mode.
The <b>SVIP system</b> introduced new ways to stand out, introducing new types of cosmetics like marching effects, teleport effects, and more. As for meat-and-potatoes combat, we've added commanders, accessories, and formations for <b>smite and combo damage builds</b>, giving you tons of new strategies to vanquish your enemies.
In the year to come, we'll be launching a new key story: <b>Song of Troy</b>. Recreating the legendary conflict between the Greek coalition and the Trojan alliance, this story will be a battle worthy of a Homeric epic. In addition, a new <b>Ark of Osiris</b> revamp will be bringing new battlefield skills and map mechanics, adding a fresh coat of paint to one of our most popular game modes.
We'll also continue updating and optimizing recurring events, giving you more fun activities to do outside of combat. As for <b>controls and performance</b>, we'll be continuing to add new optimizations to deliver you a smoother, more convenient gaming experience.
The bar you set for us is what drives our innovation; the trust you place in us gives us the courage to explore. Though we may have already walked an epic journey together, there's still a long road ahead of us. We'll continue to work towards our original vision, listen to the guidance of our governors, and build RoK into what it was meant to be. Thank you for every day and night you've been by our side. Let's continue writing new legends and exploring the infinite possibilities that lie in store!#
Da He, Producer of Rise of Kingdoms

<b><size=30>Zenith of Power</size></b>
 <color=#997336>Who will ascend to the Zenith of Power?</color>
 <b>Overview</b>
Increase your power and fight for rank to earn bountiful rewards.
 <b>Starting the Event</b>
1. Increase your power during this event (not counting commander power and equipment power) to earn points.
2. Point quests and rewards can be found on the event page.
 <b>Points</b>
1. You will be ranked based on your individual points earned.
2. You will earn <color=#379f1f>1 point</color> each time you increase your power by 1.
3. In the event of a tie, the winner will be decided by who reached their final point total first.
 <b>Rewards</b>
1. Complete quests during the event to earn rewards.
2. Repeatable quests can be completed multiple times. Each time you complete one, you'll earn Zenith Badges.
3. You can exchange Zenith Badges in the Zenith Shop for the current Zenith of Power city theme, city theme effects, and other items.
4. You'll earn additional <color=#379f1f>rank rewards</color> based on your ranking in the point leaderboard. 
5. The Zenith Shop will only open after rankings are concluded. The Shop will remain open for 1 day.
 <b>Important Notes</b>
1. If you <color=#E06666>immigrate</color>, your ranking points will be <color=#E06666>cleared</color>, but your event quest progress will not be reset.
2. At the end of the event, any unused Zenith Badges will be lost.

<b><size=30>Trial of Torgny</size></b> 
<color=#997336>Who dares defy the raging storm?</color>
 <b>Overview</b>
Challenge the mighty Chief Torgny to earn valiant rewards!
 <b>Starting the Event</b>
Once Torgny appears, all governors in the kingdom with a <color=#379f1f>level 8 or higher</color> City Hall can dispatch troops to challenge him.
 <b>How to Play</b>
1. From Monday to Saturday at 00:00, 06:00, 12:00, and 18:00 UTC, Torgny will appear in your kingdom for <color=#379f1f>3 hours</color>.
2. You can find Torgny via the event page or the map.
3. You can challenge Torgny up to <color=#379f1f>5 times a day</color>. He <color=#379f1f>cannot be rally attacked</color>.
 <b>Rewards</b>
1. You can earn rewards by challenging Torgny a certain number of times.
2. Each day, you'll be ranked with other governors in your kingdom by your <color=#379f1f>highest damage dealt in a single challenge</color>. The top-ranked governors every day will receive additional rewards.
 <b>Important Notes</b>
1. Each milestone quest reward can only be claimed <color=#E06666>once per character</color>.
2. Torgny and his cohort are elite barbarians. Buffs and skills that increase damage dealt to barbarians or reduce damage received from barbarians <color=#E06666>will not affect them</color>.$

<b><size=30>Jeweler's Jaunt</size></b>
<color=#997336>Catch up to the pack with shiny new equipment!</color>
 <b>Overview</b>
Take part in the Shining Resolve event to get Artisan Coins. Spend your Artisan Coins in the Equipment Shop to purchase Legendary accessory blueprints!
 <b>Shining Resolve</b>
Take part in this event to earn Artisan Coins!
1. During this event, you can earn EXP, increase your event level, and unlock new rewards by completing Weekly Challenges and Season Challenges.
2. Weekly Challenges are time-limited, and will be refreshed when the timer runs out. Once they are refreshed, you will lose all EXP from uncompleted challenges or completed challenges whose rewards you haven't claimed. Please make sure to claim your rewards before the timer runs out.
3. You can purchase EXP items with <color=#379f1f>Gems</color> from the shop, or you can directly purchase EXP with <color=#379f1f>Flux Scrips</color>.
4. If you purchase the Hidden Jewels bundle, you can claim an extra reward every level.
5. At the end of the event, unclaimed rewards will be sent to your inventory and unused Artisan Coins will be <color=#E06666>lost</color>.
6. This event will immediately end if you immigrate to another kingdom. Entering or exiting the Lost Kingdom will not affect this event.
 <b>Equipment Shop</b>
Exchange your Artisan Coins for Legendary accesory blueprints!
1. In the Equipment Shop, you can exchange the Artisan Coins you earned from the Shining Resolve event for Legendary accessory blueprints.
2. After <color=#E06666>purchasing everything</color> in the Normal section of the Shop, you'll unlock the Advanced section.
3. The stock of items in the Advanced section depends on your equipment upgrade progress. The greater the gap between your equipment upgrade progress and other Season of Conquest governors, the more items will be in stock.

<b><size=30>Epic Cycle</size></b>
<color=#79550a>Fan the flames of war across the Aegean!</color>
 <b>Overview</b>
Lead the forces of the Greek coalition in their epic struggle to capture Troy.
 <b>Starting the Event</b>
1. Challenge stages by tapping their icons on the event map. You can challenge previously-cleared stages.
2. After clearing all stages, you'll unlock <color=#379f1f>Hard Mode</color>.
3. You will be <color=#379f1f>ranked</color> with the rest of your kingdom by how fast you can clear each stage. The leaderboard also tracks who cleared each stage <color=#379f1f>with items</color> and <color=#379f1f>without items</color>. You can view the rankings for a stage after clearing it.
 <b>How to Play</b>
1. Scattered across each stage's map are regions of differing allegiances.
- Friendly and enemy regions will <color=#379f1f>automatically recruit</color> soldiers over time until they reach their <color=#379f1f>recruitment capacity</color>. Regions won't recruit new soldiers while they're at capacity, but they can still be reinforced with soldiers from other regions.
- Neutral regions will not auto-recruit soldiers. They'll only start recruiting after they're occupied.
2. The higher a region's recruitment capacity, the faster it recruits soldiers.
3. You can mobilize armies from your controlled regions to attack <color=#379f1f>neighboring regions</color>. If you win the battle, you'll <color=#379f1f>occupy</color> the region.
4. To win, you must <color=#379f1f>occupy all enemy regions</color>.
5. In each stage, you'll be provided with a set number of support items. You can use them by dragging them to the region you want to use them on.
6. On Hard Mode, you can choose what support items to bring. For an added challenge and bragging rights, you can also choose to not bring any items at all.
7. To prevent event data errors, you will be unable to start a challenge during the last 15 minutes of the event.
 <b>Support Items</b>
<b>Raid</b>: Reduces the target region's soldier count by 20.
<b>Reinforce</b>: Increases the target region's soldier count by 15.
<b>Bolster</b>: Increases the target region's soldier capacity by 15.
<b>Trojan Horse</b>: Reduces the target region's soldier count by 5 and dispatches an army to capture it.
<b>Spear Rain</b>: Reduces the soldier count of all enemy armies moving towards the target region by 10.
<b>Army Group</b>: Instantly dispatches all friendly soldiers within 2 regions to the target region.
 <b>Special Terrain</b>
<b>Harbor</b>: Can be used to move your soldiers to any other Harbor.
<b>Volcano</b>: Armies in the Volcano's region lose soldiers over time.
<b>Acropolis</b>: Any armies attacking the Acropolis lose soldiers over time (including armies that haven't arrived yet).
 <b>Rewards</b>
Complete challenge quests to unlock rewards. You can claim them via the challenge page.

<b><size=30>Expedition Expert</size></b>
 <color=#997336>A long journey lies before you; will you see it to its end?</color>
 <b>Overview</b>
Complete Expedition missions, get on the leaderboard, and earn tons of rewards.
 <b>Requirements</b>
To take part in this event, you need to have completed <color=#379f1f>mission {p1}</color> of Expedition mode. You also need to have a <color=#379f1f>historical highest power of at least {p2}</color>.
 <b>How to Play</b>
1. This event consists of <color=#379f1f>{p3} Expedition missions</color>.
2. To clear a mission, you must defeat all enemy troops within the time limit.
 <b>Points</b>
1. After clearing a mission, your score will be calculated based on your units remaining.
2. Different tiers of units have different point values. You will earn points for <color=#379f1f>every {p4} units</color> of a given tier you have remaining. If the number of units is not divisible by {p4}, the remainder will be rounded up and treated as {p4}.
3. Below are the point values for {p4} units of each tier:
- Tier 3 or lower: +{p5} points
- Tier 4: +{p6} points
- Tier 5: +{p7} points
4. If you have less than {p4} remaining units for a given tier, it will be counted as <color=#379f1f>{p4} remaining units</color> for the purposes of calculating your mission score.
5. You can challenge a mission multiple times, but only your <color=#379f1f>highest score</color> will be recorded.
6. Your <color=#379f1f>overall score</color> will be the average of your <color=#379f1f>highest scores for each mission</color>.
7. If you clear <color=#379f1f>mission 10</color>, you'll be able to participate in the rankings. You'll be ranked against other governors by your overall score.
 <b>Rewards</b>
1. Whenever you <color=#379f1f>clear a mission for the first time</color>, you will receive a mission reward.
2. At the end of the event, you may also receive a reward based on your ranking.
 <b>Event Bundles</b>
1. During the event, you'll be able to purchase exclusive "booster" bundles.
2. Boosters are divided into construction, research, and training boosters. Each booster type is divided into <color=#379f1f>5 tiers</color>.
3. In each instance of this event, you can only purchase <color=#379f1f>one type of booster</color> for each tier. <color=#379f1f>Each tier can only be purchased once</color>.
 <b>Important Notes</b>
1. If you don't complete <color=#E06666>mission 10</color>, you <color=#E06666>won't be ranked</color> for this event.
2. You will have <color=#E06666>{p8} challenge chances</color> per day. To maximize your score, you'll need to find the best way to divide these challenge chances between the various missions.
3. Each instance of this event will have different leaderboard ranges. Tap the "Cross-Kingdom" tag on the main event page to learn more.
4. In the first instance of this event, you will only be ranked with governors in your own kingdom. In subsequent instances, you will also be ranked with governors from three other kingdoms in your region.
5. The total number of missions may vary from instance to instance.
<b><size=30>Arms Training</size></b>
 <color=#997336>Armsmaster Lohar has organized a session of Arms Training. Use this opportunity to gain valuable battle experience!</color>
 <b>Overview</b>
Spar with Lohar, earn points, and open chests.
 <b>How to Play</b>
1. At the start of the event, you'll unlock difficulty levels based on your current power. Select a difficulty level to start the training session. The difficulty levels you've already unlocked will carry over into the next instance of this event.
2. You can only use one troop for the entire duration of each training session. In other words, all battles in a single session have to be fought by the same troop. Until the session ends, the troop must stay on the map and <color=#379f1f>cannot be healed or reinforced</color>.
3. At the beginning of each training session, Armsmaster Lohar will have 2 <color=#379f1f>starting skills</color> and 1 <color=#379f1f>active skill</color>.
4. Every <color=#379f1f>2 times</color> you defeat Lohar's troop, he will level up and activate a new skill. Before the session starts, you can pre-configure the order in which Lohar activates new skills.
5. You can adjust Lohar's skill activation order between challenges.
6. If your troop is defeated, returns to your city, or defeats a fully-upgraded Lohar 2 times (or if you give up the session), the session will end and your score will be calculated.
 <b>Points</b>
1. Every time you defeat Lohar's troop, you will earn an amount of points based on your chosen difficulty (at least <color=#379f1f>10,000</color> points).
2. If your troop is defeated midway, you will gain bonus points based on what percentage of Lohar's units you defeated in your last battle (multiplied by 10,000).
3. If you defeat a fully-upgraded Lohar 2 times, you will earn bonus points based on the percentage of units remaining in your troop (multiplied by 10,000).
4. You can conduct multiple training sessions. Your cumulative score across all sessions will be used to unlock new reward chests.
5. If you give up the training session or return your troop to your city, you will not receive any bonus points for the session.
6. Your leaderboard score will be your highest score in a single training session.
 <b>Rewards</b>
1. You can unlock new reward chests by reaching certain <color=#379f1f>point milestones</color>.
2. At the end of the event, you will receive additional rank rewards based on your event ranking.
 <b>Important Notes</b>
1. Armsmaster Lohar's units are elite barbarians. Buffs and skills that increase damage dealt to barbarians or reduce damage received from barbarians <color=#E06666>will not affect them</color>.
2. If your server is taken down for maintenance, <color=#E06666>any ongoing training sessions will be terminated</color>. If you receive a notification of impending server maintenance, please be sure to complete your current training session before the server goes offline.

<b><size=30>Wheel of Fortune</size></b>
<color=#997336>Wheel of Fortune, turn turn turn!</color>
 <b>Overview</b>
Spin the wheel to receive rewards.
 <b>Starting the Event</b>
Tap the button on the event page to spin the wheel and draw a prize.
 <b>Rewards</b>
1. You will receive rewards based on where the pointer stops when the wheel stops spinning.
2. You can claim <color=#379f1f>bonus rewards</color> when you've spun the wheel enough times. Tap the treasure chest icon in the top-left corner of the event page to claim them.
 <b>Important Notes</b>

 <b>Shining Resolve</b>
Earn Artisan Coins!
1. During this event, you can earn EXP, increase your event level, and unlock new rewards by completing Weekly Challenges and Season Challenges.
2. Weekly Challenges are time-limited, and will be refreshed when the timer runs out. Once they are refreshed, you will lose all EXP from uncompleted challenges or completed challenges whose rewards you haven't claimed. Please make sure to claim your rewards before the timer runs out.

3. The quantity of exchangeable equipment blueprints in the Serendipity Store is determined by the time interval between when blueprints were first available in game and when governors first entered the Season of Conquest.
If a blueprint became available in the Season Shop (Season of Conquest) after you already entered the Season of Conquest, you will not be able to exchange for it.
If a blueprint became available in the Season Shop (Season of Conquest) before you entered the Season of Conquest, but the time interval is less than a full season period, you will not be able to exchange for it.
If a blueprint became available in the Season Shop (Season of Conquest) before you entered the Season of Conquest, and the time interval is greater than a full season period, you will be able to exchange for it. The exact purchasable quantity depends on the specific time interval.
4. Different blueprints count towards the same purchase quota.

PREMIUM CITY THEME CUSTOMIZATION RULES
Customization Process
Customization Requirements
Legal Compliance
Production Process
Rules and Update
About Customization Process
You may choose a city theme from <b>"{p1}", "{p2}", and "{p3}"</b> for paid customization. More city themes will be available for customization in the future.p
<color=#ba7b1c>A demo of the city themes currently available for customization is displayed on the left.</color>
You can specify city modules as shown in the example image for customization. If you have special requests, we also support customizing the city atmosphere and other elements.
City Effects
Primary Decorations
Secondary Decorations
Art Style Consistency
Your customization requests should also align with the game's medieval setting and visual style. To maintain consistency with the current in-game environment, please avoid elements that are heavily <b>fantasy-based, sci-fi, or modern</b> (e.g., dragons, mecha).
Limits on Primary Decorations
Each customized city theme may include <b>one primary decoration</b> and multiple secondary decorations. The primary decoration should occupy no more than <b>30%</b> of the overall theme.
Designs that include more than one primary decoration will not meet the customization requirements (e.g., a large animal combined with a large object as separate elements).E
<b>City theme customization is subject to limitations</b>. See the city theme questionnaire for details.
The final right of interpretation rests with RoK Group. We will determine whether elements qualify as primary or secondary decorations based on factors such as production complexity and their actual visual presentation.
Limits on Creature Sculptures#
1. If an animal or character is chosen as the primary decoration, it will be presented as a sculpture or with visual effects.
2. Creature sculptures must be paired with their corresponding building elements. A creature sculpture on its own cannot serve as a complete city theme.
3. Human-like elements cannot depict third-party copyrighted characters. They may represent mythological figures or officially existing commanders in the game. (Commander appearances and color schemes cannot be altered, though certain animations may be modified.)
4. City themes with a strong cultural style should not feature commanders from a different culture. For example, a Chinese-style theme cannot use Minamoto no Yoshitsune as the decorative character.
5. Only one official commander may appear in a city theme.6
Must Not Conflict with Official Lore or Future ContentR
During the customization process, we will take upcoming game content into consideration to ensure your design does not conflict with or duplicate themes planned for future updates. For example, if a specific theme or similar elements are scheduled for release, those elements may not be available for the customization of your city theme.
Intellectual Property`
1. All intellectual property rights and related interests (including but not limited to copyrights, trademark rights, and patent rights) for all output generated under this event (including final and draft custom designs, art assets, icons, and supporting content, etc.) shall at all times remain the sole and exclusive property of Rise of Kingdoms. Some elements may be used in the game in the future.
2. Upon completing the payment in accordance with the event rules, you will receive a limited license to use the customized item within the officially designated service period and game environment. If the customized item is a virtual asset bound to your game account, you may not transfer, sell, rent, lend, or use it for any commercial purpose in any form.
3. If your account is compromised or if assets are lost due to personal reasons (including but not limited to account theft, account sharing, or account suspension), the customized theme will not transfer with any change in the account's actual controller. Rise of Kingdoms is not liable for the return, restoration, or compensation of the customized item.
Content Compliance
Your customization requests, instructions, and any materials you provide must not infringe on the legal rights of any individual. You are responsible for verifying the source of any reference materials you provide and must explain the source and provide evidence as required by Rise of Kingdoms.
Your requests must be detailed and accurate and must not be misleading, impede the identification of potential infringements, or lead to the creation of works that violate others' rights.
Your customization requests, instructions, and any materials you provide must not include content that violates applicable laws or contains elements with political, religious, or legal risks, including but not limited to:
- Content depicting blood, sexual content, extreme violence, terror, drugs, abuse, cruelty, massacres, or other elements that may cause physical or psychological discomfort.
- Content involving discrimination, hate speech, or denigration based on race, gender, nationality, religion, or targeting specific groups.
- Content depicting or encouraging dangerous activities or unsafe items, or otherwise unsuitable for dissemination.
- Content involving national leaders, political parties, national symbols such as flags or emblems, sensitive events, or politically controversial topics.
- Symbols, slogans, gambling, or other elements that may be offensive, defamatory, divisive, or incite controversy.
- Any religious symbols, sect icons, religious rituals, content that is religiously inflammatory, provides incorrect or misleading descriptions of religion, or any other content of a religious nature.
- Content that may involve or harm children or minors.
- Other content not explicitly listed but that violates public order and good morals in any region, or that is inconsistent with the purpose and values of this event or the official Service License Agreement.
Rise of Kingdoms reserves the right to review and verify your customization requests, instructions, and any submitted materials. If we believe there may be any violations of these rules, we have the right to reject the relevant requests or materials. You are required to modify or replace them according to our guidance within the specified timeframe until your requests and submissions comply with the above rules. Official review does not imply that the we assume any responsibility for your requests or materials.
You are solely responsible for any legal liabilities arising from violations of these rules. We reserve the right to seek compensation for any losses incurred as a result, and may, depending on the severity of the situation, suspend or terminate the customization service and remove the relevant customized items from the platform. Any fees already paid will not be refunded.
Customization Time0
1. City Theme Customization aims to deliver a refined, high-quality result. The design and production process is expected to take at least <b>4 months</b>.
2. The schedule for sketch production will be arranged based on the time of payment. You will be notified in advance of your scheduled slot. If the brief is not finalized <b>15 business days</b> prior to the scheduled sketch production, the schedule may be postponed, and your slot may no longer follow the original production order. This may also impact the overall production timeline.
3. We encourage Governors to communicate promptly and thoroughly with us to ensure the brief can be confirmed in a timely manner, avoiding delays to the production schedule.
4. Please note that an accurate production schedule can only be provided after the initial design sketches have been created. We will do our best to complete the project within <b>4 months</b> of confirming the brief, but the specific timeframe may vary depending on the complexity of the design and the amount of communication and revisions required.
Production and Revision Rules{
The production of a custom city theme involves multiple stages, including brief confirmation, concept art production, model production, animation, and special effects. Each stage requires time and resources, and modifications at any stage may affect the overall production timeline. To ensure a smooth production process and minimize delays, the following rules apply:
1. <b>Brief Revisions</b>: Your brief can be adjusted and revised up to <b>1 week</b> before the start of artwork creation.
2. <b>Revision Limit</b>: Once the project enters the concept art production stage, a maximum of <b>3 revisions</b> is allowed throughout the entire production process. Please review each revision carefully.
3. <b>Irreversible Process</b>: We will confirm the results with you at each stage of production. Once a stage is completed, <b>it cannot be modified retroactively</b>. Please ensure that all requirements are fully communicated and confirmed before proceeding to the next stage.
4. <b>Refund Policy</b>: After your customized city theme has progressed to the <b>concept art production stage</b>, <b>refund requests will no longer be accepted</b>.
Duplication Content Reminder
- During the review stage, we will notify you if your submission contains content with a higher degree of duplication. If you approve, production will proceed, and we will strive to provide differentiated designs. If you do not approve, we will work with you to create a new design. Please note that once a brief has been finalized or launched, it cannot be modified.
(Duplicate content includes but is not limited to common elements, such as basic animals, or using similar decorative elements on the same type of building.)
- If duplicate content leads to copyright disputes, we reserve the right to suspend the customization process until the issue is fully resolved.
Design Review Process*
After you submit your design proposal questionnaire, our team will review the submission.
We will communicate with you, provide feedback, and make necessary adjustments based on the above rules to ensure that your custom design meets your expectations while complying with the game's regulations.
Rise of Kingdoms reserves the right to final interpretation.
We will continuously optimize the customization rules based on actual situations and more city-themed cases, aiming to provide you with a better service experience.

<b><size=30>Feast of Conquest</size></b>
<color=#997336>It's time to rally! Destroy Barbarian Forts for rewards!</color>
 <b>Event Overview</b>
During the event, launch or join rallies against Barbarian Forts, and earn rich rewards along with contribution points to compete in rankings! Launching rallies also restore action points!
 <b>Event Rules</b>
1. The event lasts 7 days, with all quests resetting daily at <color=#379f1f> UTC 00:00</color>.
2. Governors can earn contributions points each day by launching or joining rallies against Barbarian Forts.
3. Upon <color=#379f1f>launching rallies and successfully destroying</color> Barbarian Forts for a specific number of times each day, you may claim <color=#379f1f>action points </color>on the event page. Please note that only rallies you launch as <color=#379f1f>captain</color> are counted for this purpose, whereas joining a rally will not grant progress.
4. During the event, you will be ranked based on your contribution points gained from various activities.
 <b>Earning Contribution Points</b>
1. <b>Launching rallies</b>: Launching a rally as captain and successfully destroying a Barbarian Fort earns you <color=#379f1f>20 contributions points</color>;
2. <b>Joining rallies</b>: Joining an ally's rally and successfully destroying a Barbarian Fort earns you <color=#379f1f>5 contribution points</color>.
 <b>Important Notes</b>
 1. Daily quest rewards must be <color=#E06666>promptly claimed each day</color>. Please make sure to claim your rewards before they expire the next day.
 2. Only <color=#E06666>successfully destroying</color> a Barbarian Fort grants contribution points. Failed or forfeited attempts do not.
 3. Quick access from the event page: tap "Go" to quickly locate any fort targets on the map, and tap "Join" to quickly open the Alliance War interface.

Weathered Brilliance
Weathered BrillianceA
The most weathered tactician delivers the most brilliant victory!
<b><size=30>Weathered Brilliance</size></b>
<color=#79550a>The most weathered tactician delivers the most brilliant victory!</color>
 <b>Event Overview</b>
A good tactician applies the five fundamental factors of military strategy, and a good commander decides matters through victory. Explore the various teachings of stratagems on the battlefield.
 <b>Joining the Event</b>
1. Challenge stages by tapping their icons. You can challenge previously-cleared stages.
2. After clearing all stages, you'll unlock <color=#379f1f>Hard Mode</color>.
3. You will be <color=#379f1f>ranked</color> with the rest of your kingdom by how fast you can clear each stage. The leaderboard also tracks who cleared each stage <color=#379f1f>with items</color> and <color=#379f1f>without items</color>. You can view the rankings for a stage after clearing it.
 <b>How to Play</b>
1. Scattered across each stage's map are regions of differing allegiances:
- Friendly and enemy regions will <color=#379f1f>automatically recruit</color> soldiers over time until they reach their <color=#379f1f>recruitment capacity</color>.
- Neutral regions will not auto-recruit soldiers. They'll only start recruiting after they're occupied.
2. The higher a region's recruitment capacity, the faster it recruits soldiers.
3. You can mobilize armies from your controlled regions to attack <color=#379f1f>neighboring regions</color>. If you win the battle, you'll <color=#379f1f>occupy</color> the region.
4. To win, you must <color=#379f1f>occupy all enemy regions</color>.
5. In each stage, you'll be provided with a set number of support items. You can use them by dragging them to the region you want to use them on.
6. On Hard Mode, you can choose what support items to bring. For an added challenge and bragging rights, you can also choose to not bring any items at all.
7. To prevent event data errors, you will be unable to start a challenge during the last 15 minutes of the event.
 <b>Support Items</b>
<b>Raid</b>: Reduces the target region's soldier count by 20.
<b>Reinforce</b>: Increases the target region's soldier count by 20.
<b>Bolster</b>: Increases the target region's soldier capacity by 20.
<b>Bloodless Victory</b>: Reduces the target region's soldier count by 5 and dispatches an army to capture it.
<b>Spear Rain</b>: Reduces the soldier count of all enemy armies moving towards the target region by 10.
<b>Army Group</b>: Instantly dispatches all friendly soldiers within 2 regions to the target region.
 <b>Special Terrain</b>
<b>Harbor</b>: Can be used to move your soldiers to any other Harbor and will not engage with armies on land.
<b>Volcano</b>: Armies in the Volcano's region lose soldiers over time.

<b><size=30>Zenith of Power</size></b>
 <color=#997336>Who will ascend to the Zenith of Power?</color>
 <b>Event Overview</b>
Increase your power and fight for rank to earn bountiful rewards.
 <b>Joining the Event</b>
1. Increase your power during this event (not counting commander power and equipment power) to earn points.
2. Point quests and rewards can be found on the event page.
 <b>Points</b>
1. You will be ranked based on your individual points earned.
2. You will earn <color=#379f1f>1 point</color> each time you increase your power by 1.
3. In the event of a tie, the winner will be decided by who reached their final point total first.
 <b>Rewards</b>
1. Complete quests during the event to earn rewards.
2. Repeatable quests can be completed multiple times. Each time you complete one, you'll earn Zenith Badges.
3. You can exchange Zenith Badges in the Zenith Shop for the current Zenith of Power city theme, city theme effects, and other items.
4. You'll earn additional <color=#379f1f>rank rewards</color> based on your ranking in the points leaderboard. 
5. The Zenith Shop will only open after rankings are concluded. The Shop will remain open for 1 day.
6. The Zenith Shop contains 2 sections for new city themes and past city themes. You can use Zenith Badges to exchange for current Zenith of Power city themes and corresponding custom decorations, and you can use Faded Zenith Badges to exchange for past city themes.
7. Within designated time periods, Zenith Badges can be converted into Faded Zenith Badges at a 1 to 1 ratio.
 <b>Important Notes</b>
1. If you <color=#E06666>immigrate</color>, your ranking points will be <color=#E06666>cleared</color>, but your event quest progress will not be reset.
2. After the event ends, any unused Zenith Badges will be automatically converted into <color=#E06666>Faded Zenith Badges</color>.
3. After the event ends, Faded Zenith Badges <color=#E06666>won't be lost</color>.r

Event Overview
General Rules
Combat
From faraway lands across Egria, legends speak of remnants of an ancient power residing on the Divine Isles. Now, kingdoms reign over its fractured territories, each vying for statues of divine authority.
Across the Divine Isles are territories belonging to <color=#e68526>different kingdoms</color>. Your key objective is to <color=#e68526>conquer statues on foreign territories</color> to earn points.
First, you must <color=#e68526>deploy troops to serve as Statue Sentries during the Preparation phase</color> to automatically keep watch near statues in your territory. In the <color=#e68526>subsequent Invasion phase, you must either lead your troops</color> to invade foreign territory of other kingdoms, or defend that of your own.
After battle begins, you will <color=#e68526>earn points from defeating roaming troops, Statue Sentries, and enemy defending troops, or from conquering statues</color>.
After time-limited rounds of intense offensive and defensive battles, you will earn rewards based on your placement in point rankings. Your single highest record will be used to contribute to your kingdom's overall ranking.
Countless warriors have gathered here. Some have sworn to defend their soils to the last breath, while others set sights on conquests of foreign land. Under the gods' watchful gaze, only the greatest of them all shall leave their kingdom's mark in the Annals of the Divine Isles.#
 The Annals of Divine Isles event consists of 4 phases: Preparation, Matchmaking, Invasion, and Settlement.
<b>Preparation Phase</b>:
- During this phase, your <color=#e68526>city hall must be at least level {p1}</color> for you to participate with your kingdom.
- During Preparation, you may <color=#e68526>deploy troops to serve as Statue Sentries</color>. Statue Sentries will automatically appear near random statues to keep guard.
<b>Matchmaking Phase</b>: Depending on kingdom strength, 3-4 kingdoms in the same season will be matched to the same Divine Isles map.
<b>Invasion Phase</b>: This phase lasts {p2} days and alternates between battle and rest periods.
- Battle Period: From {p3}-{p4} and {p5}-{p6} UTC every day, statues are open for conquest.
- Rest Period: Outside of battle periods, statues will not be accessible. However, if a previous invasion or defense campaign still has time remaining when the rest period begins, the campaign may continue until it is complete.
<b>Settlement Phase</b>: Gain rewards based on individual and kingdom point rankings.
 Invasion Phase Combat Rules:
You may deploy <color=#e68526>1 Preset Troop</color> for the following purposes:
<b>Invade Foreign Territory (Invasion)</b>:
- Chances and Duration: Each governor has {p7} daily invasion chances, each limited to {p8} minutes.
- Additional Invasion Time: Defeating roaming troops, Statue Sentries, or enemy defending troops will grant additional invasion time (for up to {p9} minutes total in a single invasion).
- Invading Parties: You may choose to either invade by yourself or invade with a team. Team invasions can have up to <color=#e68526>5 governors</color> in total and are initiated by the team captain.
<b>Defend Kingdom Territory (Defense)</b>:
- Chances and Duration: There are no limits to defense attempts. However, only {p10} minutes are allowed each time you enter to defend your territory, and you must wait for a cooldown of {p11} minutes in between defense attempts.
- Defending Parties: You must carry out defense attempts by yourself and not with a team.
 Blessings Shop
- Complete quests to earn <color=#e68526>Divine Emblems</color>.
- Divine Emblems can be used to redeem items in the Blessings Shop. You will not lose unused emblems at the end of the event.
 Points and Rewards
- You will earn points when you defeat roaming troops, Statue Sentries, and enemy defending troops, or when you conquer statues.
- Team Bonuses: When conquering statues in team invasions, members earn {p12}% of points, and captains earn {p13}%; when conquering statues in individual invasions by yourself, you earn {p14}% of points.
- Total Kingdom Points:
Your daily record of most points earned from a single invasion automatically counts towards your kingdom's points.
Each time the battle period ends, all unconquered statues in your kingdom territory will have their points tallied and count towards your kingdom's points.
 Ranks
Based on overall strength, you will be assigned 1 of 5 ranks by the system: <color=#e68526>Explorer Bronze, Sentinel Copper, Conqueror Silver, Protector Gold, and Divine Vessel</color>.
- Rank Buffs: The higher your rank, the better the buffs given to your deployed troops during the event (including Statue Sentries and preset troops for invasion and defense). For those with the same rank, the strength of buffs may vary, depending on overall differences in commanders, equipment, and armaments.
- Special Rewards: If you conquer a statue guarded by Statue Sentries of a governor whose kingdom rank is in the top {p15}, you will earn extra point rewards.7
In the Clash of Divine Isles event, basic combat rules are identical to those on the regular map. All participating governors will be able to hold & drag troops across the Divine Isles.
 Special Rules
- Teleport: You can directly teleport troops to various locations in the Divine Isles. However, there is a cooldown of {p1} seconds, and you won't be able to teleport to certain restricted areas.
- Death and resurrection: In the Divine Isles, defeated troops will enter spectate mode instead of Hospitals. After a resurrection countdown, your units will revive fully at random resurrection points, followed by a short period of resurrection protection.
- Switching areas: You may freely switch areas in the Divine Isles. View remaining statues in any area and their points worth to engage strategically. While in battle, however, you cannot switch areas.
 Divine Gaze
If you achieve extraordinary performance on the battlefield, you will fall under <color=#e68526>Divine Gaze</color> and draw everyone's attention.
Governors under Divine Gaze will see a red warning border on their screen, and their location will be marked on the map for enemies.
<b>First Divine Gaze</b>
You will fall under Divine Gaze for the first time when you meet any of the following conditions:
1. Accrue {p2} minutes of invasion time in a single invasion;
2. Defeat a total of {p3} enemy defending troops;
3. Actively attack a statue.
<b>End of Divine Gaze</b>
The gods will turn away their gaze when you meet any of the following conditions:
1. Your troop is defeated;
2. Invasion time has ended, or if you exit the Divine Isles battlefield.
<b>Repeated Divine Gaze</b>
Within one event period after Divine Gaze has been lost, you will activate it once more when you meet any of the following conditions:
1. Defeat another {p4} enemy defending troops;
2. Actively attack a statue once more.
 Skills
Both the invading and defending party have specific skills that can be accessed near the profile of deployed commanders in your march queue.
1. <color=#e68526>Stealth: An invade skill</color> that can be used in battle. When used, your troop will become invisible after a brief period of time. You will exit invisibility upon launching an attack, or when the skill's duration ends.
2. <color=#e68526>Charge: A defense skill</color>. When attacking a target troop, you may enter Charge mode once in range, which allows your troop to quickly charge to the target and reduce its March Speed.
3. <color=#e68526>Recover: A general skill</color>. When used, you will continuously recover units for {p5} seconds. Recovery will be interrupted if you suffer damage while recovering.
4. <color=#e68526>Focus Fire: A skill only usable by captains</color>. When used, all troops of your team within range will automatically concentrate attacks on a target marked by your captain. A special crosshair icon will be displayed above the target under focus fire.
5. <color=#e68526>Assembly: A skill only usable by captains</color>. When used, the captain can summon surviving team troops currently not engaged in battle to the captain's location. Summoned teammates can choose to accept or reject the summon; after the summon notification ends, however, they will be teleported by default. This skill cannot be used to teleport troops to restricted areas.
 Buffs
Event buffs: After signing up for the Divine Isles event, you will obtain rank buffs based on the strength of your commanders, equipment, and armaments. Additional buffs for damage, Health, Defense, and unit capacity will be given accordingly in the Divine Isles.
Active buffs: Buffs from commander levels, talents and skills, formations, armaments, equipment, technologies, VIP levels, city buildings, city themes, civilization features, museums, army expansion items, as well as alliance technologies will take effect in the Divine Isles.
Inactive buffs: Buffs from runes, holy sites, Attack/Defense enhancement items, alliance skills, alliance and kingdom titles, kingdom buffs, and Lost Kingdom buffs will not take effect in the Divine Isles.
*Army expansion items cannot be used on Statue Sentry troops.`
Deployed Statue Sentry troops will automatically appear near random statues and serve as guards.I
Troops cannot be modified after defense begins. Please proceed carefully.

5. Once a treasure's location is revealed, it can be found in either your home kingdom or the Lost Kingdom. If you teleport from the Lost Kingdom or your home kingdom, the treasure will remain in its original location. You will need to return to that location to search for it.

Conduct Score Rules
1. Your Conduct score is a reflection of your recent in-game behavior. All governors start with an initial Conduct score of <color=#ffa800>100</color>.
2. <color=#ffa800>Violations</color> in any shape or form will lower your Conduct score, including but not limited to:
-<color=#ffa800> Using automated scripts or third party tools</color> to gather resources or attack barbarians/barbarian forts;
- Using synchronizers;
- Hacking the game client.
3. When your Conduct score drops below 100, you can <color=#ffa800>restore it</color> through active game behavior, such as:
- Manually gathering resources.
- Manually attacking barbarians and barbarian forts.
4. When your Conduct score drops below certain thresholds, <color=#ffa800>corresponding penalties will apply</color>:
- When Conduct is lower than 81, earnings from gathering resources and defeating barbarians are reduced by 50%. Transportation capacity is reduced by 50% when transporting resources to allies.
- When Conduct is lower than 61, resource assistance is prohibited. You won't be able to transport nor receive resources from allies. You are also prohibited from entering the Lost Kingdom, and some troop dispatch functions will be limited.
- You won't be able to log into the game with a Conduct score lower than 41.
