KICK-OFF FORECAST
Kick-Off Forecast@
Place your bets for the Kick-Off season and win amazing rewards!
<b><size=30>Kick-Off Forecast</size></b>
<color=#997336>Place your bets for the Kick-Off season with all governors!</color>
 <b>Overview</b>
1. Use <color=#379f1f>Kick-Off Aurics</color> to place bets on real-time game matches.
2. For each match during the <color=#379f1f>Group Stage</color>, you can bet on either team winning or a draw. During the <color=#379f1f>Knockout Stage</color>, you can bet on which team advances.
 <b>Bet and Settlement Rules</b>
1. You can only place bets for matches set to begin in <color=#379f1f>72 hours</color>.
2. You can only make <color=#E06666>one prediction</color> for each match. After a bet is placed, you can raise your wager before the match is locked, but you cannot decrease it nor change your prediction.
3. <color=#379f1f>30 minutes</color> prior to a match, its bets are confirmed and become locked. Locked bets cannot be changed or canceled.
4. At the end of each match, all bets placed on the losing team will be divided among the governors who bet correctly. The earnings received by each governor are proportional to the size of the individual bets placed. In addition, winners will also be returned their entire original bet.
5. Match results are updated the next day. Within 30 minutes of confirmed results, earnings will automatically be sent via mail by the system.
6. If a match is postponed or canceled, all bets placed on it are returned in full.
 <b>Sharing and Tailing Bets</b>
1. As long as a match hasn't been locked, you can share your bet with other governors and invite them to tail.
2. By tailing another governor's bet, you are betting on the same match outcome as them. Your wagered amount will count towards that governor's <color=#379f1f>total tailed wager</color>, but your earnings are calculated separately and will not be affected.
3. After placing or tailing a bet, you cannot change your prediction. However, you can still raise your wager as long as the match hasn't been locked.
4. Tailing follows the same rules as regular bets regarding locked bets, bet odds, and settlement.
 <b>Kick-Off Aurics</b>
1. Kick-Off Aurics can be obtained from the Kick-Off Supply Station event.
2. Kick-Off Aurics can be used to be redeem various rewards in the Kick-Off Shop.

Used to place bets and redeem rewards in the 2026 Kick-Off Forecast event.

Preparation
<b><size=30>Radiant Rivalry</size></b>
<color=#997336>A sacred ruin left behind by the ancients, the Radiant Spire is a symbol of the kingdom's fortune and faith. As the drums of war begin to sound, two kingdoms will clash in a contest of honor and strength. Who will seize the Radiant Spire and claim the crown of victory?</color>
 <b>Event Overview</b>
1. During the preparation phase, participating kingdoms compete by earning points each day. The kingdom with higher points scores for that day. At the end of the preparation phase, the kingdom with the higher total score gains the right to teleport into the opposing kingdom to contest the Radiant Spire. The losing kingdom must defend it from enemy capture.
2. During the battle phase, both kingdoms battle within the territory of the losing kingdom to seize the Radiant Spire.
 <b>Requirements</b>
Your City Hall must be at least <color=#e87300>level {p1}</color> to participate in this event.
 <b>Preparation Phase</b>
1. During the Preparation Phase, a new set of preparation quests will be unlocked <color=#e87300>each day</color>.
2. Governors can earn <color=#e87300>Individual Points</color> by completing preparation quests. Individual points also contribute to your kingdom's <color=#e87300>Kingdom Points</color>.
3. At 00:00 UTC each day, the Kingdom Points of both kingdoms are settled. The kingdom with more points scores for <color=#e87300>that day's preparation</color>. If both kingdoms have the same number of points, the kingdom that reaches the total first is considered the winner.
4. After the preparation phase ends, the <color=#e87300>final winner</color> will be determined based on the score results of both kingdoms.
5. During the preparation phase, governors can view individual points, kingdom points, individual rankings, and a rewards preview.
 <b>Battle Times</b>
1. During the preparation phase, the <color=#e87300>leader of the kingdom's top alliance</color> by power may cast votes to determine when the kingdom heads into battle.
2. Once both kingdoms have completed voting, the final time of battle will be determined based on vote results and that of the preparation phase if needed (winner gets priority).
3. After battle times are determined, they can be viewed in the event interface.
 <b>Battle Phase</b>
1. When the battle phase begins, governors from the attacking kingdom may <color=#e87300>teleport</color> to the designated area in the defending kingdom and begin preparations.
2. The attacking kingdom must expand its territory to <color=#e87300>capture the Radiant Spire</color>. The defending kingdom must defend the Radiant Spire from enemy capture.
3. During the battle phase, both kingdoms fight for control of the Radiant Spire such as by <color=#e87300>constructing alliance buildings, rallying, and stationing garrisons</color>.
4. At the end of the battle phase, <color=#e87300>the kingdom in control of the Radiant Spire is declared the winner of the battle</color>.
5. At the end of the battle phase, all cities and troops belonging to the attacking kingdom will be returned to their home kingdom.
 <b>Radiance Shop</b>
1. Governors who participate in battle phase combat can earn <color=#e87300>Radiant Tokens</color>.
2. Radiant Tokens can be used to <color=#e87300>redeem rewards</color> in the Radiance Shop.
3. Please refer to the relevant event page for information on available items and purchase limits in the Radiance Shop.
4. Radiant Tokens are automatically <color=#e87300>lost</color> at the end of the event. Please remember to use them promptly.
 <b>Event Rewards</b>
1. During the preparation phase, governors can earn rewards from daily individual rankings, individual progress, as well as final score results.
2. At the end of the battle phase, event rewards will be issued based on the amount of Radiant Tokens obtained.
3. Please claim your rewards before the event ends.
 <b>Other Rules</b>
1. Event matchmaking, rankings, and reward rules are subject to the actual information displayed on the event page.
2. During the battle phase, governors from the attacking kingdom will be subject to certain restrictions on map interactions, event participation, and ranking eligibility while in the defending kingdom.
3. During the battle phase, troops lost in battles against the enemy kingdom and resources spent on troop healing will be recorded in the Hall of Heroes. A portion of troops lost and resources spent will be returned when the event ends.
4. After the event ends, governors can view records of past battles in the event page.

3. Each type of prey is worth a certain number of points. <color=#379f1f>Killing an animal with a Vital Shot will earn you double points</color>.
 <b>Rank Rewards</b>

 <b>Other</b>

<b><size=30>Event Rules</size></b> 
1. Team immigration is only open to returning governors. To help you immigrate to kingdoms in the offseason, the number of Passport Pages needed to immigrate will be reduced.
2. You can only activate the team immigration feature for 1 character on your account. After successfully immigrating through team immigration, you will need to wait some time before using team immigration again. This will not affect the cooldown time for other types of immigration.
3. You can either join or create an immigration team. To help you find a team or recruit for your team, you can make use of the exclusive returning player chat channel.
4. To immigrate, your team's captain needs to submit an application to the kingdom you want to immigrate to. If any member of your team <b>exceeds the power limit for team immigration or is in the Season of Conquest</b>, the application must be approved by the target kingdom's king. Once approved, all members of your team will be able to immigrate there.
If all members of your team are <b>below the power limit for team immigration and no members are in the Season of Conquest</b>, your application will be automatically approved.
5. There is no minimum member requirement for an immigration team. You can create a one-person team if you wish. We recommend contacting the king of your target kingdom in advance via mail.
6. Only kingdoms in the offseason are open to team immigration. Imperium Kingdoms and kingdoms in their first Season of Conquest are not open to team immigration at the moment.
7. Incomplete returning player quests and unclaimed returning player rewards will carry over to the new kingdom.
8. If you immigrate through this event, you will appear within a random province of the target kingdom (you cannot choose a specific province).

 <color=#997336>A group of scholars was ambushed by barbarians during a field expedition! Many valuable research documents were scattered, including a proof copy of an unpublished scientific puzzle book. If you can recover lost pages from the barbarians and place them correctly to restore the damaged book, you can receive treasured rewards from the academy!</color>
 <b>Event Overview</b>
Defeat barbarians to collect Lost Pages and use them to restore the Book of Puzzles for valuable rewards.
 <b>Event Rules</b>
1. During the event, defeating barbarians gives a high chance of obtaining <color=#379f1f>Lost Pages</color>. Lost Pages cannot be used directly and must be placed in the Book of Puzzles. Restore the book and turn it in to receive treasured rewards from the academy.
2. <color=#379f1f>Arrange and rotate Lost Pages</color> to place as many as you can into the Book of Puzzles to complete the restoration.

 <b>Event Rewards</b>
1. Place as many Lost Pages as possible into the Book of Puzzles to restore it. Complete the restoration and turn in the book to claim valuable rewards.

 <b>Important Notes</b>
1. All Lost Pages will be <color=#E06666>lost</color> at 00:00 UTC each day, and the Book of Puzzles will be reset.
2. Any unclaimed Lost Pages from defeating barbarians cannot be claimed or used after the event ends.'

<b><size=30>Riddles of the Sphinx</size></b>
<color=#997336>Solve the riddles of the Sphinx and lead your team to survival!</color>
 <b>Event Overview</b>
During the event, governors whose City Hall has reached <color=#008b00>Level {p1}</color> may participate. You may enter solo matchmaking or join a team and allow the team captain to initiate matchmaking. Once matched, you will enter the same event session together.
 <b>Joining the Event</b>
1. This event requires at least {p2} governors to participate. You may join solo or invite other governors to form a team.
2. If the team is not full, additional governors will be matched automatically. Once matchmaking is complete, all members will enter the same event session together.
3. There are no limitations on how many times you can join sessions. Each quest tier's reward can only be claimed once.
 <b>Event Rules</b>
1. After entering an event session, the system will assign a number to each member. Governors will answer questions in turn according to the numbered order.
2. At the start of each question, characters with different color labels will refresh on the map. The answering governor must quickly observe the scenario and select the correct answer from four options.
3. Questions may involve counting characters, identifying colors, or performing simple calculations. All governors can view their teammates' selections, but only the answer submitted by the answering governor will be used to determine the result of the question.
4. Each question must be answered within {p3} seconds. A correct answer grants the team {p4} points.
5. If a governor answers incorrectly or fails to respond within the time limit, they will be swallowed by quicksand and eliminated for the remainder of the session. Eliminated governors may still spectate and select answers for subsequent questions, but their answers will not count towards results.
6. As long as the session is ongoing, surviving governors will continue to answer questions in sequence. If all governors are eliminated, the session ends immediately.
7. An event session is cleared when the team reaches the required point total. If the time limit expires before reaching the target, the session will be settled based on the current points.
 <b>Event Rewards</b>
1. Complete daily quests, event quests, or clear sessions to claim corresponding rewards.
2. After clearing each session, clear rewards can be claimed based on performance. Clear rewards can be claimed up to {p5} times per day.
3. Each quest tier's reward can only be claimed once. Please ensure rewards are collected before the event ends.
 <b>Other Rules</b>
1. During the event, achievement tags will display highest single-session scores, win streaks, and other performance highlights.

RULES
Overview
Battlefields
Battle Phase
Overview
1. During the preparation phase, participating kingdoms compete by earning points each day. <b>The kingdom with higher points scores for that day</b>. At the end of the preparation phase, the kingdom with the higher total score wins and gains the right to teleport into the opposing kingdom to contest the Radiant Spire. The losing kingdom must defend it from enemy capture.
2. During the battle phase, both kingdoms battle within the territory of the losing kingdom to seize the Radiant Spire.
PrerequisitesO
Your City Hall must be at least level <b>{p1}</b> to participate in this event.
Preparation Phase
1. During the Preparation Phase, a new set of preparation quests will be unlocked <b>each day</b>.
2. Governors can earn <b>Individual Points</b> by completing preparation quests. Individual points also contribute to your kingdom's <b>Kingdom Points</b>.
3. At 00:00 UTC each day, the Kingdom Points of both kingdoms are settled. The kingdom with more points <b>scores</b> for that day's preparation. If both kingdoms have the same number of points, the kingdom that reaches the total first is considered the winner.
4. After the preparation phase ends, the <b>final winner</b> will be determined based on the score results of both kingdoms.
5. During the preparation phase, governors can view individual points, kingdom points, individual rankings, as well as preview rewards.
Battle Time Voting
1. During the preparation phase, the <b>leader of the kingdom's top alliance</b> by power may cast votes to determine when the kingdom heads into battle.
2. Once both kingdoms have completed voting, the final time of battle will be determined based on vote results and that of the preparation phase if needed (winner gets priority).
3. After battle times are determined, they can be viewed in the event interface.
Radiant Tokens & Shop
1. Governors who take part in combat during the battle phase earn <b>Radiant Tokens</b>. Radiant Tokens are obtained when you severely wound or kill troops from other kingdoms, or when your own troops are severely wounded or killed in battles against them.
2. Radiant Tokens can be used to <b>redeem rewards</b> in the Radiance Shop.
3. Please refer to the relevant event page for information on available items and purchase limits in the Radiance Shop.
Event Rewards4
1. During the preparation phase, governors can earn rewards from daily individual rankings, individual progress, as well as final score results.
2. At the end of the battle phase, event rewards will be issued based on the amount of Radiant Tokens obtained.
3. Please claim your rewards before the event ends.
Coalitions|
1. After the battle phase begins, attacking and defending kingdoms can form alliances to join or create coalitions. Each coalition can contain a maximum of 4 alliances.
2. Within coalitions, alliances can teleport to each other's territory, and members can join each other's rallies and garrisons.
3. Members of the same coalition cannot attack each other.
4. All coalition members within coalition territory have territorial protection and their cities cannot be attacked. However, only members of the same alliance within the coalition receive territory buffs.
5. After the battle phase ends, the coalition is automatically disbanded.
Other Rules
1. Event matchmaking, rankings, and reward rules are subject to the actual information displayed on the event page.
2. During the battle phase, governors from the attacking kingdom will be subject to certain restrictions on map interactions, event participation, and ranking eligibility while in the defending kingdom.
3. During the battle phase, troops lost in battles against the enemy kingdom and resources spent on troop healing will be recorded in the Hall of Heroes. A portion of troops lost and resources spent will be returned when the event ends.
4. After the event ends, governors can view records of past battles in the event page.
Preparation
1. After the battle phase begins, there will be a 1-hour preparation period. During this time, attacking members can teleport to the defending kingdom's province where the Radiant Spire is located, and both attacking and defending sides can form alliances to create coalitions.
2. After teleporting, attacking members can build alliance fortresses in recommended locations within a designated safe zone.
3. During the battle preparation period, both sides can engage in field battles, but they cannot attack alliance buildings. Attacking members cannot attack the Radiant Spire at this time.
4. When the battle preparation period begins, the Radiant Spire becomes available for defending members to initiate attacks and attempt capture.
CombatJ
1. The combat period of the battle phase lasts for 4 hours. During this time, attacking members can build alliance flags outside of the safe zone, as well as attack alliance buildings and the Radiant Spire.
2. At the end of the combat period of the battle phase, the kingdom in control of the Radiant Spire is declared the winner.
Settlement
1. The settlement period lasts for 1 hour. During this time, the Radiant Spire becomes inaccessible and cannot be attacked.
2. Both sides can still engage in field battles and attack alliance buildings.
The battle phase ends in its entirety. All buildings constructed by attacking members in the defending kingdom are dismantled, and attacker cities and troops are automatically returned to their home kingdom.
Radiant Rivalry BattlegroundsN
The province where the defending kingdom's Radiant Spire is located serves as battlegrounds during the battle phase. The center of the engagement zone, where the Radiant Spire stands, is a key target of the battle. When the combat period of the battle phase ends, the kingdom in possession of the Radiant Spire is declared the victor.
Engagement Zone+
1. A combat area surrounding the Radiant Spire. At the beginning of the battle phase, defending members can teleport directly to this area to begin preparations (without joining an alliance).
2. The defending kingdom can build alliance flags here in advance, but it cannot build alliance fortresses.
Radiant Spire
The key target of the battle phase that can be contested once it begins. When the combat period of the battle phase ends, the kingdom in possession of the Radiant Spire is declared the victor; after, the spire will automatically become inaccessible.
Attacker Safe Zonel
1. At the beginning of the battle phase, attacking members can teleport to this area to begin preparations. Defending members cannot enter or teleport to this safe zone.
2. There are two recommended alliance fortress locations within the safe zone, and attacking members can build their fortresses there. Alliance resource centers cannot be built in the safe zone.

Radiant Rivalry Attacker Safe Zone
This area serves as the safe zone for the attacking kingdom during the battle phase of the Radiant Rivalry event:
1. The defending kingdom won't be able to construct fortresses in this area.
2. During the preparation period at the start of the battle phase, any governor cities or troops from the defending kingdom in this area will be automatically teleported or relocated to open areas. Barbarian forts, resource points, and alliance buildings in this area will be automatically removed.
3. At the beginning of the battle phase, attacking members can teleport to this area to begin preparations. Defending members cannot enter or teleport to this safe zone.
Radiant Rivalry Engagement Zonen
This area serves as the engagement zone for both kingdoms during the battle phase of the Radiant Rivalry event:
1. At the beginning of the battle phase, defending members can teleport directly to this area to begin preparations (without joining an alliance).
2. The defending kingdom can build alliance flags here in advance, but it cannot build alliance fortresses.&
